absence.en: In the absence of environmentally and economically feasible recycling options, fast fashion manufacturers pump out low quality clothes produced in high volumes that are worn only a few times, and then discarded.
absence.cn: 在缺乏环保且经济可行的回收方案的情况下，快时尚制造商大量生产质量低劣的服装，这些衣物往往只穿几次就被丢弃。
absence.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

absent.en: What caused more disruption was when schools tried to stay open in bad weather, even though many staff and pupils were absent .
absent.cn: 造成更多干扰的是，尽管许多教职员工和学生缺席，但学校仍试图在恶劣天气下保持开放。

absorb.en: "When the brain is healthier from a vascular point of view, it can absorb more Alzheimer's pathogen before people become symptomatic," he said.
absorb.cn: 从血管健康的角度来看，大脑越健康，就能在出现症状前吸收更多的阿尔茨海默病病原体，他表示。
absorb.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

absorption.en: Lawrence Patihis at the University of Southern Mississippi recently studied around 20 people with HSAM and found that they scored particularly high on two measures: fantasy proneness and absorption .
absorption.cn: 南密西西比大学的Lawrence Patihis最近研究了约20名患有HSAM的人，发现他们在两方面的分数特别高：幻想倾向和专注度。

abstract.en: This in turn helps us become better negotiators and abstract thinkers.
abstract.cn: 这反过来帮助我们成为更优秀的谈判者和更善于抽象思考的人。

abundance.en: You don't have to hit the grocery store daily, nor do you need an abundance of skill.
abundance.cn: 你不需要每天都去杂货店，也无需过多的技巧。
abundance.source: 2015年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

abundant.en: Well, creating fabric from cotton, which is the most abundant clothing material, is actually a process that involves a lot of water, 2,700 liters per shirt to be exact.
abundant.cn: 那么用最丰富的服装材料棉花来制作织物，实际上是一个需要大量的水的过程，准确地说，每件衬衫需要2700升水。

abuse.en: Some tiger cubs were dead because of abuse.
abuse.cn: 有些老虎幼崽因遭受虐待而死亡。
abuse.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第3套 听力

academic.en: I admit the academic record is very strong, with many outstanding awards for achievements in science and math, but he is just not mature enough to live on his own at this point.
academic.cn: 我承认他的学业成绩确实非常优秀,在科学和数学方面获得了许多杰出奖项,但现阶段他还不够成熟,无法独立生活。

accelerate.en: That comes against inflation rates that accelerated last month, with consumer prices growing 6.6%.
accelerate.cn: 这一预测出现在通货膨胀率上个月加速上升的背景下，当时消费者物价上涨了6.6%。

accent.en: Let's see, in his thirties, tall, bushy dark hair, slight northern accent , sounds a bit like you actually.
accent.cn: 我们来看看，他三十多岁，高高的个子，浓密的黑发，略带北方口音，听起来倒是有点像你。

acceptance.en: Luxury goods target our feelings of self-worth, acceptance , and status in the world.
acceptance.cn: 奢侈品迎合了我们对自我价值、认同感和社会地位的追求。

access.en: There is objection to e-learning days owing to fear that students with no access to the Internet at home will suffer.
access.cn: 由于担心无法在家上网的学生会受到影响，人们对实施电子学习日表示反对。
access.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

accidental.en: Children have an impulse to explore their noses and ears. This results in the accidental entry of foreign objects.
accidental.cn: 儿童有探索耳鼻的冲动，这会导致异物的意外进入。

accommodate.en: They are not designed for students to interact with the material in depth but designed to be graded easily to accommodate such a large number of students.
accommodate.cn: （在线课程）并不是为想要与学习课程材料深入交流的学生设计的，而是为了便于评分以适应大量的学生。

accommodation.cn: 帮她找到校园内的住宿。
accommodation.source: 2018年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

accompany.en: A permanent underestimation of one's own abilities is often accompanied by the fear that this supposed intellectual deception will be exposed sooner or later and that they will pay the price for this.
accompany.cn: 对自身能力的长期低估常伴随着一种恐惧，害怕这种所谓的智力欺骗迟早会被揭穿，并为此付出代价。

accomplish.en: She is saying it is possible that you can accomplish anything.
accomplish.cn: 她表示，你有可能实现任何目标。
accomplish.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

accord.en: Earlier this year, Italy signed an accord with UNESCO to establish a task force of police art detectives and archaeologists to protect cultural heritage from natural disasters and terror groups, such as ISIS.
accord.cn: 今年早些时候，意大利与联合国教科文组织联合签署了一项协议，成立一支由警察艺术侦探和考古学家组成的专案小组，以保护文化遗产免受自然灾害和诸如“伊斯兰国”等恐怖组织的侵害。

accordingly.en: Ultimately, Smith hopes institutions will take note of these insights accordingly .
accordingly.cn: 最后，史密斯希望各机构会相应地注意到这些见解。

accumulate.en: In fact, scientists now suspect accumulating novel experiences, facts, and skills can keep people's minds more flexible.
accumulate.cn: 实际上，科学家们现在认为，积累新奇的经历、知识和技能能够使人们的思维更加灵活。

accurate.en: With genetic testing becoming increasingly popular, many people are left wondering exactly how accurate it is.
accurate.cn: 随着基因检测日益普及,许多人开始疑惑它究竟有多准确。
accurate.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

accuse.en: For more than a decade, they have been under attack from e-commerce giants, blamed for making Americans fat, and accused of contributing to climate change.
accuse.cn: 十多年来，它们一直受到电商巨头的攻击，被指责导致美国人肥胖，是促成气候变化的罪魁祸首。

acknowledge.en: Pendry acknowledges that these are really important topics, and these workshops help typical students succeed, but they are less helpful for struggling students.
acknowledge.cn: Pendry承认这些课题的重要性，相关的研讨会能助力一般学生取得成功，然而，对于那些学业挣扎的学生来说，其帮助则相对有限。

acquaint.en: Through their reading they find a deeper significance to life as books acquaint them with life in the world as it was and it is now.
acquaint.cn: 通过阅读，他们发现了生活的更深层意义，因为书籍让他们了解了过去和现在的世界。

active.en: The 115-year-old woman is active on social media and regularly shares aspects of her life.
active.cn: 这位115岁的老人活跃在社交媒体上,经常分享她的生活点滴。

acute.en: The pain will be especially acute in parts of the country that heavily rely on heating oil to keep homes warm.
acute.cn: 在严重依赖取暖油的地区，居民将面临更为严峻的困境。

adapt.en: They studied how animals adapted themselves to life in zoos.
adapt.cn: 他们研究了动物如何适应在动物园中的生活。
adapt.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

addition.en: In addition to people being healthier and living much longer, economists say that a combination of financial considerations such as years of slow rise in real wages and a shift away from traditional pensions in the private sector are some of the reasons people delay retirement.
addition.cn: 除了人们更加健康、寿命更长之外，经济学家指出，实际工资多年增长缓慢、私营部门传统养老金制度的转变等一系列经济因素，也是人们推迟退休的部分原因。

additional.en: An additional bonus is when the winners see their design on sale in the spring of the following year.
additional.cn: 获胜者还有一个额外奖励，就是能在次年春季看到自己的设计作品在商店上架销售。

adequate.en: And the same activities that help prevent Alzheimer's — including avoiding smoking, getting adequate exercise and sleep and eating a healthy diet — also prevent heart disease, he said, making them even more worthwhile."
adequate.cn: 他说，帮助预防阿尔茨海默病的活动——包括戒烟、适量运动和充足睡眠以及健康饮食——也能预防心脏病，因此更有价值。

adjust.en: Although the pressure of the cabin is adjusted to prevent altitude sickness, you could still experience sleepiness or a headache.
adjust.cn: 虽然机舱的压力已经做了调整，以预防高空病，但你仍有可能会感到困倦或头痛。

administration.en: The university administration will likely vote to raise costs at least once more before my graduation.
administration.cn: 在我毕业之前，大学行政部门可能会投票决定至少再提高一次学费。

admiration.en: Indeed, Google, for which Leslie expresses admiration, is also his frequent whipping boy.
admiration.cn: 实际上，谷歌，这家莱斯利表达钦佩之情的企业，也常常沦为支撑其理论的替罪羊。
admiration.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

admission.en: It wasn't until after I had accepted admission to an out-of-state school that I learned that I could not use my Ohio Medicaid on campus for anything other than emergency care.
admission.cn: 直到我接受了州外学校的录取后，我才知道，除了紧急护理，我不能在校园里使用我的俄亥俄州医疗补助计划。

admit.en: I admit the academic record is very strong, with many outstanding awards for achievements in science and math, but he is just not mature enough to live on his own at this point.
admit.cn: 我承认他的学业成绩确实非常优秀,在科学和数学方面获得了许多杰出奖项,但现阶段他还不够成熟,无法独立生活。
admit.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

adopt.en: It is entitled to adopt any rules it wants.
adopt.cn: 它有权制定任何它想要的规则。
adopt.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

adoption.en: Alan was given away for adoption soon after he was born, and Walter never knew his father.
adoption.cn: 艾伦出生后不久就被送养了，沃尔特从未见过他的父亲。
adoption.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

advanced.en: To offer them a platform to pursue advanced degrees.
advanced.cn: 为他们提供攻读更高学位的平台。
advanced.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 阅读

advantageous.en: It found that being selfish was more advantageous than cooperating.
advantageous.cn: 研究发现，自私比合作更为有利。

adventure.en: The desire for adventure is a human one.
adventure.cn: 对冒险的渴望是人类的天性。
adventure.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

advertise.en: A totally different approach could be adopted to combat advertising campaigns for snack food.
advertise.cn: 可以采取完全不同的方法来应对零食广告宣传活动。

advisable.en: To ensure employees' commitment, it is advisable to give them more flexibility as to where and how they work.
advisable.cn: 为了确保员工的忠诚度，建议给予他们更大的工作地点和工作方式的灵活性。
advisable.source: 2017年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

advocate.en: On the other hand, advocates of organic farming argue yields and efficiency could be significantly improved if the food industry devoted as much research and money to organic farming as it does conventional agriculture.
advocate.cn: 另一方面，有机农业的支持者认为，如果食品行业在有机农业上投入与传统农业相同的研究和资金，有机作物的产量和效率可能会显著提高。

aerial.en: But the Center for Coastal Studies said Friday that its aerial survey team spotted a mum with two babies in Cape Cod Bay a day earlier.
aerial.cn: 不过，海岸研究中心在周五表示，它的空中调查团队一天前在科德角湾发现了一头母鲸带着两头幼鲸。
aerial.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

affection.en: In the history of horse racing, few horses have captured the affection of the British public like Red Rum.
affection.cn: 在赛马历史上，像Red Rum这样深受英国公众喜爱的马匹屈指可数。

afford.en: I'm not sure we can afford it.
afford.cn: 我担心我们可能负担不起。

afterward.en: Afterwards , the participants read a fictional survey of teens who wanted to "fight back against the companies by buying and eating less processed food".
afterward.cn: 之后，参与者阅读了一份虚构的调查问卷，问卷内容是关于青少年想要“通过购买和食用更少的加工食品来反击这些公司”。

aggressive.en: Newspapers are constantly filled with frightening accounts of drug addiction and aggressive behavior supposedly caused by violent video games.
aggressive.cn: 报刊上不断充斥着有关暴力视频游戏所致药物上瘾和攻击性行为的骇人听闻的报道。
aggressive.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

agreeable.en: "Blue became the color of choice because it's a conservative, agreeable , corporate shade that symbolizes being trustworthy and safe.
agreeable.cn: “蓝色之所以成为首选颜色，是因为它是一种保守、令人愉悦的企业色调，象征着值得信赖和安全。

agriculture.en: Whether or not to buy organic is a personal decision, said Mike von Massow, professor of Food Agriculture .
agriculture.cn: 要不要购买有机食品是个人的选择，食品农业教授迈克·冯·马索表示。

aisle.en: Regular shoppers at the supermarket are familiar with the sight of several cats settling down in the shop aisles.
aisle.cn: 超市的常客们已经习惯了看到几只猫在商店过道里安家的景象。
aisle.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

alert.en: The technology is being adopted so quickly that school districts cannot adequately keep up with cheating policies, or even awareness campaigns that alert students to the problem with using technology to find answers in a certain way.
alert.cn: 这项技术被采用得太快，各个学区无法充分跟进作弊政策，甚至没法跟进宣传活动，以提醒学生不要使用某种技术手段查找答案。

alliance.en: Kids in play-based kindergartens "end up equally good or better at reading and other intellectual skills, and they are more likely to become well-adjusted healthy people," the Alliance for Childhood said in 2009.
alliance.cn: 儿童联盟在 2009 年表示，在以游戏为基础的幼儿园里，孩子们“最终在阅读和其他智力技能方面表现得同样出色甚至更好，而且他们更有可能成为适应良好的健康人”。
alliance.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

allowance.en: Luthar is not opposed to giving allowances , but she thinks it's important to establish that chores are done not because they will lead to payment, but because they keep the household running.
allowance.cn: 卢瑟并不反对发放零用钱，但她认为重要的是要明确，做家务不是为了获得报酬，而是为了维持家庭的运转。

ally.en: Besides, with Jonathan's wild gang to contend with, I'd really welcome an ally.
ally.cn: 此外还要对付乔纳森的疯狂团伙，我真心欢迎你做我的盟友。
ally.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

alongside.en: Your coworkers are more likely to agree with you when they succeed alongside you.
alongside.cn: 当你的同事与你一起取得成功时，他们更有可能认同你的观点。
alongside.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

alter.en: Alter its per-pupil funding policy on a rational basis.
alter.cn: 理性地调整其人均资助政策。
alter.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

alteration.en: The researchers are already working with food companies keen to see if their products can be made resistant to bacterial attack through alterations to the food's structure.
alteration.cn: 研究人员已经与一些食品公司合作，这些公司渴望了解是否可以通过改变食品的结构来使他们的产品能够抵抗细菌的侵袭。
alteration.source: 2000年1月英语四级 第1套 阅读

alternative.en: When people want to make a quick and easy choice, when the product is complex, when it's difficult to compare alternatives , and when consumers don't have clear preferences.
alternative.cn: 这些规则适用于以下情况：当人们希望快速简单地做出选择时，当产品较为复杂时，当难以比较不同选择时，以及当消费者没有明确偏好时。

altitude.en: Besides the airport crowds and stress, traveling at a high altitude has real effects on the body.
altitude.cn: 除了机场拥挤的人群和由此产生的压力，在高空飞行确实会对身体产生影响。

amateur.en: But observations that an amateur bird-watcher can make are really limitless.
amateur.cn: 但业余观鸟者可以进行的观察真的是无穷无尽的。
amateur.source: 2009年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

ambassador.en: Our guide for some of our stay was the inestimable Hilde Hoven, a Dark Sky ambassador who runs Good Heavens with Deborah Kilgallon and Orla Cumisky.
ambassador.cn: 我们部分行程的向导是无可比拟的希尔德·霍文，她是黑暗天空大使，与黛博拉·基尔加伦和奥拉·卡米斯基共同经营Good Heavens。

ambition.en: After an American company … acquired the Formula One competition recently, … a former executive with Fox Broadcasting Company and DirecTV who by his own admission is not a fierce racing fan was named to replace Ecclestone and to try to renovate the organization's management, reach and ambition .
ambition.cn: 美国公司最近收购了一级方程式赛车比赛之后，福克斯广播公司和DirecTV前高管（他承认自己并不是狂热的赛车迷）被任命接替埃克尔斯通，试图更新该组织的管理、影响范围和雄心。

ambitious.en: By all means, set ambitious long-term goals for your future self, but when it comes to actually following through day-to-day, make sure your present self knows what’s in it for her too.
ambitious.cn: 当然，可以为将来的自己设定宏伟的长期目标，但在日常的跟进执行中，也要让你现在的自己明白这样做的好处。

amid.en: Amid all the election drama, air pollution problems, and disease outbreaks, five tourists' good work is being spread online.
amid.cn: 在选举风波、空气污染问题和疾病爆发的背景下，五位游客的善举正在网上传播。
amid.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

amongst.en: These are often very well received amongst mainstream music fans.
amongst.cn: 这些作品通常在主流音乐爱好者中备受青睐。
amongst.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

analytic.en: In particular, Arum and Roksa found, college students were not developing the critical thinking, analytic reasoning and other higher-level skills…
analytic.cn: 尤其是，阿鲁姆和洛科萨发现大学生没有养成批判性思维、分析性推理和其他高级技能。

ancestor.en: Susan is white. She says her ancestors were from Britain.
ancestor.cn: 苏珊是白人，她说她的祖先来自于英国。
ancestor.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

anniversary.en: The 100th anniversary celebration of Methodist University.
anniversary.cn: 卫理公会大学百年校庆。
anniversary.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

announce.en: The State Department will announce a partnership with an online education platform called Coursera.
announce.cn: 美国国务院将宣布与在线教育平台Coursera建立合作伙伴关系。

annual.en: The vast majority of the UK's 200,000 tons of retail sector’s annual food waste comes from supermarkets.
annual.cn: 英国零售业每年约20万吨的食品浪费，绝大部分来自超市。

anticipate.en: Researchers say this was because participants anticipated more negative judgment from an outsider group.
anticipate.cn: 研究人员表示，这是因为参与者预期会受到来自外部群体的更多负面评价。

antique.en: It stores lots of priceless antiques .
antique.cn: 它收藏了许多无价的古董。

apparent.en: This characteristic is particularly apparent in a new study, focusing on people who underwent a hemispherectomy, a surgical procedure in which half of the brain is removed to treat illness.
apparent.cn: 这一特性在一项新研究中表现得尤为明显，该研究关注了接受半脑切除术的患者，这是一种通过切除半个大脑来治疗疾病的手术。

appeal.en: The teenagers also rated healthy eating as being more appealing.
appeal.cn: 青少年们也认为健康饮食更有吸引力。
appeal.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

appearance.en: Americans spend an average of over $722 each year on their appearance .
appearance.cn: 美国人每年平均在外表上花费超过722美元。

applaud.en: Some applaud the policy as fair, because it rewards both individuals who maintain a healthy weight and those who are working towards achieving it.
applaud.cn: 一些人称赞这项政策很公平，因为它既奖励那些保持健康体重的人，又奖励那些努力达到健康体重的人。
applaud.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

applause.en: While the city council vote was met with applause inside the council room, opponents to the measure, including soda lobbyists made sharp criticisms and a promise to challenge the tax in court.
applause.cn: 尽管市议会投票结果在议会会议室内赢得了掌声，但包括汽水游说者在内的反对者却提出了尖锐的批评，并承诺将在法庭上挑战这项税收。
applause.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

appliance.en: With costs falling and kitchen appliances becoming "status" items, owners are throwing away microwaves after an average of eight years.
appliance.cn: 随着成本下降，厨房用具成为象征“身份”的物品，所有者平均八年后就会丢弃微波炉。

applicable.en: …John Sievenpiper, associate professor at the University of Toronto's Department of Nutritional Sciences, set out to understand if the associations between sugary soft drinks and health were applicable to the food and drink…
applicable.cn: ……多伦多大学营养科学系副教授约翰・西文派珀着手探究含糖软饮料与健康之间的关联是否也适用于……的食物和饮料。

application.en: The city then changed the program to limit the number of applications each month.
application.cn: 随后，市政府调整了计划，限制每月的申请数量。

appoint.en: Last year Britain even appointed a minister for loneliness.
appoint.cn: 去年，英国甚至任命了一位部长负责孤独问题。

appointment.en: Even if your school offers a flat-rate fee for a doctor's appointment at the student health center (mine is $20 a visit), these fees often do not include extra fees for lab tests or prescription medications.
appointment.cn: 即使你的学校预约学生健康中心的医生只需要支付统一费用(我的是每次20美元)，这些费用通常不包括实验室检测或处方药的额外费用。

appreciate.en: We may be appreciated more by people around us.
appreciate.cn: 我们或许会更受周围人的欣赏。
appreciate.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

appropriate.en: It's gained through experience on the job and learning what's appropriate given the needs of the project.
appropriate.cn: 这种能力是通过工作实践以及学习如何根据项目需求做出恰当选择而获得的。

approval.en: People-pleasing, or seeking self-worth through others’ approval, is unproductive and an exhausting way to go through life.
approval.cn: 通过讨好他人寻求自我认同，不仅效率低下，还会让人感到筋疲力尽。
approval.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

approve.en: The school board approved criteria to close schools with fewer than 215 students, as well as schools with fewer than 275 students and a projected decline in enrollment.
approve.cn: 校董事会通过了关闭学生少于215人的学校的标准，以及那些学生少于275人且预计入学人数下降的学校。
approve.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

approximate.en: Nowadays, men eat an approximate average of 140 grams of bread daily, whereas women eat 80 to 90 grams.
approximate.cn: 如今，男性平均每天吃140克面包，而女性平均每天吃80到90克面包。

architect.en: Many other designers and architects have expressed concern over the future supply of home-grown talent for UK firms, and industry bodies have pointed out that there has been a lack of roots-level support.
architect.cn: 许多设计师和建筑师也对英国企业未来本土人才供应表示担忧，行业机构指出，基层支持严重不足。

architecture.en: Carême would often spend his free afternoons at the nearby National Library reading books on art and architecture.
architecture.cn: 卡雷姆经常在空闲的下午到附近的国家图书馆阅读有关艺术和建筑的书籍。
architecture.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

arise.en: How did these personal bubbles arise ?
arise.cn: 这些个人空间气泡是怎样产生的呢？

arouse.en: Arouse customers' appetite to buy flowers, fruit and vegetables.
arouse.cn: 激发顾客购买鲜花、水果和蔬菜的欲望。

artificial.en: Over the coming decades, millions of jobs will be threatened by robotics and artificial intelligence.
artificial.cn: 在接下来的几十年中，机器人和人工智能将威胁到数百万个职位。

artistic.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

ashore.en: It's a fantasy that goes back centuries: a message in a bottle, carried ashore from far-off lands.
ashore.cn: 这是一个可以追溯到几个世纪前的幻想：装在瓶子里的纸条，从遥远的国度来到岸上。
ashore.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 阅读

aside.en: One recent study tested people's willingness to set aside selfish interests to reach a greater good.
aside.cn: 最近一项研究测试了人们是否愿意放下私利，以实现更大的共同利益。
aside.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

assemble.en: Some 55% of consumers, according to the report, said they are “more” concerned about high-tech components come from than where the product was assembled.
assemble.cn: 根据报道，约55%的消费者说他们更关心高科技零件来自于哪里而不是产品在哪里组装。
assemble.source: 2012年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

assembly.en: In more than a tew passages, she relates the stories of men and women who came up against assembly-line medicine where patients were treated mostly as pieces of flesh.
assembly.cn: 在不止一段文字中，她讲述了那些与流水线医疗作斗争的男男女女的故事，在这种医疗模式下，病人大多被当作一块块肉来对待。
assembly.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

assess.en: Educational videos may deliver academic content, but they are unable to make eye contact or assess a student’s level of engagement.
assess.cn: 教育视频可以传递学术内容，但无法与学生进行眼神交流，也无法与评估学生的课堂参与度。

asset.cn: 把我们的经验视为财富。

assign.en: Participants were more willing to employ deceptive strategies when assigned an agent to negotiate on their behalf.
assign.cn: 当参与者指派一名代理人代替他们进行谈判时，他们更倾向于运用欺骗性手段。
assign.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

assignment.en: A pilot programme in a school district in Anderson County, South Carolina, has supplied students with electronic tablets loaded with assignments to complete in the event of a school closure.
assignment.cn: 南卡罗来纳州安德森县的一所学区正在试行一个项目，为学生配备了预装作业的电子平板，以在学校停课时使用。
assignment.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

assistant.en: We're growing more used to chatting to our computers, phones and smart speakers through voice assistants like Amazon's Alexa, Apple's Siri and Microsoft's Cortana.
assistant.cn: 我们越来越习惯于通过亚马逊的Alexa、苹果的Siri和微软的Cortana等语音助手与电脑、手机和智能音响聊天。

associate.en: Having a valuable outcome associated with a habit will help you stick to that habit permanently.
associate.cn: 如果一个习惯能带来有价值的结果，这将有助于你长期坚持这个习惯。

association.en: This type of study can't say exactly what kind of exercise is best, or how much is needed — only a study that has a placebo group and tracks people going forward can do that, said Keith Fargo, director of scientific programs and outreach at the non-profit Alzheimer's Association.
association.cn: 这种类型的研究无法准确指出哪种运动最好，或需要多少运动量——只有对比设有安慰剂对照组并进行长期追踪的研究才能做到这一点，非营利机构阿尔茨海默病协会的科学项目与外展部主任基思·法戈说。
association.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

assume.en: I assume that you don't want to be too high up.
assume.cn: 我猜想你不想待在太高的地方。

assumption.en: Secondly, the test supported the assumption that people with a tendency to exhibit the Impostor Phenomenon devalue their objectively measured performance and attribute positive results to external causes such as luck and chance, but not to their own abilities.
assumption.cn: 其次，实验支持了一种假设：倾向于出现冒名顶替现象的人会贬低他们客观测量的表现，并将积极结果归因于外部因素，如运气和机会，而非自身能力。

assure.en: We were assured that, except for low grades or a raise in family income, no money would be taken away.
assure.cn: 我们得到保证，除了成绩太差或家庭收入增加外，不会拿走（奖学金里的）任何钱。

astonish.en: It is astonishing how many cultures share this tool in approaching music.
astonish.cn: 令人惊讶的是，许多文化在音乐中都使用这种元素。

astonishment.en: A Hillsdale teacher who became principal last year, remembers sitting with other teachers watching students file out of a graduation ceremony and asking one another in astonishment , "How did that student graduate?"
astonishment.cn: 一位去年成为校长的希尔斯代尔教师回忆说，他曾与其他教师坐在一起，看着学生们鱼贯走出毕业典礼，惊讶地互相问道：“那个学生是怎么毕业的？”

atmosphere.en: A more favorable atmosphere for effective classroom learning.
atmosphere.cn: 营造更有利于有效课堂学习的氛围。

atomic.en: Thus, time and time's relativity are measurable by any hourglass, alarm clock, or atomic clock that can measure a billionth of a second.
atomic.cn: 因此，任何能够测量十亿分之一秒的沙漏、闹钟或原子钟都可以测量时间和时间的相对性。

attachment.en: These include helping with social development, increasing physical activity, managing anxiety or serving as a source of attachment in the face of changing family structures.
attachment.cn: 这些积极影响包括促进儿童社交能力发展、增加体育锻炼、缓解焦虑情绪，以及在家庭结构发生变化时成为情感寄托的对象。

attempt.en: Today's historians agree that overall, the standards of living increase. They do not agree, however, on when this improvement occurred. In an effort to solve this controversy, historians have attempted to define exactly what "standard of living" means.
attempt.cn: 当今的历史学家普遍认为，生活水平整体上提高了，但他们对这一改善发生的时间并不一致。为了化解这一争议，历史学家试图准确定义“生活水平”的含义。
attempt.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

attendance.en: Students who don't get enough sleep have poorer attendance and lower grades.
attendance.cn: 缺乏睡眠的学生出勤率偏低，成绩也相对较差。
attendance.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

attendant.en: During peak shopping hours, some retailers solved the parking problems by getting moonlighting local police to work as parking attendants .
attendant.cn: 在购物高峰期，一些零售商通过聘请兼职的当地警察担任停车管理员来解决停车问题。

attorney.en: New York's Attorney General's office an investigation in the fall into whether or not Verizon, Cablevision and Time Warner are delivering broadband that's as fast as the providers it is.
attorney.cn: 纽约州总检察长办公室在秋季展开调查，以查明 Verizon、Cablevision 和时代华纳提供的宽带速度是否与供应商提供的速度一样快。

attraction.en: The poisonous snake forced the closure of the attraction last week when staff noticed the disappearance.
attraction.cn: 上周，当工作人员注意到这条毒蛇失踪时，景点被迫关闭。
attraction.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

attribute.en: This is generally attributed to backward thinking and conservative values, but new research shows that such differences could be linked to differences in the preferences of males and females.
attribute.cn: 这通常被认为是因为落后的思维方式和保守的价值观，但新的研究表明，这样的差异可能与男女偏好上的不同有关。
attribute.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

audience.en: While we know that adults use a large variety of attributes to manage and create impressions, we don't yet know whether children understand and use the fact that different attributes are valuable at different times to different audiences.
audience.cn: 虽然我们知道成年人会运用各种各样的特质来管理和塑造自身形象，但我们尚不清楚，孩子们是否理解并运用这样一个事实 —— 即不同的特质在不同的时机、对不同的受众而言，具有不同的价值。
audience.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

audio.en: To install some audio equipment in a lab
audio.cn: 在实验室安装一些音频设备

authority.en: The man told authorities that his experience began in December when currents swept the sailboat out to sea while he was making repairs.
authority.cn: 这名男子告诉当局，他的经历始于12月，当时他在修理船只时，洋流将帆船卷入海中。

auto.en: In 1950, a young man would have found it much easier than it is today to get and keep a job in the auto industry.
auto.cn: 年轻人会发现，1950年在汽车行业寻得并维持一份工作比今天容易得多。

automate.en: Research in human-vehicle interaction has shown even systems designed to automate driving are far from being error-proof.
automate.cn: 人车交互方面的研究表明，即使是旨在实现自动驾驶的系统也远非万无一失。
automate.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

automatic.en: Automatic driving systems are by no means immune to errors.
automatic.cn: 自动驾驶系统并非完全不会出错。
automatic.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

automobile.en: Give way to automobiles at all times.
automobile.cn: 任何时候都要给汽车让路。

average.en: The average international runway model has a body mass index (BMI) under 16—low enough to indicate starvation by the World Health Organization’s standard.
average.cn: 国际T型台模特儿的平均体重指数（BMI）低于16——按照世界卫生组织的标准足以表明是处于饥饿状态。

aviation.en: She added the helicopters varied around eight customers to the airport on their first day, the company that owns and operates the service is called Thumby aviation .
aviation.cn: 她补充说，直升机在第一天运送了大约八名乘客到机场，拥有和运营这项服务的公司名为 Thumby Aviation。

awkward.en: Some of them find it awkward when hugging children.
awkward.cn: 他们中有些人觉得拥抱孩子很尴尬。

bachelor.en: The share of Americans with bachelor's degrees who were working into their 70s reached nearly 20% in 2018.
bachelor.cn: 2018年，拥有学士学位且工作到70多岁的美国人比例接近20%。

background.en: Yet, not a single interviewer has ever asked me about my educational background.
background.cn: 然而，没有任何一个面试官问过我的教育背景。
background.source: 2018年6月大学英语六级考试真题（三）

backward.en: The suggestion of letting children simply play may sound like going backwards to parents who want to help build their children's skills.
backward.cn: 让孩子自由玩耍的建议，对于想要帮助孩子培养技能的父母来说，听起来可能是一种倒退。
backward.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

backyard.en: With Silicon Valley in its backyard, it certainly has the chance to do so.
backyard.cn: 硅谷就在它的后院，它当然有机会做到这一点。
backyard.source: 2020年12月大学英语四级考试真题

bacteria.en: The use of animal waste in organic agriculture can also be a factor in the spread of bacteria like coli and salmonella.
bacteria.cn: 在有机农业中使用动物粪便也可能成为传播细菌的因素，例如大肠杆菌和沙门氏菌。

badge.en: Today, consulting or freelancing for five businesses at the same time is a badge of honor.
badge.cn: 现如今，能够同时为五家企业做咨询或做自由职业者是荣耀的象征。

balcony.en: Wide awake at 3:30 am with our nine-year-old daughter on our lodge balcony , I stared for hours at the most incredible night sky I've ever seen before the dawn slowly started to rub out the stars on the horizon and the multiple shooting stars faded away.
balcony.cn: 凌晨3:30，我和九岁的女儿坐在小屋阳台上彻夜未眠，我凝视着这辈子见过的最美的夜空，直到黎明慢慢开始抹去天边的星星，许多流星也渐渐消失。

ballet.en: It is a traditional type of ballet.
ballet.cn: 这是一种传统的芭蕾舞。
ballet.source: 2019年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

bang.en: The job was to end with a monumental bang when I became so poorly I could no longer function. A few feverish weeks in bed ended in a specialist appointment, where I was diagnosed with Lupus and rushed into hospital for fear that it may have attacked my internal organs.
bang.cn: 这份工作原本应该以一场巨大的悲剧收场，因为我的病情急转直下，完全丧失了工作能力。在床上高烧数周后，我去看了一位专科医生，被确诊为红斑狼疮，并被紧急送往医院，因为医生担心病情可能已经扩散到我的内脏器官。

banker.en: Katherine's father used to be a successful investment banker .
banker.cn: 凯瑟琳的父亲曾经是一位成功的投资银行家。

bankrupt.en: Most people can get unstuck without going bankrupt .
bankrupt.cn: 大多数人都可以在不破产的情况下摆脱困境。

banner.en: Welcome to the ColoredZone, a large stretched banner could have said.
banner.cn: “欢迎来到有色人种区”，一条巨大的横幅上可能会这样写着。

banquet.en: He voyaged to England to cook in the modern Great Kitchen of the prince regent, George IV, and crossed continents to prepare grand banquets for the tables of Tsar Alexander I of Russia.
banquet.cn: 他远赴英国，在摄政王乔治四世的现代化大厨房里掌勺；他还跨越各大洲，为俄罗斯沙皇亚历山大一世的餐桌准备盛大宴会。

bare.en: And it felt good in there, like walking around your house in bare feet and underwear, or snoring right out loud on the couch in front of the TV—enveloped by the comforts of home, the warmth of those you love.
bare.cn: 待在里面感觉很好，就像光着脚穿着内衣在家里走来走去，或者在电视机前的沙发上大声打鼾——被家的舒适和爱人的温暖包围着。

barely.en: Over the next century, he predicted, the economy would become so productive that people would barely need to work at all.
barely.cn: 他预测，未来一百年间，经济将变得极为高效，人们几乎无需工作。
barely.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

bargain.en: To make customers believe they are getting a bargain .
bargain.cn: 让顾客觉得他们买到了便宜货。

barrel.en: Although you don’t read about this much, the United States is also a large exporter of oil products, selling about 2 million barrels of petroleum products per day to about 90 countries.
barrel.cn: 尽管你没了解很多，但是美国也是石油产品的出口大国，每天把200万桶石油产品销往约90个国家。

baseball.en: Besides, I don't think I could ever give up a good hot dog at a baseball game.
baseball.cn: 再说，我觉得自己永远无法放弃在棒球比赛时吃热狗的乐趣。

basically.en: Earlier this year, Matthew Ricci told gaming site Kotaku: "If you're playing EVE Online you basically already have an MBA."
basically.cn: 今年早些时候，马修·里奇告诉游戏网站 Kotaku：“如果你玩《EVE Online》，你基本上就已经拥有一个MBA学位了。”
basically.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

basis.en: "From the get-go, it was designed on the basis of connectivity and competitiveness," says Kasada.
basis.cn: 卡萨达说：“从一开始，它就是在连接性和竞争力的基础上设计的。”
basis.source: 2019年12月大学英语四级考试真题（二）

battery.en: It has no batteries, if that's what you mean.
battery.cn: 如果你是问这个的话，它不需要电池。
battery.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

beam.en: A beam about ten feet long collapsed to the ground.
beam.cn: 一根约十英尺长的横梁坍塌到地面。

bearing.en: An accumulating body of research indicates that some distinctions between one type of elder care and another have little real bearing on how well residents do.
bearing.cn: 越来越多的研究表明，一种老年护理机构与另一种之间的某些区别对于入住者的表现如何几乎没有什么切实的联系。

beforehand.en: Therefore, if you are someone who loves to show physical affection, you should not be afraid to show it or drastically change your behaviors just ask for consent beforehand !
beforehand.cn: 因此，如果你喜欢表达肢体接触，你不应该害怕表达或彻底改变你的行为，只要事先征得对方的同意即可！

behave.en: Five-year-olds aren't just aware of their reputations, they also behave strategically to alter their outward image.
behave.cn: 五岁的孩子不仅意识到自己的声誉，他们还会策略性地调整自己的外在形象。
behave.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

behavior.en: Emotion is what really drives the purchasing behaviors and also decision-making in general.
behavior.cn: 情感是驱动购买行为及一般决策的真正动力。
behavior.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

beloved.en: Even their fine motor skills can be utilized in taking care of a beloved animal.
beloved.cn: 照顾心爱的宠物还能锻炼孩子的精细动作能力。

beneath.en: As customers began to queue, Mr. Azar reached beneath the counter for a black plastic bag.
beneath.cn: 当顾客开始排队时，阿扎尔先生从柜台下面伸手去拿一个黑色塑料袋。
beneath.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

beneficial.en: According to Knopman, the study gives the message that a healthy lifestyle is beneficial , but not that all the middle-aged need heavy exercise.
beneficial.cn: 据诺普曼说，这项研究传递的信息是健康的生活方式是有益的，但并不是所有中年人都需要进行高强度运动。

bet.en: I know I'm not alone here — I bet you loved your first lunch box, too.
bet.cn: 我知道并不是只有我这样——我敢说你也很喜欢你的第一个饭盒。
bet.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

bible.en: The phenomenon is often referred to as the Matthew effect, inspired by the Bible's wisdom that to those who have, more will be given.
bible.cn: 这种现象通常被称为马太效应，这是受《圣经》智慧的启发：已经拥有的，还要给他更多。
bible.source: 2021年6月大学英语四级考试真题

bid.en: Their unusual coloring is believed to be the result of scar tissue from dolphin fights, whether play fighting or a serious bid for a mate.
bid.cn: 人们认为，它们与众不同的颜色是海豚打斗后留下疤痕组织的结果，无论是嬉戏打闹还是真正为了争夺配偶而进行的争斗。

billion.en: Analysts don't expect the meat-free movement to slow anytime soon; a 2021 report predicts the market will skyrocket to $74 billion by 2030—a 957 percent surge.
billion.cn: 分析师预计素食潮流不会很快放缓；2021 年的一份报告预测，到 2030 年，该市场将飙升至 740 亿美元——增幅高达 957%。
billion.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

bind.en: For example, a Japanese firm may have signed a contract, but they may not feel bound by every detail of it—particularly if circumstances later change.
bind.cn: 例如，一家日本公司可能已经签好了合同，但他们可能不会认为自己受里面所有细节的约束——尤其是之后情况有所改变时。

blade.en: "The idea was to put blades on the wheels! You know? Like Ben Hur. Precisely like that, you just go around and run people down."
blade.cn: “我们就是想把刀片放在轮子上！你明白吧？就像电影中的人物宾虚那样。真的就像那样，你只是四处走走，把人们撞倒。”

blend.en: There's also a theory that this color helps the dolphins more readily blend in with their surroundings.
blend.cn: 也有理论指出，这种颜色有助于海豚更好地与环境融为一体。

blond.en: Melanomas are the most aggressive skin cancers. You have a higher risk if you have red or blond hair, fair skin, blue or green eyes, or sunburn easily, or if a close relative has had one.
blond.cn: 黑瘤是最恶性的皮肤癌。如果你有红色或金色头发、白色皮肤、蓝色或绿色眼睛，或很容易被太阳晒伤，或你的亲属或亲戚得过皮肤癌，你患皮肤癌的风险也高。

bloom.en: In the 1920s, Swiss psychologist Jean Piaget proposed that children's cognitive abilities unfold, like the blooming of a flower, almost independent of what else is in their lives.
bloom.cn: 20 世纪 20 年代，瑞士心理学家让·皮亚杰提出，儿童的认知能力的发展就像花朵的绽放一样，几乎与他们生活中的其他事物无关。

board.en: The board of Denver public schools is set to close several elementary and middle schools to make up for a decreased budget caused by declining enrollment.
board.cn: 丹佛公立学校董事会计划关闭几所小学和初中，以弥补因入学人数下降而导致的预算减少。

boast.en: The island boasts a beautiful wilderness with dense forests, glorious, unspoilt sandy beaches and plenty of bays and a few mountainous areas where there are good walking tracks among the wetlands and valleys.
boast.cn: 该岛拥有美丽的荒野，密林、壮丽且未受破坏的沙滩，众多海湾以及一些山地地区，其中有穿越湿地与山谷的良好步道。

bodily.en: We recorded children's facial and bodily expressions.
bodily.cn: 我们记录了孩子们的面部表情和身体姿势。
bodily.source: 2020年7月大学英语六级考试真题

bold.en: However, last year, the restaurant's co-owner and famous chef, Daniel Humm, made the bold decision to remove meat from the menu, citing our unsustainable food system.
bold.cn: 然而去年，餐厅联合老板兼知名主厨丹尼尔·胡姆做出了大胆决定，将肉类从菜单中移除，理由是我们的食品体系不可持续。

bolt.en: "They want someone who isn't constrained by nuts and bolts to look at the big picture,"says Scheetz.
bolt.cn: “他们需要的是不拘泥于细节、着眼于全局的人，”谢茨说道。

bond.en: These closer bonds and greater attachment pay off.
bond.cn: 这些更紧密的纽带和更大的依恋是值得的。
bond.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

boost.en: But whatever the type of animal, the vast majority of owners said their pets boosted their mental and physical health.
boost.cn: 但无论是哪种动物，绝大多数宠物主人都表示，他们的宠物提升了自己的心理和身体健康。
boost.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

booth.en: Neon is to Hong Kong as red phone booths are to London and fog is to San Francisco.
booth.cn: 霓虹灯对于香港的意义就如同红色电话亭之于伦敦，雾之于旧金山。
booth.source: 2018年6月大学英语四级考试真题（三）

border.en: Not all casualties can necessarily be prevented—but by coordinating across local, state, and even national borders, officials hope that the worst-case scenario can be averted.
border.cn: 并不是所有伤亡都可以避免，但官员们希望通过跨地区、跨州，甚至跨国界的协作来防止发生最坏的情况。
border.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（一）

bore.en: Robots are not yet witty, Siri is boring.
bore.cn: 机器人还不够机智，Siri 很无聊。
bore.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

bounce.en: The value of listed shares in American firms collapsed by 57% from its peak in October 2007 to a low in March this year, though it has since bounced back somewhat.
bounce.cn: 美国上市公司的股票价值从 2007 年 10 月的峰值到今年 3 月的低点暴跌了 57%，不过此后有所回升。
bounce.source: 2013年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

bound.en: They are bound to excel effortlessly.
bound.cn: 他们注定会毫不费力地脱颖而出。

boundary.en: This is precisely why parents still need to set firm boundaries around it, as with any other distraction.
boundary.cn: 正因如此，父母必须为此划定明确的界限，如同管理其他分散注意力的事物一般。
boundary.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

brand.en: Many consumers report comparing multiple competing brands and prices when evaluating a purchase.
brand.cn: 许多消费者表示，在考虑购买时会货比三家，比较多个竞争品牌和价格。

breadth.en: Books influence the depth and breadth of life.
breadth.cn: 书籍影响着人生的深度和广度。

breakdown.en: The combined effects of those trends and the political tensions they generate point to the breakdown of governments and societies.
breakdown.cn: 这些趋势的联合效应及其产生的政治紧张局势均指向政府和社会的崩溃。

breed.en: The Amazon wetland system, fed by the Amazon River, is a crucial place for pink dolphins to breed .
breed.cn: 亚马逊湿地系统由亚马逊河提供水源，对粉红海豚的繁殖至关重要。

breeze.en: If you understand the material and have the ability to articulate your thoughts, they should be a breeze .
breeze.cn: 如果你理解材料并且有能力表达出你的想法，考试就是轻而易举的事。

broaden.en: As communities diversified, mutual support could have broadened to include individuals not linked by blood.
broaden.cn: 随着社会日趋多元，互助合作的范围可能逐渐扩展至没有血缘关系的个体。
broaden.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

brutal.en: But for the Saharan silver ant, crawling from their underground nests into the sun's brutal rays to hunt for food, this is the perfect time to seek lunch.
brutal.cn: 但对于撒哈拉银蚁来说，从它们的地下巢穴爬到烈日下搜寻食物，这是寻找午餐的最佳时机。

bubble.en: Each of these bubbles applies to a different set of people.
bubble.cn: 这些气泡的大小各异，对应于不同的人际关系。
bubble.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

bucket.en: buckets on the market were mainly for tradesmen and factory workers.
bucket.cn: 市场上出售的水桶主要面向商贩和工厂工人。

budget.en: The board of Denver public schools is set to close several elementary and middle schools to make up for a decreased budget caused by declining enrollment.
budget.cn: 丹佛公立学校董事会计划关闭几所小学和初中，以弥补因入学人数下降而导致的预算减少。

bug.en: But in the rare chance that there is a micro-organism that can make you sick on the exact spot where the food dropped, you can be fairly sure that the bug is on the food you are about to put in your mouth.
bug.cn: 但是，万一食物掉落的地方恰好有能使人生病的微生物，那么你几乎可以肯定，这种微生物也存在于你即将放入口中的食物上。

bulb.en: The staff believe he squeezed himself out of a gap located around new energy saving bulbs installed inside the snake house.
bulb.cn: 工作人员认为这条蛇是从蛇舍内新安装的节能灯周围的一个缝隙挤出来的。

bulk.en: The literature has not yet settled on an amount or type of exercise that is going to be key, although the bulk of literature has suggested that aerobic exercise is what you need to be doing," he said.
bulk.cn: 文献尚未就关键的运动量或类型达成一致，尽管许多文献建议有氧运动是必要的，他表示。

bullet.en: However, aquaculture is no silver bullet.
bullet.cn: 然而，水产养殖业并不是灵丹妙药。
bullet.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

bulletin.en: By reading the Bulletin of Information.

bump.en: But now wage growth is slowing down for everyone, and job switchers are getting smaller wage bumps in their new jobs.
bump.cn: 但现在，所有人的工资增长都在放缓，跳槽者在新岗位上获得的加薪也在减少。

bundle.en: Bundles containing thousands of pounds in cash keep turning up on the streets of Blackhall Colliery in northern England, according to police.
bundle.cn: 据警方称，英格兰北部布莱克霍尔煤矿的街道上不断出现装有数千英镑现金的包裹。
bundle.source: 2022年12月大学英语四级考试真题（第二套）

burden.en: But for some parents, the school's restrictions are an unnecessary burden .
burden.cn: 但对一些家长而言,学校的这些限制是不必要的负担。

bureau.en: According to the Census Bureau, 38 million people in the U.S. are living below the official poverty thresholds.
bureau.cn: 据美国人口统计局调查，3800万美国人都生活在官方的贫困线之下。
bureau.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

burial.en: Local people have also carved out over two hundred caves in the soft rock, and use them for everything from sacred burial places to food storage.
burial.cn: 当地居民还在柔软的岩石中开凿了两百多个洞穴，并将其用于各种用途，从神圣的墓地到食物储存。

burst.en: We do work that gives us bursts of joy each new day.
burst.cn: 我们从事的工作每天都能给我们带来满满的快乐。
burst.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

bypass.en: The bypass hailed a new era in motor travel and was greeted with excitement and optimism.
bypass.cn: 这条绕城公路的开通标志着汽车旅行新时代的到来，人们对此感到兴奋和乐观。

cabin.en: It can be seen from the cheapest budget airlines to the world's largest carriers: Airlines across the globe integrate various shades of blue in their cabin seats, and it is no coincidence.
cabin.cn: 从最便宜的廉价航空公司到世界上最大的航空运输公司，我们都可以看出：全球各地的航空公司都在其机舱座位上融入了深浅不一的蓝色，但这并非是巧合。

cabinet.en: They are fond of sleeping in cabinets .

cable.en: But even back then, a minority of people perhaps 20% — were lifelong heavy readers, and it was cable TV, not the internet, that struck a blow at that culture in the 1980s.
cable.cn: 但即便在那时，终生沉浸在书海的人也只占了少数（20%）。并且在20世纪80年代对这种阅读文化造成了冲击的不是互联网，而是有线电视。

calculation.en: What can we conclude from the author's calculations ?
calculation.cn: 我们能从作者的计算中得出什么结论？

calculator.en: According to the Bank of England's inflation calculator, 200 pounds in 1921 would be worth 7,750 pounds today.
calculator.cn: 根据英格兰银行的通胀计算器，1921年的200英镑在今天价值7,750英镑。
calculator.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

calendar.en: Catherine Ritman Smith, head of learning at the Design Museum, is expecting around 10,000 participants aged 13 to 16 to take part this year and says that the project—funded by Deutsche Bank as part of its youth engagement programme Born To Be—is the biggest event in the museum's calendar .
calendar.cn: 设计博物馆学习部主管凯瑟琳·里特曼·史密斯预计，今年将有约1万名13至16岁的青少年参与这一活动，她表示，这个由德意志银行通过其青年参与计划"天生如此"资助的项目是博物馆年度最大规模的活动。

calorie.en: The study found that when people ate a highly processed diet, they consumed about five hundred more calories per day than they did when they ate a less processed diet.
calorie.cn: 研究发现，当人们食用高度加工的饮食时，每天的热量摄入比食用较少加工饮食时多出约500卡路里。

campus.en: I've been thinking about moving off campus next semester.
campus.cn: 我在考虑下学期搬出校园住。
campus.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

canal.en: Hello, Benjamin, Dan and I will be going for a run along the canal Saturday morning.
canal.cn: 你好本杰明，周六上午丹和我计划一起去运河边跑步。

cancel.en: Often, the school remains officially open even though buses do not run and classes are canceled .
cancel.cn: 即使校车停运且课程取消，学校通常仍然正式开放。

cancer.en: But poor diet and physical inactivity also each increase the risk of heart disease and have a role to play in the development of some cancers.
cancer.cn: 然而，不良的饮食习惯以及缺乏运动也会增加患心脏病的风险，并且会对癌症的形成产生作用。
cancer.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（一）

candidate.en: And when they asked over-45 candidates about their attitudes, they found that “those who are excited by training are unemployed for less time, receive more job offers, and are more satisfied by the job offers they receive.”
candidate.cn: 当他们询问45岁以上求职者的态度时发现，"那些对培训充满热情的人失业时间更短，获得的工作机会更多，对所获得的工作机会也更加满意。"

capable.en: But research does show that kids are very capable of training dogs.
capable.cn: 但研究确实显示，孩子们完全有能力训练狗狗。

capacity.en: Our capacity to speak, write and learn new vocabulary does not seem to deteriorate with age.
capacity.cn: 我们说话、写作和学习新词汇的能力似乎并不会随着年龄的增长而衰退。
capacity.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

capture.en: At some point, humans began to capture and hold animals.
capture.cn: 在历史的某个阶段，人类开始捕获并饲养动物。

cargo.en: Police said the eggs came from a freighter that lost part of its cargo during an unusual storm, the worst to hit Germany's northeastern coast since 2006.
cargo.cn: 警方称，这些鸡蛋来自一艘货轮，该货轮在一次异常风暴中损失了部分货物，这是自 2006 年以来袭击德国东北海岸的最严重风暴。

carrier.en: "When they see that carrier back out on the street," Swigart said, "that's the first sign to them that life is starting to return to normal."
carrier.cn: 斯维格特说：“当他们看到搬运工重新出现在街道上，这就是人们回归正常生活的首个标志。”

cart.en: Fifteen minutes and a few clicks later, with more than $350 worth of dolls in her cart , Kate placed the order and ran off to play.
cart.cn: 15分钟后，点击几下鼠标，凯特在购物车里放了价值超过350美元的娃娃，下了订单，然后跑去玩了。

cartoon.en: There's a Bobo man cartoon popular amongst young children you see, and this toy is the lead character from the show.
cartoon.cn: 你知道，现在小朋友中很流行一个波波人卡通，这个玩具就是节目中的主角。
cartoon.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

cashier.en: When you visit the grocery store, you might draw conclusions about the cashier who checks you out.
cashier.cn: 当你去杂货店购物时，你可能会对为你结账的收银员做出一些判断。

cast.en: When night falls, red and blue and other colors cast a hazy glow over a city lit up by tens of thousands of neon signs.
cast.cn: 当夜幕降临，成千上万个霓虹灯招牌点亮时发出来的红色、蓝色以及其他颜色将城市上空蒙上一层朦胧的光芒。

casual.en: On the other hand, a casual dress helps us become more friendly and creative.
casual.cn: 相反，休闲装扮能让我们变得更加友善和富有创造力。

catalog.en: They can apply for fully funded access to Coursera's course catalog , which means they can take all of the platform's classes and obtain professional certificates for free.
catalog.cn: 他们可以申请全额资助访问Coursera的课程目录，这意味着他们可以免费参加该平台的所有课程并获得专业证书。

category.en: The overall trend is hitting Americans of all different levels of educational attainment, although the percentages vary by category.
category.cn: 这一总体趋势影响着各个教育水平的美国人，尽管不同群体的比例有所差异。
category.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

cautious.en: On the other hand, scientists at the USDA who I've spoken with are much more cautious.
cautious.cn: 然而，我所接触的美国农业部科学家们对此则显得更为谨慎。
cautious.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

cease.en: They may cease to exist as a result of enjoying too good a life.
cease.cn: 他们可能会因为生活过于优渥而走向消亡。
cease.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

cement.en: Just imagine building a house without cement or nails to hold together.
cement.cn: 试想一下，如果没有水泥和钉子来固定房屋，该如何建造呢？

cereal.en: An average person consumes 144 pints of milk a year, but 40% of that is poured onto cereal.
cereal.cn: 一个普通人一年消耗144品脱牛奶，但是40%的牛奶都被倒在了麦片上。
cereal.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

certainty.en: “One explanation for this finding is that possible awards may be more emotionally provoking than certainty awards,” says Reimann.
certainty.cn: 赖曼说：“这一发现的一种解释是，可能的奖励也许要比确定的奖励更能从情感上激发人们。”

certificate.en: Social isolation and loneliness were determined with questionnaires; the researchers depended on medical records and death certificates for determining coronary events and strokes.
certificate.cn: 社交孤立和孤独感是通过问卷调查来确定的；同时研究人员依靠医疗记录和死亡证明来确定冠状动脉事件和中风。

challenge.en: This little story turns out to be a fascinating glimpse at the challenges cities face as they try to update their urban infrastructure — to clean up the air, reduce greenhouse emissions, and speed up travel by making towns more bike-friendly.
challenge.cn: 这个小故事为我们提供了一个引人入胜的视角，让我们看到城市在升级基础设施时面临的挑战——净化空气、减少温室气体排放、通过打造更友好的骑行环境来提升出行效率。
challenge.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

champion.en: Many have become national chess champions.
champion.cn: 许多人已成为全国国际象棋冠军。
champion.source: 2019年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

change.en: Penguins are sensitive indicators of changes in marine ecosystems.
change.cn: 企鹅是海洋生态系统变化的敏感指示器。
change.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（二）

character.en: The principal characters in his movies were often ordinary people caught in unwanted and unavoidable situations.
character.cn: 他电影中的主角通常是卷入意外且无法逃脱困境的普通人。
character.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

characteristic.en: This characteristic is particularly apparent in a new study, focusing on people who underwent a hemispherectomy, a surgical procedure in which half of the brain is removed to treat illness.
characteristic.cn: 这一特性在一项新研究中表现得尤为明显，该研究关注了接受半脑切除术的患者，这是一种通过切除半个大脑来治疗疾病的手术。

characterize.en: What characterizes Japanese and Chinese foods?
characterize.cn: 日本和中国食物的特点是什么？
characterize.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

charity.cn: 所有收益都用于慈善事业。

charm.en: The streets are narrow but beautiful with plenty of charm.
charm.cn: 街道虽然狭窄，却别有一番美丽与韵味。
charm.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

charter.en: When University of California-Berkeley released a study this month showing alarmingly high teacher turnover rates at Los Angeles charter schools, I wasn’t surprised.
charter.cn: 当加州大学伯克利分校本月公布一项研究，提到洛杉矶特许学校的教师流动率高得惊人时，我并不感到惊讶。

chase.en: You’re cold, but your heart is racing as if a killer just chased you down a dark street.
chase.cn: 你感觉很冷，但你的心在狂跳，就像刚刚被一个杀手在漆黑的街道上追赶。

cheat.en: Over five experiments researchers gave participants tasks in which they could cheat.
cheat.cn: 在五个实验中，研究人员给参与者布置了他们可以作弊的任务。
cheat.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

cherish.en: People don't cherish it until they lose it.
cherish.cn: 人们直到失去才珍惜它。

chief.en: What is the chief reason for college-educated workers delaying retirement according to an economist?
chief.cn: 经济学家认为，受过大学教育的劳动者推迟退休的主要原因是什么？

chill.en: Trains, planes and ferries are also likely to be affected, with a wind chill that could see parts of Britain feeling as cold as -15℃.

christian.cn: 这一传统可以追溯到公元前300年，后来被纳入基督教教会。

circuit.en: In short, our brain evolved circuits to allow us to experience sympathy, which in turn made civilization, and an ethics based on sympathy, possible.
circuit.cn: 简而言之，我们的大脑进化出了能够让我们体验同情心的回路，而同情心反过来又使文明以及基于同情心的伦理成为可能。

circular.en: Teara used to be a chef at the Langham in Auckland and so dinner, eaten around a huge circular table (made of one of the most ancient trees in the world), was every bit as mouth-watering as you'd expect.
circular.cn: Teara曾在奥克兰的朗廷酒店担任主厨，因此晚餐在一个由世界上最古老的树木之一制成的大圆桌旁享用，味道绝佳，正如你所期待的那样。

circulate.en: They don't want their photos to be circulated on the Internet.
circulate.cn: 他们不希望自己的照片在互联网上流传。

circulation.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

circumstance.en: They think that all of their successes are not a product of their skill or hard work, instead they attribute their own successes to external circumstances, for example, to luck and chance, or believe that their performance is massively overestimated by others.
circumstance.cn: 他们认为他们所有的成功都不是自己能力或努力的结果，相反，他们将自己的成功归因于外部因素，例如运气和偶然，或相信他人对他们的表现评价过高。

cite.en: Well, the expert on the show did cite research supporting her recommendations, so I guess I'll give it a try next time I fly a long distance.

civil.en: The American Civil Liberties Union has stated that digital assistants create a threat to privacy from hackers.
civil.cn: 美国公民自由联盟表示，数字助理带来了黑客对隐私的威胁。

civilian.en: opinions differ as to whether civilian scientists should be allowed to use military technology
civilian.cn: 对于是否应该允许民用科学家使用军事技术，各方意见不一。

claim.en: Claim to have confidence in their own abilities.
claim.cn: 自称对自己的能力充满信心。

clap.en: The phenomenon happens when thunder and lightning mix with a heavy snowstorm, sometimes causing loud claps that can be confused with explosions.
clap.cn: 这种现象是由雷电与暴风雪交织而成，有时会伴随着巨大的响声，容易被误认为爆炸。这种罕见的天气现象在苏格兰被称为"雷雪"。

clash.en: This means that they strive to implement the golden rule whenever possible, as long as it doesn't clash with a more important concept.
clash.cn: 这意味着他们会尽可能努力贯彻黄金法则，只要它不会和更重要的概念发生冲突。

classical.en: With the rise of pop music, jazz, and electronic music, both opera and classical music started to fade away from the public eye.
classical.cn: 随着流行音乐、爵士乐和电子音乐的兴起，歌剧和古典音乐逐渐淡出了公众视野。

classification.en: Despite the classification , there are more complex factors such as relational closeness, gender, age, and context that can affect how someone views physical contact.
classification.cn: 尽管有此分类，但还存在许多更加复杂的因素，比如关系亲密度、性别、年龄、情境等，这些都可以影响一个人对身体接触的看法。

classify.en: This type of snake is classified as a threat to humans, especially small children as well as pets.
classify.cn: 这种蛇被认为对人类构成威胁,尤其是对幼童和宠物。

client.en: But it will not prepare you for actual challenges you'll face with clients' work.
client.cn: 但它无法让你为客户工作中将要面对的实际挑战做好准备。

cliff.en: Erosion of the white cliffs along the south coast of England has always been a problem but it has become more serious in recent years.
cliff.cn: 英格兰南部海岸白色悬崖的侵蚀一直是个问题，但近年来情况变得更加严重。

cling.en: Whether it's a decision-making session, a basketball game, or a family outing, they can't help grabbing the lead dog position and clinging on to it for dear life.
cling.cn: 不管是决策时间，篮球赛，还是家庭出游，他们都忍不住要霸占领导的位置一辈子都不放手。

clip.en: In another study, researchers asked volunteers to jog for 30 minutes and then showed them clips from a sad movie.
clip.cn: 在另一项研究中，研究人员要求志愿者慢跑30分钟，然后向他们展示了一部伤感电影的片段。

clue.en: And where exactly should you look for these culture clues ?
clue.cn: 你具体应该在哪里寻找这些文化线索呢？

coach.en: Recruiting coaches for hot yoga and advanced spinning.
coach.cn: 招聘高温瑜伽和高级动感单车教练。

coin.en: The word "serendipity" was coined by Horace Walpole in an 1854 letter...
coin.cn: “serendipity（机缘巧合）”一词是霍勒斯·沃波尔在1854年写的一封信中创造的……

collaborate.en: I'll need to collaborate with my co-workers, and I'm very aware of just how important others are for my success at work.
collaborate.cn: 我需要与同事合作，也深知他人对我职业发展的重要性。

collapse.en: Because of the collapse of the three-story building.
collapse.cn: 因为那栋三层楼房倒塌了。
collapse.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

collection.en: The primitive tools early humans used tell a lot about their life, but my favorite is the coin collection .
collection.cn: 早期人类使用的原始工具能揭示他们生活的许多信息，但我最喜欢的还是钱币收藏。

collective.en: It serves individual interest rather than a collective 's.
collective.cn: 它服务于个人利益，而非集体利益。

colonial.en: I love the colonial fabrics, all the silver work, the furnishings, the combination of elegance and simplicity.
colonial.cn: 我喜欢殖民时期的布料、所有的银器、家具，以及优雅与简约的结合。
colonial.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

colony.en: Live in colonies that number in the tens of thousands to the hundreds of thousands, and reproduce quickly.
colony.cn: 它们生活在数量达数万至数十万的群体中，并且繁殖速度很快。

combat.en: ABTA says it is trying to combat the issue by running public awareness campaigns.
combat.cn: 英国旅行社协会表示，它正通过开展公众意识运动来对这一问题进行斗争。

combination.en: In addition to people being healthier and living much longer, economists say that a combination of financial considerations such as years of slow rise in real wages and a shift away from traditional pensions in the private sector are some of the reasons people delay retirement.
combination.cn: 除了人们更加健康、寿命更长之外，经济学家指出，实际工资多年增长缓慢、私营部门传统养老金制度的转变等一系列经济因素，也是人们推迟退休的部分原因。

combine.en: The gaming industry is larger than films and music combined , yet few of us are likely to list our achievements in playing computer games as work experience in our résumé.
combine.cn: 游戏产业的规模已超过电影和音乐产业的总和，但我们当中很少有人会在简历中把玩电脑游戏的成就列为工作经验。

comedy.en: It's a charity comedy night with lots of different acts.
comedy.cn: 这是个慈善喜剧之夜，有很多不同的表演。
comedy.source: 2018年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

command.en: In 1976, the company commanded 90% of the market for photographic film and 85% of the market for cameras.
command.cn: 1976年，公司拥有90%的摄影胶卷市场和85%的相机市场。

commerce.en: They are forced to use e- commerce strategies.
commerce.cn: 他们被迫采用电子商务策略。

commercial.en: "One of the really useful things about this competition,” says Hourican, "is that there's a commercial element because the product is going on sale for real and the boys had to learn about budgeting and marketing, as well as designing their game.”
commercial.cn: "这项比赛真正有价值的一点，"霍里肯说，"是它包含了商业要素，因为产品将会真正投入销售，男孩们必须学习预算和营销知识，同时还要设计他们的游戏。"

commission.en: Back in June, the Federal Communications Commission fined AT&T $100 million over that the carrier secretly reduced wireless speeds after customers consumed a certain amount of.
commission.cn: 早在六月份，联邦通信委员会就对 AT&T 处以 1 亿美元的罚款，原因是该运营商在用户消耗一定量的流量后秘密降低了无线速度。
commission.source: 2017年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

commit.en: They may commit more errors than ever before.
commit.cn: 他们可能会犯比以往任何时候都多的错误。

committee.en: Goto, however, has accepted the International Olympic Committee ’s offer of a replacement, according to Japanese media reports.
committee.cn: 然而，据日本媒体报道，后藤已经接受了国际奥委会提出的替补人选。

commodity.en: Manufacturing costs come into effect, and commodities fluctuate in price based on demand and the distance to haul the commodity.
commodity.cn: 制造成本会产生影响，而商品价格则根据需求和运输距离而波动。
commodity.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

commonplace.en: Even the most commonplace activities, such as calling Telstra or picking up a parcel from Australia Post, are followed by texts or emails with surveys asking, "How did we do?"
commonplace.cn: 即使是最普通的活动，例如打电话给澳洲电信或从澳大利亚邮政领取包裹，后续也会收到带有调查问卷的短信或电子邮件，询问“我们做得如何？”

communicate.en: The two professors hope to refute that idea, claiming that just as when kids walk themselves through a process, adults can benefit from using language not just to communicate, but also to help "augment thinking".
communicate.cn: 两位教授希望能驳倒上述观点，他们声称，正如孩子们得经历一个过程才能学会走路一样，大人们能够从使用语言中获益，不仅只是用于沟通，还能帮助他们“增强思考能力”。

company.en: So the company teamed up with Wisconsin-based rancher Northstar Bison.

comparable.en: One straightforward reason close losers might outperform narrow winners is that the two groups have comparable ability.

compatible.cn: 但最终，我们会找到那些欣赏真实自我的灵魂伴侣。

compel.en: Using visual aids to back up your ideas can help communicate your ideas better and make compelling arguments so your listeners will come to a logical choice and become fully committed to your ideas and plans.
compel.cn: 使用视觉辅助工具来支持你的想法，可以更好地传达你的想法，并提出令人信服的论点，从而使你的听众做出合乎逻辑的选择，并完全接受你的想法和计划。

compensation.cn: 粗略的计算表明，员工居家办公时雇主省下的开支与员工在家设置办公空间应得的补偿价值相当。

compete.cn: 许多消费者表示，在考虑购买时会货比三家，比较多个竞争品牌和价格。

competent.en: Studies have shown that people who appear to be wealthy tend to be considered more intelligent, disciplined, and competent than those who do not.
competent.cn: 研究表明，外表富有的人通常被认为比不富有的人更聪明、更自律、更有能力。

competition.en: Simply put, when most individuals stay away from risk, it means less competition for risk-takers.

competitive.en: To enable the district to remain competitive .

competitor.en: Posting about luxury purchases and expensive vacations online may help you to persuade others and frighten competitors , but it could also signal to potential friends or future employers that you are unlikely to think about the needs of others.
competitor.cn: 在网上发布奢侈品购买和豪华度假的内容可能有助于说服他人或震慑竞争对手，但也可能向潜在朋友或未来雇主传递信号：你不太可能考虑他人的需求。

complaint.en: To discourage them from making complaints .
complaint.cn: 为了阻止他们提出投诉。

completion.en: The completion of the baking task.

complex.en: New findings suggest that the kinds of complex and strategic self-presentation behaviour we see in adults appear at a much younger age than previously known.

complexity.cn: 展现人类与动物之间复杂互动的关系。

complicated.en: However, nightmares are complicated, and researchers are still struggling to understand them, said Dr. Rachel Salas, an expert on sleep disorders and an associate professor at Johns Hopkins Medicine in Baltimore.
complicated.cn: 然而，噩梦复杂难懂，研究人员仍在努力了解它们，巴尔的摩约翰·霍普金斯医学院的睡眠障碍专家兼副教授雷切尔·萨拉斯博士如是说。

complication.en: She said the elephant's birth went smoothly and that there were no complications .
complication.cn: 她说，小象的出生过程很顺利，没有出现任何并发症状。

comply.en: They tell patients to comply with the directions of drug manufacturers.
comply.cn: 他们告诉患者要遵照药品生产商的指示。
comply.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

component.en: The researchers explain that the possible reason for this may partly have been the lack of the other components found in whole fruit, like fibre.
component.cn: 研究人员解释说，造成这种情况的可能原因部分是因为缺少了完整水果中的其他成分，比如膳食纤维。

compose.en: Many four-and five-year-olds who have been shown a few letters and taught their sounds will compose single words of their own with them even before they have been taught to read.
compose.cn: 许多四五岁的孩子，在学习阅读之前，只要接触过一些字母并学会发音，就能用这些字母组成自己的单词。

composer.en: Factual writing provides background information on an author, composer or artist, or on a type of music, literature or art.
composer.cn: 事实性写作提供有关作者、作曲家或艺术家，或某种音乐、文学或艺术类型的背景信息。

compound.en: We consume compounds every day that may be poisonous and our bodies do a wonderful job of removing and eliminating anything harmful from our bodies.
compound.cn: 我们每天都会摄入可能有毒的物质，而我们的身体在清除和排出任何有害物质方面做得非常出色。

comprehend.en: Our eyesight may dim and our recall may weaken, but, by comparison, our ability to produce and to comprehend language is well preserved into older adulthood.
comprehend.cn: 虽然我们的视力可能会变差，记忆力也可能会减退，但相比之下，我们产生和理解语言的能力在步入老年后仍能保持得相当好。

comprehensive.en: It's also important to understand your role thoroughly to gain a comprehensive picture of your job.

comprise.cn: 岛上的警察由一对夫妻组成，还有一名邮递员。

compromise.en: Most of the time, though, the most popular compromise is to hyphenate your last name and the last name of your groom.
compromise.cn: 不过，大多数时候，最流行的折衷办法是用连字符连接你和新郎的姓。

concentrate.en: Concentrate on reading articles recommended by experts.

concentration.en: I genuinely find it odd, for if you nap properly, it’s like waking up from a full night’s sleep and you can double your day’s worth of concentration .
concentration.cn: 我真的觉得这很奇怪，因为如果小睡质量很高，就像从一整夜的睡眠中醒来一样，你可以让你一天的注意力加倍。

concerning.cn: 由于联邦立法尚未出台，美国一些州已经通过了有关带薪家庭假的法律。

conclude.cn: 研究的作者总结道，男性和女性在育儿和家务上花费时间的差异并不意味着他们感到不满。

condemn.en: It is condemned as a crazy idea.

conduct.en: To find out, business researchers at TUM and Erasmus University Rotterdam conducted 11 studies and surveys with over 2,000 persons from several countries.

conference.en: Their chips are great, but their service takes a long time, and I need to get back by 2:30 for a conference call.

confidence.en: Claim to have confidence in their own abilities.
confidence.cn: 自称对自己的能力充满信心。
