crisis.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

critic.en: But critics say the policy contradicts recommendations by many health experts, who warned that a person's weight is influenced by genetic and environmental factors.
critic.cn: 但批评者表示，这一政策与很多健康专家的建议相矛盾，这些专家警示，一个人的体重受基因和环境因素影响。
critic.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

critical.en: The findings showed that, despite missing half of this critical organ, participants could function well.
critical.cn: 研究发现，尽管失去了这一关键器官的一半，参与者仍能正常运作。

criticism.en: NetEase House, a restaurant in America, has been hit with criticism after announcing on its website that children under the age of ten are no longer welcome.
criticism.cn: 美国一家名为NetEase House的餐厅在其网站上宣布不再欢迎十岁以下儿童后，遭到了公众批评。

criticize.en: The ads criticized the measure, characterizing it as a "grocery tax".
criticize.cn: 广告批评了这项措施，把它形容为“食品杂货税”。
criticize.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

crown.en: In the current listless economy, every generation has a claim to having been most injured. But the Labor Department's latest jobs reports and other recent data present a strong case for crowning baby boomers as the greatest victims of the recession and its dreadful consequences.
crown.cn: 在当前低迷的经济形势下，每一代人都声称自己受到的冲击最大。但劳工部最新的就业报告和其他近期数据有力地表明，婴儿潮一代才是此次经济衰退及其可怕后果的最大受害者。

crucial.en: Medical literature has not concluded as to what exercise or how much exercise is crucial , although it generally agrees that people should do aerobic exercise.
crucial.cn: 医学文献尚未对何种运动或运动量是关键作出结论，尽管普遍认为人们应进行有氧运动。

cruelty.en: Along with this effort, we’re working with animal advocates and state and federal lawmakers to strengthen anti-cruelty laws across the country, as well as supporting laws and policies that assist overburdened animal shelters that care for animal fighting victims.
cruelty.cn: 除了这一努力，我们正与动物保护倡导者以及州和联邦法律制定者一起，在全国范围内加强实施反虐待法以及配套法律、政策，这些配套法律及政策旨在为负担过重的、为照顾角斗动物受害者而设的动物收容所提供帮助。
cruelty.source: 2016年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

cruise.en: Just beyond St. Mark's Square, a cruise ship passes, one of hundreds every year that appear over their medieval surroundings.
cruise.cn: 就在圣马可广场的外围，一艘游轮驶过，每年都有数百艘游轮出现在威尼斯这个中世纪的环境中，这才只是其中一艘。

crystal.en: For example, we have quartz crystal clocks and watches accurate to within one minute a year.
crystal.cn: 例如，我们的石英水晶钟表，年误差在一分钟以内。
crystal.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

cue.en: Even simple visual cues , like plate size and lighting, have been shown to affect portion size and consumption.
cue.cn: 即便是简单的视觉因素，比如盘子大小和灯光，也被证明能影响摄取的食物的量。

cultivate.cn: 合作行为可以通过培养获得。
cultivate.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

curb.en: It is obvious that solutions must be found to curb the fast worsening environment and social acceleration.
curb.cn: 很明显，必须找到解决方法来阻止环境急剧恶化和社会加速现象。
curb.source: 2020年12月大学英语六级考试真题

curiosity.en: Openness—a characteristic defined by curiosity and a desire for knowledge—may also help folks pass brain tests.
curiosity.cn: 开放性——这种以好奇心和求知欲定义的特质——也有助于人们通过大脑测试。
curiosity.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

curl.en: Just five one-hundredths of an inch thick, light golden in color and with a perfect "saddle curl ," the Lay's potato chip seems an unlikely weapon for global domination.
curl.cn: 乐事薯片只有五分之一英寸厚，呈浅金色，并带有完美的“马鞍卷”，看起来不太可能成为称霸全球的武器。

currency.en: Our main challenge is that our national currency is rising, and we're losing competitive advantages to stone producers in India.
currency.cn: 我们面临的主要挑战是本国货币升值，导致我们在与印度石材生产商的竞争中失去优势。

curse.en: Outer beauty can be as much of a curse as a blessing.
curse.cn: 外在美丽既可能是祝福，也可能是诅咒。
curse.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

curve.en: Once you get beyond the initial learning curve, knitting and crocheting can lower heart rate and blood pressure.
curve.cn: 一旦克服了最初的学习曲线，编织和钩针就能降低心率和血压。
curve.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

customary.en: Once upon a time, it was just customary for a bride to take her groom's last name as her own and abandon her maiden name completely.
customary.cn: 从前，新娘把姓氏改为新郎的，完全放弃她的娘家姓，这是一种习俗。

dairy.en: And in the UK, dairy consumption overall has fallen by a third in the past 20 years.
dairy.cn: 在过去20年里，英国的乳制品消费总量下降了三分之一。
dairy.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

damn.en: In light of Hershfield's study, one simple question arises: Is it possible to make our present selves give a damn about our future selves?
damn.cn: 根据赫什菲尔德的研究，我们提出了一个简单的问题：我们是否有可能让现在的自己关心未来的自己？

daylight.en: Around the world, people changed sleep patterns thanks to the start or end of daylight savings time.
daylight.cn: 由于夏令时的开始或结束，全世界的人们改变了睡眠模式。
daylight.source: 2015年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

deadly.en: A deadly snake, which had finally been tracked down after escaping a zoo has slipped away for the second time.
deadly.cn: 一条致命毒蛇之前从动物园逃脱后最终被成功追踪到，结果它又一次逃跑了。

dealer.en: For the past four decades, the leader of Formula One car racing, one of the biggest annual sporting series in the world, was Bernie Ecclestone, a former motorcycle parts dealer who built it into an international presence essentially on his own.
dealer.cn: 在过去的40年里，世界上最大的年度体育系列赛之一，一级方程式赛车的领导者是伯尼·埃克尔斯通，他曾是一名摩托车零部件经销商，他基本上是靠自己把一级方程式赛车打造成了一个国际品牌。

dean.en: Following the Harvard scandal, Mary Miller, the former dean of students at Yale, made an impassioned appeal to her school's professors to refrain from take-home exams.
dean.cn: 继哈佛大学的丑闻之后，耶鲁大学的前教导主任玛丽·米勒向学校的教授们发出了强烈的呼吁，要求他们不要安排可以带回家的考试。

debt.en: "We know that there are impacts and it's heartbreaking and difficult work, but in order for the district to stay out of debt , it's a step that needs to be taken," he said.
debt.cn: “我们知道这会带来影响，这是一个令人心碎且艰难的决定，但为了让学区不陷入债务，这是必需采取的一步。”他说。

decade.en: If this doesn't encourage you to squeeze in a workout today, nothing will: a new study from Sweden shows that women who were highly fit in mid-life were nearly 90% less likely to get dementia decades later.
decade.cn: 如果这还不能促使你今天抽空去锻炼，那就没什么能打动你了：一项来自瑞典的新研究显示，中年时期体能极佳的女性，数十年后患痴呆的风险几乎降低了90%。

decay.en: Last month one chief executive of a water bottling company said that bans would "result in greater consumption of sugary drinks, adding to all the health dangers of obesity, diabetes and tooth decay ".
decay.cn: 上个月，一家瓶装水公司的首席执行官表示，禁令将“导致含糖饮料的消费量增加，加剧肥胖、糖尿病和蛀牙等所有健康风险”。

deceive.en: My advice is that you not pay attention to the number of steps and ingredients, because they can be deceiving .
deceive.cn: 我的建议是你无须过分关注烹饪步骤以及食材，因为它们可能会误导你。

decent.en: Don't take many English courses; they won't help you get a decent job.
decent.cn: 不要选修太多英语课程；它们对你找到一份体面的工作没有帮助。

decisive.en: Personality plays a decisive role in how healthy one is.
decisive.cn: 性格对一个人的健康程度起决定性作用。
decisive.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

deck.en: And he found an old gold coin, some $100 bills and a silver wedding ring while replacing the deck .
deck.cn: 在更换露台时，他发现了一枚旧金币，大约100美元的钞票和一枚银质婚戒。

decline.en: Instead of continuing to decline, the duration of the working week remained stable.
decline.cn: 然而，每周工作时间并未继续减少，而是保持了稳定。
decline.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

decorate.en: She decorated it with colorful stickers.
decorate.cn: 她用彩色贴纸装饰了它。
decorate.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

decorative.en: Building a neon sign is an art practiced by professionals trained on the job to mold glass tubes into decorative shapes and letters.
decorative.cn: 制作霓虹灯招牌是一门技术，它是由经过在岗培训的专业人员将玻璃管烧制成装饰性的图案或文字的过程。
decorative.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

deem.en: She doesn't deem homemade soup tasty.
deem.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

defeat.en: When these students gave the speech, their blood vessels contracted and their hearts pumped less blood through the body—both responses that the body shows when it is preparing for damage or defeat after a physical threat.
defeat.cn: 当这些学生发表演讲时，他们的血管收缩，心脏向身体输送的血液减少——这两种反应都是身体在受到物理威胁后准备遭受伤害或失败时的表现。

defect.en: I can understand some scars and physical defects can be ugly and distracting, but not Johnny's.
defect.cn: 我能理解某些疤痕和身体缺陷可能很难看，会让人分心，但Johnny的情况并非如此。
defect.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

deficiency.en: Many of us living in the most developed countries are buying into a myth of protein deficiency created by food companies and self-identified health experts.
deficiency.cn: 在发达国家，我们许多人都被食品公司和所谓的健康专家编造的"蛋白质缺乏"神话所误导。

define.en: Dementia, as defined in medical dictionaries, is a broad term that describes a loss of thinking ability, memory, attention, logical reasoning, and other mental abilities.
define.cn: 医学词典中定义的痴呆，是一个广泛的术语，用于描述思维能力、记忆力、注意力、逻辑推理和其他精神能力的丧失。

definite.en: Whether digitally interactive ones like Inkling actually take off or not remains to be seen, and we probably won't have a definite answer for the next few years.
definite.cn: 像 Inkling 这样的数字互动游戏能否真正流行起来还有待观察，而且在未来几年内我们可能都无法得到确切的答案。

definitely.en: Tariq said, not everyone has to like corn, but everyone should definitely try it, especially with butter.
definitely.cn: 塔里克表示，虽然不是每个人都必须喜欢玉米，但每个人都应该尝试一下，特别是涂上黄油的玉米。

definition.en: Opera, in its simplest definition , is telling a story using music as its form.
definition.cn: 歌剧最简单的定义就是用音乐形式讲述故事。

defy.en: The practice of throwing seed bombs to turn vacant plots of land green took off in 1970s New York, and has been revived by green-thumbed social media influencers who defy local US regulations in a war on ugly spots in cities.
defy.cn: 在1970年代的纽约，向空地投掷“种子炸弹”以让土地变绿的做法兴起，如今，这一行为被一些“园艺达人”型的社交媒体网红重新推广，他们无视美国当地的法规，发起了一场对城市丑陋角落的“绿色战争”。
defy.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

degree.en: After all, where else can you leave school with a decent degree — but without a lifetime of debt?
degree.cn: 毕竟，还有哪些地方能让你带着一个体面的学位离开学校——而不用背负终身债务呢？
degree.source: 2018年6月大学英语六级考试真题（三）

delegate.en: Leaders have to be able to delegate and manage resources wisely—including staff expertise.
delegate.cn: 领导者必须能够明智地委派任务和管理资源，包括员工的专业知识。

deliberate.en: It likely won't fully protect automakers against accusations of deliberate cheating.
deliberate.cn: 它可能无法完全保护汽车制造商免受故意作弊的指控。
deliberate.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

delicate.en: Another highlight was an hour-long walk to Kaitoke hot pools in the centre of the island, through wetlands and a forest, where we whiled away a good hour sitting in the pools shaded from the heat by layers of delicate umbrella-like plants.
delicate.cn: 另一个亮点是在岛中心的凯托克温泉进行一个小时的徒步旅行，穿过湿地和森林，我们在温泉中坐了一个小时，周围是层层叠叠如伞般的植物挡住暑气。

delivery.en: This led to a string of unexpected deliveries, and maybe a starring role in an advertisement campaign.
delivery.cn: 这导致了一连串意外的送餐，甚至可能让他在广告活动中担任主角。
delivery.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

democracy.en: Implicitly or explicitly, American fashion addressed a democracy, whereas traditional Paris-based fashion was prescriptive and imposed on women, willing or not.
democracy.cn: 含蓄也好，明确也罢，美国的时装注重民主，而以巴黎风格为基础的传统时装则是约定俗成的，是强加给女性的，不管她们愿意与否。
democracy.source: 2017年6月大学英语六级考试真题（二）

democratic.en: A Democratic member of the New Jersey legislature said he was bothered by the lack of curiosity, referring to the insufficiently inquiring attitude of an assistant to Governor Chris Christie who did not ask hard questions about the George Washington Bridge traffic scandal.
democratic.cn: “我长期以来一直对这种奇怪的缺乏好奇心感到困扰，”新泽西州议会的一位民主党议员在7月份说道，他指的是新泽西州州长克里斯·克里斯蒂的一位助理缺乏足够的探究精神，选择不就乔治·华盛顿大桥交通丑闻提出尖锐的问题。
democratic.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

demonstrate.en: This is the first trial that demonstrates that there is something about highly processed foods independent of those nutrients that causes people to overeat.
demonstrate.cn: 这次试验首次证明，高度加工食品本身有导致人们过度饮食的原因，而不仅仅是因为其营养成分。
demonstrate.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

dense.en: These are generally known as “phantom” traffic jams, in which dense traffic crawls to a halt for no apparent reason at all.
dense.cn: 这些通常被称为"幻影"交通堵塞，指的是密集的车流在没有明显原因的情况下突然停滞。

density.en: Bone density may not be one of the most exciting health benefits of walking, but it's an important one.
density.cn: 步行最令人兴奋的健康益处之一可能不是骨密度，但也很重要。

dental.en: In spite of our dental discomfort, it turns out there's a good reason our teeth are so sensitive.
dental.cn: 尽管我们会感到牙齿不适，但我们的牙齿很敏感是有充足理由的。
dental.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

deny.cn: 否认他们实际测量的智力。

depart.en: In critique, however, we are forced to depart , to give up the perfection we thought we had achieved for the chance of being even a little bit better.
depart.cn: 然而，在批评中，我们被迫远离和放弃我们自认为已经成就的完美而去争取精益求精的机会。

departure.en: What does the woman say she needs to do before departure ?
departure.cn: 这位女士说她出发前需要做什么？

dependent.en: But 64 percent of the young adults surveyed said parents financial support to children aged 25-34 is a bad thing, because it makes those kids dependent.
dependent.cn: 但是在调查中，64%的年轻人认为父母对25至34岁子女的财务支持是不利的，因为这种支持使他们变得不独立。
dependent.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

deposit.en: These microscopic layers of deposits containing bacteria are known as biofilms and they are found on most surfaces and objects.
deposit.cn: 这些含有细菌的微小沉积层被称为生物膜，它们存在于大多数表面和物体上。
deposit.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

depress.en: Kate was depressed at first, but then she sat with some girl patients and they opened up all the boxes together, laughing and playing.
depress.cn: 凯特起初很沮丧，但后来她和一些女病人坐在一起，她们一起打开了所有的盒子，欢笑玩耍。
depress.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 听力

depression.en: However, people who suffer from it show a higher vulnerability to depression.
depression.cn: 然而，患有这种现象的人对抑郁症更易感。
depression.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

deprive.en: Scientists have known that depriving adult mice of vision can increase the sensitivity of individual neurons in the part of the brain devoted to hearing.
deprive.cn: 科学家们早已发现，当成年小鼠失去视力后，其大脑中负责听觉的区域内的单个神经元会变得更加敏感。
deprive.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

deputy.en: Firefighters responded to the three-story building shortly after 1 P.M. for a reported structure fire, according to Norwalk Deputy Fire Chief Adam Markiewicz.
deputy.cn: 诺沃克副消防局长亚当·马尔凯维奇表示，消防员收到建筑失火讯息，于下午一点刚过不久抵达现场三层建筑。
deputy.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

derive.en: These top earners derive meaning from their jobs and work is an important part of how they think of themselves.
derive.cn: 这些高收入者从工作中找到了意义，而工作也是构成他们自我认知的重要因素。

descend.en: Other choices, in descending order of personalization, are; a real-time phone call, a voice-mail message, a handwritten note, a typewritten letter, and the most is email.
descend.cn: 其他选择按个性化程度降序排列为：实时电话、语音留言、手写便条、打印信件，而最个性化的是电子邮件。

descent.en: What could have been considered the beginning of a descent is now a potential turning point — the turning point you are most equipped to take full advantage of.
descent.cn: 原本被当成是开始走下坡路的时期，现在成了一个潜在的转折点——这是一个你已经做好准备，可以充分利用的转折点。
descent.source: 2017年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

description.en: Of course, that may sound like a description of every teenager on the planet.
description.cn: 当然，这听起来像是在描述地球上的每一位青少年。
description.source: 2016年12月大学英语六级考试真题（一）

desert.en: The road appears today to go nowhere, ending in the middle of the desert.
desert.cn: 如今看来，这条路哪儿也通不了，终点就是沙漠中央。

deserve.en: On the one hand, your family dinner table deserves only the best.
deserve.cn: 一方面，您家的餐桌应享有最好的品质。
deserve.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

desirable.en: It is neither desirable nor morally acceptable nor practical for this county to tolerate the signs of deprivation more commonly associated with the slums of Rio de Janiero.
desirable.cn: 对于这个国家来说，容忍贫困迹象既不可取，也不道德可接受，也不现实。这种贫困迹象更常与里约热内卢贫民窟联系在一起。

despair.en: He entirely abandoned himself to despair .

desperate.en: After six days of desperate searching, he was eventually found and placed in a supposedly secure area.
desperate.cn: 经过六天的紧张搜寻，他终于被找到并被安置在一个认为是安全的区域。
desperate.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

despite.en: However, there are people who are permanently plagued by a massive amount of self-doubt despite delivering a good performance.
despite.cn: 然而，也有一些人即使表现出色，仍长期被极度的自我怀疑所困扰。
despite.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

destination.en: But within a few years, Carey said, he plans to bring another to a destination American city, like New York, Los Angeles, Miami or Las Vegas.
destination.cn: 凯里说，但在几年内，他计划把（F1赛事）带到另一个美国目标城市，如纽约、洛杉矶、迈阿密或拉斯维加斯。
destination.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

destruction.en: Forest destruction in the developing world will quickly slow down.
destruction.cn: 发展中国家的森林破坏速度将迅速放缓。
destruction.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

destructive.en: Actually manufacturing tablets is environmentally destructive and dangerous to human health.
destructive.cn: 实际上，生产平板电脑会破坏环境，危害人类健康。

detail.en: Kind of, but more like knowing the details of the products and services that the company exists to deliver.
detail.cn: 有点类似，但更侧重于了解公司所提供的产品和服务的具体细节。
detail.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

detect.en: The opposite results of our study suggest coffee consumers acquire a taste for or an ability to detect the bitterness of caffeine due to the learned positive reinforcement brought out by caffeine.
detect.cn: “而我们得到的却是相反的结果：咖啡饮用者之所以会逐渐喜欢或更能辨别咖啡因的苦味，是由于咖啡因带来的习得性正向强化所致。
detect.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

detection.en: Evidence suggests that early detection and diagnosis of autism can help children take advantage of therapies …
detection.cn: 证据表明自闭症的早期发现和诊断有助于利用一些治疗方法帮助孩子治疗……

detective.en: Now comes the part when you put on your detective hat and do a little digging.
detective.cn: 现在来到了你需要带上侦探帽、去做一些调查的部分了。

determination.en: It is a strong determination that allows you to do something difficult.
determination.cn: 正是坚定的决心使你能够完成困难的事情。

determine.en: Their contribution to calorie consumption is hard to determine .
determine.cn: 他们对卡路里消耗的贡献难以确定。

devil.en: The fish, often known as Devil Firefish, is a highly invasive species.
devil.cn: 这种鱼经常被称为恶魔火鱼，是一种危害很大的入侵物种。
devil.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

devise.en: In order to devise effective policies to curb the environmental impact of the clothing industry, it is important to identify the source of the problem in the supply chain.
devise.cn: 要制定有效政策来减轻服装行业对环境的影响，关键在于找出供应链中问题的根源。

devote.en: On the other hand, advocates of organic farming argue yields and efficiency could be significantly improved if the food industry devoted as much research and money to organic farming as it does conventional agriculture.
devote.cn: 另一方面，有机农业的支持者认为，如果食品行业在有机农业上投入与传统农业相同的研究和资金，有机作物的产量和效率可能会显著提高。

devotion.en: "If you ask Japanese students to list the positive attributes they expect in a romantic partner, they rate highly things like loyalty, commitment and devotion," says O'Sullivan. "If you ask American college women, … in addition to being committed, partners have to be amusing, funny and a friend."
devotion.cn: “如果你让日本学生列举他们对伴侣期望的品德，他们赞许的是忠诚、承诺和奉献，”奥沙利文说，“如果你问美国女大学生同样的问题，……除了忠诚，伴侣还要幽默、有趣、能当朋友。“
devotion.source: 2013年6月大学英语四级考试真题（三）

diagnose.en: Jeff Anderson, associate professor in Radiology at the University of Utah and author on the study, says "In our society, the diagnoses of dementia are resources to the maximum.
diagnose.cn: 犹他大学放射学副教授、该研究的作者杰夫·安德森说：“在我们的社会里，痴呆症的诊断是资源的最大消耗。
diagnose.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

diameter.en: Many start off as part of larger plastic objects, which over time fragment into smaller and smaller pieces until they become tiny, 5 millimeters or less in diameter.
diameter.cn: 许多微塑料最初是较大塑料物体的一部分，随着时间的推移，它们会分解成越来越小的碎片，直径缩小至5毫米或更小。
diameter.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

dictate.en: Besides, the Emily Post Institute doesn't dictate manners.
dictate.cn: 此外，艾米莉·波斯特礼仪学院并不规定礼仪规范。

dictator.en: A skilled backroom operator who speaks without a filter, Ecclestone said often that in his opinion, the sport was at its best when he was allowed to act as 'Ca dictator .
dictator.cn: 埃克莱斯顿是一名技术娴熟的幕后经营者，他说话内容不经过滤，他经常说，在他看来，当他被允许扮演独裁者时，这项运动处于最佳状态。

differ.en: They differ in how much pesticide remains on them.
differ.cn: 两者的差异在于各自残留的农药量。
differ.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

diligent.en: Such a brilliant and diligent girl!
diligent.cn: 多么聪明勤奋的女孩啊！

dim.en: Our eyesight may dim and our recall may weaken, but, by comparison, our ability to produce and to comprehend language is well preserved into older adulthood.
dim.cn: 虽然我们的视力可能会变差，记忆力也可能会减退，但相比之下，我们产生和理解语言的能力在步入老年后仍能保持得相当好。

dimension.en: There's a social dimension to health that we've completely overlooked in our efforts to find the best and most cutting-edge medical care.
dimension.cn: 在我们努力寻找最好和最尖端的医疗保健时，我们完全忽略了"健康"尤其社会层面。

diplomatic.en: It suspended diplomatic relations with Libya.
diplomatic.cn: 它暂停了与利比亚的外交关系。

dirt.en: And they can also hide dirt and wear.
dirt.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

disappearance.en: The poisonous snake forced the closure of the attraction last week when staff noticed the disappearance .
disappearance.cn: 上周，当工作人员注意到这条毒蛇失踪时，景点被迫关闭。

disapprove.en: If parents are angered by their daughter's divorce, dislike her new husband, and disapprove of how she is raising their grandchildren, chances are that they are not going to enjoy her visits.
disapprove.cn: 如果父母对女儿的离婚感到恼怒，不喜欢其新任丈夫，不赞同其养育孙辈的方式，那么他们可能不会喜欢女儿的来访。
disapprove.source: 2016年6月大学英语四级考试真题（三）

disastrous.en: "Fears of disastrous consequences for local businesses are unfounded," the researchers concluded.
disastrous.cn: 研究人员总结道："对当地商家会遭受灾难性后果的担忧毫无根据。"
disastrous.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

discard.en: In the absence of environmentally and economically feasible recycling options, fast fashion manufacturers pump out low quality clothes produced in high volumes that are worn only a few times, and then discarded.
discard.cn: 在缺乏环保且经济可行的回收方案的情况下，快时尚制造商大量生产质量低劣的服装，这些衣物往往只穿几次就被丢弃。
discard.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

discharge.en: He added that he had warned McLaughlin that three preventable accidents in one year could lead to his discharge, as indeed it should.
discharge.cn: 他补充说，自己曾警告麦克劳林，若一年内发生三起可预防事故就会将其解雇，确实理应如此。
discharge.source: 2013年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

discipline.en: The concept has been applied to a wide range of disciplines , from developmental psychology to economics and engineering.
discipline.cn: 这一概念已广泛应用于从发展心理学到经济学和工程学等多个学科领域。

discourage.en: Staff did their best to discourage the pet from hanging around, but instead of leaving and never coming back, it invited its friends round.
discourage.cn: 店员们尽力阻止这只宠物在店内逗留，但它不仅没有离开不再回来，反而还带来了它的朋友们。

disguise.en: The description of a thief in disguise.
disguise.source: 2008年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

disgust.en: Increasingly, we are uncomfortable, annoyed, disgusted, scared or unaware.
disgust.cn: 我们越来越感到不舒服、恼怒、厌恶、害怕或茫然无措。
disgust.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

dismiss.en: If you tried a vegetable burger years ago and dismissed it as rubbery and flavorless, it's a good time to give meatless meat another chance.
dismiss.cn: 如果您多年前尝试过素食汉堡并因其橡胶般的口感和寡淡的味道而放弃，现在是时候再给素肉一次机会了。
dismiss.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

disorder.en: Having an eating disorder boosts annual health care costs by nearly US$2,000 per person.
disorder.cn: 饮食失调使每人每年的医疗费用增加了近2000美元。
disorder.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

display.en: They have loads of stuff there on display .
display.cn: 那里陈列着琳琅满目的展品。

disposal.en: The researchers put forth policy contributions ranging from sustainable disposal of leftover stock to production tax to incentivize both manufacturers and consumers to be more waste conscious.
disposal.cn: 研究人员提出了一系列政策建议，从可持续处理剩余库存到征收生产税，旨在鼓励制造商和消费者更加重视减少浪费。

dispute.en: Another role that they are expected to take over is negotiating on our behalf in commercial transactions or legal disputes .
dispute.cn: 它们还有望在商业交易或法律争端中，担任代表我们进行谈判的角色。

dissolve.en: The rubbish in them takes long to dissolve.
dissolve.cn: 里面的垃圾需要很长时间才能溶解。
dissolve.source: 2015年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

distinct.en: Music is tied to specific perceptual, mental, and emotional faculties, including language, motor control, sound analysis (all musical systems have a distinct pitch and quality), and aesthetics (their tunes and rhythms are balanced between repetitiveness and chaos).
distinct.cn: 音乐与特定的感知、心理和情感能力有关，包括语言、运动控制、声音分析（所有音乐系统都有独特的音高和音色），以及审美（他们的曲调和节奏在重复与混乱之间保持平衡）。

distinction.en: Before dipping into some of the key take-aways, an important distinction made in the review is between aerobic exercise and anaerobic.
distinction.cn: 在探讨一些关键信息之前，该综述首先明确了有氧运动和无氧运动的区别。
distinction.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

distinguish.en: Distinguish between conventional success and our life goal.
distinguish.cn: 区分世俗意义上的成功和我们的人生目标。
distinguish.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

distract.en: I can understand some scars and physical defects can be ugly and distracting , but not Johnny's.
distract.cn: 我能理解某些疤痕和身体缺陷可能很难看，会让人分心，但Johnny的情况并非如此。

distress.en: He says that keeping animals in zoos and parks causes them great distress .
distress.cn: 他说，把动物关在动物园和公园里会给它们带来巨大的痛苦。

distribute.en: As soon as it's safe enough to be outside, couriers start distributing accumulated mail on the still-accessible routes.
distribute.cn: 一旦确认外出是安全的，邮递员就开始沿着可通行的路线派发囤积的邮件。

distribution.en: They revolutionized the distribution of goods.
distribution.cn: 他们彻底改变了商品的流通方式。
distribution.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

disturb.en: They have been disturbed by a nightmare.
disturb.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

disturbance.en: Physical symptoms listed include dry eyes, backaches, skipping meals, poor personal hygiene and sleep disturbances.
disturbance.cn: 列出的身体症状包括眼睛干涩、背痛、不规律饮食、个人卫生差和睡眠障碍。
disturbance.source: 2010年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

ditch.en: Not only has red meat been linked to cancer, but studies show that people who ditch meat have lower blood pressure, lower average blood sugar, and lower cholesterol levels.
ditch.cn: 红肉不仅与癌症有关联，研究还表明，戒肉的人血压较低，平均血糖水平较低，胆固醇水平也较低。
ditch.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

diverse.en: A new study finds that job seekers are even willing to explore jobs with lower salaries when companies are more diverse.
diverse.cn: 一项新的研究发现，当公司员工构成更加多元化时，求职者甚至愿意考虑薪资较低的工作。
diverse.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

divide.en: The fierce divide between store owners and bike-lane advocates seems similar to our larger culture wars over climate change.
divide.cn: 店主与自行车道倡导者之间的激烈对立，似乎与我们在气候变化问题上更广泛的文化之争如出一辙。
divide.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

division.en: He completed the race in 41 minutes and 1 second and claimed the top spot in the men's division.
division.cn: 他以41分01秒完成比赛，夺得男子组冠军。
division.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

dock.en: When he was about half a mile out from the dock, he felt a bit tired.
dock.cn: 当他离码头大约半英里时，他感到有点累了。
dock.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

documentary.en: Numerous documentaries have shown how plastic is ultimately killing wildlife.
documentary.cn: 许多纪录片都表明，塑料最终会杀死野生动物。
documentary.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

domestic.en: It had two of its domestic flights mixed up.
domestic.cn: 它把两趟国内航班搞混了。
domestic.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

dominant.en: They are vital to keeping a dominant position in business transactions.
dominant.cn: 它们对于在商业交易中保持主导地位至关重要。

dominate.en: The quest to attain this mysterious state has dominated discussion around careers for years—especially for working parents.
dominate.cn: 多年来，如何达到这种神秘状态一直是职业生涯讨论的焦点——尤其是对于职场父母而言。

donate.en: To date, ReBicycle has donated more than 200 bikes to those in need, and is now expanding bike-riding lessons as demand soars.
donate.cn: 至今为止，ReBicycle已经向需要的人们捐赠了超过200辆自行车。由于需求高涨，现在它正在开展骑行课程业务。
donate.source: 2020年12月大学英语四级考试真题

donation.en: You indirectly support science through taxes you pay, products and services you purchase, and donations you make.
donation.cn: 通过缴纳的税款、购买的商品和服务以及所作的捐赠，你间接地为科学研究提供了支持。

donkey.en: But people still mostly fed carrots to horses, donkeys and pigs, and didn't eat them themselves.
donkey.cn: 但当时的人基本都用胡萝卜来喂马、驴和猪，他们自己并不吃。
donkey.source: 2017年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

doom.en: Does this spell the doom of the physical book?
doom.cn: 这是否预示着实体书的末日？
doom.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

dorm.en: And with four of us, it wouldn't cost any more than living in the dorm.
dorm.cn: 而且我们四个人一起住的话，费用不会比住宿舍更高。
dorm.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

dose.en: “When creating treatment plans, the aim is to optimise the radiation dose to the tumour and restrict it as much as possible to healthy surrounding tissues and organs,"" he says.
dose.cn: "在制定治疗方案时，目标是优化肿瘤的放射剂量，同时尽可能减少对周围健康组织和器官的辐射，"他说。
dose.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

doubtful.en: Be doubtful of diet experts' recommendations.
doubtful.cn: 对营养专家的建议要持怀疑态度。
doubtful.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

dove.en: Winning entries in past years have included a make-your-own cloth kit called Dove Bunting and a threefold, wallet-sized travel game with goals at each end, called Badoiiing.
dove.cn: 往年的获奖作品包括名为“鸽子彩旗”的自制布艺套装，以及名为“Badoiiing”的三折钱包大小的旅行游戏，游戏两端都有球门。

downward.en: Similarly with earnings, young men's wages (after adjusting for inflation) have been on a downward trajectory since 1970 and fell significantly from 2000 to 2010.
downward.cn: 同样，从 1970 年开始，年轻男性的工资（经通货膨胀调整后）就一直呈下降趋势，并且在 2000 年至 2010 年间大幅下降。

drain.en: Some simplistically attribute the decline in our public education system to the drain of skilled students by private schools, but far more significant events were at work.
drain.cn: 有些人简单地将公立教育体系的衰落归咎于私立学校吸走了优秀学生，但实际上还有更重要的因素在起作用。

drama.en: While there's plenty of drama and messiness online, it is not, for most teens, a cycle of non-stop abuse: a Pew study found only 15% of teens said someone had bullied them online in the last 12 months.
drama.cn: 尽管网络世界中充满了戏剧性和混乱局面，但对于多数青少年而言，这并不意味着他们不断遭受网络霸凌：皮尤进行的一项研究显示，在过去的12个月中，仅有15%的青少年称他们在网上被人欺负过。

dramatic.en: The study, published Wednesday in the journal Neurology, couldn't prove that exercise prevented dementia, and the findings aren't a surprise — it's long been known there's a correlation between exercise and decreased dementia risk — but the results were particularly dramatic .
dramatic.cn: 这项研究发表在周三的《神经病学》杂志上，虽然无法证明运动可以预防痴呆，结果也并不令人意外——人们早已知道运动与降低痴呆风险之间存在联系——但结果尤为显著。

drastic.en: Such drastic change is not easy.
drastic.cn: 如此剧烈的改变并非易事。
drastic.source: 2017年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

drift.en: A police officer in the US stopped a large SUV car that was going very slowly and drifting across lanes on a highway.
drift.cn: 一名美国警官在高速公路上截停了一辆速度很慢、并且不断在车道间游走的大型SUV。

dumb.en: On the other side are parents like Mike Jia, one of the thousands of Asian-American professionals who have moved to the district in the past decade, who said Aderhold's reforms would amount to a "dumbing down" of his children's education.
dumb.cn: 另一方面，像迈克·贾这样的家长也表示反对，他是过去十年间成千上万移居该地区的亚裔美国人专业人士之一。他们认为，阿德霍尔德的改革将导致子女教育水平“降低”。
dumb.source: 2018年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

dump.en: Camping in public parks has now been banned for August and the early part of September because campers dump litter, human waste, and even their tents on the grassland.
dump.cn: 由于露营者在草地上乱扔垃圾、排泄物以及帐篷，面向公共的公园已从八月到九月初禁止露营。

durable.en: They have a denser weave and are more durable than any other jeans in the world.
durable.cn: 它们的编织式样比世界上任何其他牛仔裤都更密集，更耐穿。
durable.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

duration.en: Inequality declined in America during the period following World War II, along with the duration of the working week.
duration.cn: 二战后，美国的贫富差距缩小，每周工作时间也相应缩短。
duration.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

dye.en: Also, the fabric they use is of a higher quality and the dyes are natural.
dye.cn: 此外，他们使用的面料质量更高，染料是天然的。

dynamic.en: For instance, in a follow-up study conducted with a sample of 300 students, the researchers manipulated power dynamics in an interpersonal setting to see if this would influence communicative abstraction.
dynamic.cn: 例如，在一项涉及300名学生的后续研究中，研究者在人际环境中调整了权力动态，以探究这是否会对沟通的抽象程度产生影响。

earnest.en: But the word "gamification" and the widespread, conscious application of the concept only began in earnest about five years ago, Werbach says.
earnest.cn: Werbach表示，“游戏化”一词以及这一概念的广泛、有意识的应用，直到大约五年前才真正开始。
earnest.source: 2016年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

ease.en: However, if these designers had visited the Design Museum shop in London earlier this year their fears may have been eased.
ease.cn: 然而，如果这些设计师今年早些时候参观过伦敦设计博物馆商店，他们的担忧可能会有所缓解。
ease.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

echo.en: The maker philosophy echoes old ideas advocated by John Dewey, Montessori, and even ancient Greek philosophers, as we pointed out recently.
echo.cn: 正如我们最近指出的那样，创客理念与约翰·杜威、蒙特梭利，甚至古希腊哲学家所倡导的古老思想遥相呼应。

economical.en: It is not economical to find a cure for each for each type of cold.
economical.cn: 为每一种感冒都寻找特效药是不经济的。

economics.en: The concept has been applied to a wide range of disciplines, from developmental psychology to economics and engineering.
economics.cn: 这一概念已广泛应用于从发展心理学到经济学和工程学等多个学科领域。
economics.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

edit.en: Students are able to highlight and edit text, write notes and search for information much more quickly than they can with printed textbooks.
edit.cn: 与纸质教科书相比，学生能够更快地用荧光笔标记和编辑文本、写笔记和搜索信息。

editorial.en: In an editorial released Monday in the American Journal of Public Health, Katherine Record and Bryn Austin made their case for government regulation of the fashion industry.
editorial.cn: 在《美国公共卫生杂志》周一发表的一篇社论中，凯瑟琳·雷科德和布林·奥斯丁阐述了政府应该对时尚行业进行规范的理由。

effective.en: Interactive experiences may provide opportunities for children to learn about what constitutes a desirable reputation and the kinds of strategies that are effective for building a good reputation in their social environment.
effective.cn: 互动体验或许能让孩子们有机会了解：什么样的声誉是值得拥有的，以及在他们所处的社交环境中，哪些策略能有效建立良好的声誉。

efficiency.en: On the other hand, advocates of organic farming argue yields and efficiency could be significantly improved if the food industry devoted as much research and money to organic farming as it does conventional agriculture.
efficiency.cn: 另一方面，有机农业的支持者认为，如果食品行业在有机农业上投入与传统农业相同的研究和资金，有机作物的产量和效率可能会显著提高。

efficient.en: Organic farming is much less efficient when it comes to land use, although yields vary considerably depending on the crop.
efficient.cn: 在土地使用效率上，有机农业要低得多，尽管产量因作物种类而异。

elect.en: This is an election year in the United States when the people elect a new President.
elect.cn: 今年是美国大选年，人民将选举新总统。

election.en: Amid all the election drama, air pollution problems and disease outbreaks, five tourists' good work is being spread online.
election.cn: 在热闹的选举、空气污染和疾病爆发事件中，五名游客的善行在网上被广泛传播。

electric.en: Denver is suspending its popular electric bike incentive program.
electric.cn: 丹佛市正在暂停其受欢迎的电动自行车激励计划。

electron.en: In the late 1960s, British brain scientist Geoffrey Raisman spied growth in damaged brain regions of rats through an electron microscope; their brains were forging new connections.
electron.cn: 20 世纪 60 年代末，英国脑科学家杰弗里·雷斯曼通过电子显微镜观察到老鼠受损脑区正在生长；它们的大脑正在形成新的连接。

electronic.en: With the rise of pop music, jazz, and electronic music, both opera and classical music started to fade away from the public eye.
electronic.cn: 随着流行音乐、爵士乐和电子音乐的兴起，歌剧和古典音乐逐渐淡出了公众视野。
electronic.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

electronics.en: It also provides a great opportunity to bond with friends and family, far away from electronics and other distractions at home.
electronics.cn: 它还提供了一个与朋友和家人建立联系的绝佳机会，远离家里的电子产品和其他分散注意力的事情。
electronics.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

elegant.en: I have seen this place — it is elegant , inside and out.
elegant.cn: 我曾拜访过这家机构——它从内到外都设计得很讲究。

element.en: "One of the really useful things about this competition,” says Hourican, "is that there's a commercial element because the product is going on sale for real and the boys had to learn about budgeting and marketing, as well as designing their game.”
element.cn: "这项比赛真正有价值的一点，"霍里肯说，"是它包含了商业要素，因为产品将会真正投入销售，男孩们必须学习预算和营销知识，同时还要设计他们的游戏。"
element.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

elementary.en: … the district expects to enroll 3,000 fewer elementary and middle school students, it said. 3, 000 students may not seem like that many students, but to a budget where you're receiving per-pupil funding, that's about 36 million dollars, district spokesperson Scott Bribble said.
elementary.cn: ……该地区小学和初中学生预计将减少3,000人。地区发言人斯科特·布里布尔说，3,000名学生看似不多，但对于按学生数量拨款的预算来说，这意味着大约3,600万美元。
elementary.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

elevate.en: "Cooking is elevated to an art form and some of their dishes are destined to become classics," reads Michelin's website, in a clear nod to plant-based foods' growing significance in the culinary world.
elevate.cn: 烹饪被提升为艺术形式,他们的一些菜品注定成为经典,"米其林官网如此写道,这显然认可了植物性食品在烹饪界日益重要的地位。

elevator.en: The costs of any damage to the dorm, including elevators , bathrooms, and common areas, are billed to every person on a dorm floor, or even the entire building if they do not know who caused the damage.
elevator.cn: 宿舍的任何损坏，包括电梯、卫生间和公共区域，如果他们不知道是谁造成的损坏，都会向宿舍楼层的每个人开出账单，甚至会给整栋宿舍楼的人开账单。

eliminate.en: What should be done first to eliminate the harm caused by the clothing industry?
eliminate.cn: 为消除服装行业造成的危害，首先应该采取什么措施？
eliminate.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

elsewhere.en: Those over 45 make up the bulk of the long-term unemployed, in America and elsewhere.
elsewhere.cn: 无论在美国还是其他地方,45岁以上人群占长期失业者的大多数。
elsewhere.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

embarrass.en: Maybe you're right, but the thing is, everyone at the office has a nice, expensive phone, and I'm a little embarrassed by mine.
embarrass.cn: 也许你是对的，但问题是，办公室里的每个人都有一部漂亮又昂贵的手机，而我的手机让我有点不好意思。

embassy.en: Last month the home secretary, Theresa May, announced that embassy staff would interview more than 100,000 applicants in an attempt to prevent bogus ones entering the country.
embassy.cn: 上个月，内政大臣特蕾莎·梅宣布大使馆工作人员将对10万名申请者进行面试，以防他们冒充身份进入英国。

embrace.en: So embrace the cliché and love yourself as it's highly doubtful that you'll regret it.
embrace.cn: 所以，请勇敢接受那些老生常谈，爱自己，因为这样做你几乎不可能会后悔。

emerge.en: In particular, studies of millions of bats emerging at dusk from caves in Southeast Asia showed that each bat used a form of bilateral control to reduce the likelihood of collisions with other bats in the densely packed swarm, Horn said.
emerge.cn: 霍恩说，对东南亚黄昏时分从洞穴中出来的数百万只蝙蝠进行的研究尤其表明，每只蝙蝠都使用了一种双边控制方式，以减少在密集的蝙蝠群中与其他蝙蝠发生碰撞的可能性。

emission.en: This little story turns out to be a fascinating glimpse at the challenges cities face as they try to update their urban infrastructure — to clean up the air, reduce greenhouse emissions, and speed up travel by making towns more bike-friendly.
emission.cn: 这个小故事为我们提供了一个引人入胜的视角，让我们看到城市在升级基础设施时面临的挑战——净化空气、减少温室气体排放、通过打造更友好的骑行环境来提升出行效率。

emit.en: Rocket engines emit particles that destroy ozone.
emit.cn: 火箭发动机排放的粒子会破坏臭氧层。
emit.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

emotional.en: The district said the decreased budget means it cannot provide the same mental health supports, social and emotional services or specialized programming to schools with lower enrollments.
emotional.cn: 学区表示，预算减少意味着无法为入学人数较少的学校提供同等的心理健康支持、社会和情感服务或专业化课程。

emphasis.en: With so much emphasis on employee wellness these days, company volunteer programs could be the perfect 2025 resolution.
emphasis.cn: 在当今这个高度重视员工健康的时代，公司志愿者计划或许是2025年最理想的企业发展方向。

empire.en: The things people make, and the way they make them, determine how cities grow and decline, and influence how empires rise and fall.
empire.cn: 人们制造的物品以及制造方式决定了城市的兴衰，并影响着帝国的兴衰。

employee.en: The labor market is likely cooling, because even a shortage of workers isn't overcoming the historic imbalance between employers and employees in the US: the volume of income that workers take home as a proportion of what the US economy produces is still falling.
employee.cn: 劳动力市场可能正在冷却，因为即使劳动力短缺，也无法克服美国雇主与雇员之间的历史性失衡：工人收入占美国经济产出的比重仍在下降。
employee.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

employer.en: The labor market is likely cooling, because even a shortage of workers isn't overcoming the historic imbalance between employers and employees in the US: the volume of income that workers take home as a proportion of what the US economy produces is still falling.
employer.cn: 劳动力市场可能正在冷却，因为即使劳动力短缺，也无法克服美国雇主与雇员之间的历史性失衡：工人收入占美国经济产出的比重仍在下降。

employment.en: As the world migrant crisis intensifies, employment is becoming a global concern.
employment.cn: 随着世界移民危机的加剧，就业正成为全球关注的问题。
employment.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 阅读

enable.en: To enable the district to remain competitive.

encounter.en: Markiewicz said crews encountered heavy smoke coming from the second floor when they arrived.
encounter.cn: 马尔凯维奇表示，消防人员到场时，发现二楼冒出大量浓烟。

endanger.en: The most recent count of pandas found that there were more than 1,800 left in the wild, putting them on the list of vulnerable, but not endangered, species.
endanger.cn: 最近一次熊猫数量统计显示，野外熊猫数量已超过1,800只，使它们被列为易危而非濒危物种。

endurance.en: It enables people to build up endurance .
endurance.cn: 它能帮助人们增强耐力。

endure.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 听力

energetic.en: It has made her happy and energetic .
energetic.cn: 这让她感到快乐和充满活力。

engage.en: Older workers who've actively engaged in more education and training relevant to their jobs turn this pretty much on its head.
engage.cn: 而那些积极参与与工作相关的教育和培训的年长员工，几乎完全扭转了这种局面。

engagement.en: What is the chief advantage of having the engagement period?
engagement.cn: 订婚期的主要优势是什么？

enhance.en: From our experiences so far, flexible seating enhances student ownership of space.
enhance.cn: 根据目前的经验,灵活座椅增强了学生对空间的主人翁意识。
enhance.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

enlarge.en: Enlarge the marine fish stocks effectively.
enlarge.cn: 有效扩大海洋鱼类资源量。

enlighten.en: Even if there is no concrete benefit paid in response to your good deed, at the very least, the doer has the opportunity to enjoy a kind of spiritually enlightened moment.
enlighten.cn: 即使并没有具体的好处来回应你善良的行为，但至少做善事的人有机会享受精神上的升华时刻。

enormous.en: They would be achieved along with enormous health benefits.
enormous.cn: 它们的实现将带来巨大的健康效益。
enormous.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

enquire.en: To enquire about the price of cats.

enrich.cn: 它丰富了这座城市的夜生活。
enrich.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

ensure.en: Therefore, patients are directed to take most drugs during the morning or evening primarily to ensure compliance.
ensure.cn: 因此，医生通常会让患者在早晨或晚上服药，主要是为了确保用药依从性。
ensure.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

entertainment.en: The New York dance club also serves as a place for entertainment where youngsters can enjoy themselves safely.
entertainment.cn: 纽约舞蹈俱乐部也是一个娱乐场所，年轻人可以在这里安全地享受生活。
entertainment.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

enthusiasm.en: He is currently traveling through North America performing with his guitar and his enthusiasm on his Age of Disruption Tour.
enthusiasm.cn: 他目前正带着吉他和热情，在北美进行“颠覆时代”巡回演出。

enthusiastic.cn: 亚裔美国家长们是竞争激烈的器乐音乐项目的热情支持者。

entire.en: According to the estate agent, the house was built in 1882 and originally featured a well for the entire road.
entire.cn: 根据房产中介的说法，这座房子建于1882年，最初为整条街道提供了一口井。

entitle.en: It is entitled to adopt any rules it wants.

entry.en: The craft will use the heat of re- entry to roast coffee beans as they float inside it in a pressurised tank.

environmental.en: On the whole, organic agriculture may have a smaller environmental footprint.
environmental.cn: 总体而言，有机农业可能对环境的影响较小。

episode.en: It is sunburn that is most worrying recent research shows five episodes of sunburn in the teenage years increases the risk of all skin cancers.
episode.cn: 晒伤是最让人担心的——近来研究表明青少年时代被太阳晒伤五次会增加患所有类型皮肤癌的风险。

equality.en: However, the study also shows how traditional gender roles endure both at work, where more women than men reported changes in their perceived career potential, and at home — even among workers who claim to have a strong desire for equality.
equality.cn: 然而，该研究也揭示了传统性别角色无论在工作场所还是在家庭都根深蒂固，工作场所中，女性比男性更多地感受到其职业发展潜力的影响，即使在那些自称强烈追求平等的员工当中，这种现象依然存在。

equivalent.en: It's recommended by the World Health Organisation that adults have no more than 30g of added sugar, the equivalent of 150ml of fruit juice, per day.

era.en: This is the era of social media.

estate.en: Employers argue they make considerable savings on real estate when workers shift from office to home work.

ethic.en: In fact, of the four generations Pew Research has data for, the Millennial generation does not cite work ethic as distinctive of itself.

ethnic.en: We know that friends are more likely to be the same age, gender and ethnic background as each other.
ethnic.cn: 我们知道，朋友往往年龄相近、性别一致，且来自相似的民族背景。

evaluate.en: Many consumers report comparing multiple competing brands and prices when evaluating a purchase.
evaluate.cn: 许多消费者表示，在考虑购买时会货比三家，比较多个竞争品牌和价格。

eve.en: Russia's other late nights and early mornings generally correspond to public holidays. On New Year's Eve , Russians have the world's latest bedtime, hitting the hay at around 3:30 a.
eve.cn: 俄罗斯其他较晚的夜晚和较早的清晨通常与公共假日相对应。在新年夜，俄罗斯人拥有世界上最晚的就寝时间，大约凌晨3:30才入睡。

evident.en: Cooperative behavior is evident among identical twins.
evident.cn: 合作行为在同卵双胞胎中表现得尤为明显。

evil.en: Over the past 13 years, as a student, lecturer and researcher, I've enjoyed discussing the science of evil with anyone willing to listen.
evil.cn: 在过去的13年里，作为一名学生、讲师和研究人员，我喜欢与任何愿意倾听的人讨论邪恶这门科学。

evolution.en: It has reached the highest level of evolution .

exceed.en: Generally, though, a 140-pound person should not exceed 120 grams of protein per day, particularly because a high protein diet can strain kidney and liver function and increase risks of developing heart disease and cancer.
exceed.cn: 通常而言，一个体重约63公斤的人每天的蛋白质摄入量不应超过120克。这是因为过高的蛋白质摄入可能会给肾脏和肝脏带来负担，同时还可能增加患心脏病和癌症的风险。

excitement.cn: 拥有竞争对手能够增强你的事业表现，原因之一是它激发了一种令人兴奋的竞争氛围，促使你加倍努力。

exclude.cn: 医学教授希瑟·费里斯表示："水果的很多营养成分都存在于果皮中，比如苹果皮，而这些部分在榨汁过程中被丢弃了。"
exclude.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

exclusive.en: As these findings show, exercise and academics may not be mutually exclusive .
exclusive.cn: 据这些研究结果显示，运动和学业可能并不互相排斥。

excursion.en: If you can fly on a Tuesday or Wednesday and buy your tickets at least 21 days in advance, I suggest you book a round-trip excursion flight.
excursion.cn: 如果你能在周二或周三出行，并且至少提前 21 天购买机票，我建议你预订往返观光航班。

execute.en: He was the first minor to be executed in South Carolina.
execute.cn: 他是南卡罗来纳州第一个被执行死刑的未成年人。
execute.source: 2015年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

execution.en: Whether there should be a minimum age limit for execution .
execution.cn: 是否应该设定死刑最低年龄限制。

executive.en: Chief executive John Kampfner of the Creative Industries Federation thinks that this drop in figures has worrying implications for the skills pipeline in Britain's hugely successful arts and creative industries.
executive.cn: 创意产业联合会的首席执行官约翰·坎普夫纳认为，这一数据下降对英国极为成功的艺术和创意产业的人才培养渠道有着令人担忧的影响。

exemplify.en: And Mr. Jobs, many experts say, exemplifies what works in the innovation game.
exemplify.cn: 许多专家表示，乔布斯先生是创新领域成功经验的典范。
exemplify.source: 2015年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

exert.en: People's active mental processes exert a positive effect on their multitasking.
exert.cn: 人们积极的心理活动对他们的多任务处理能力产生积极影响。

exhaust.en: After exhausting debate and analysis of the average income, historians have agreed to disagree on whether there was rapid or slow economic growth during the Industrial Revolution.
exhaust.cn: 在对平均收入进行充分辩论和分析之后，历史学家们对工业革命期间经济增长是快速还是缓慢仍然存在分歧。

exhibit.en: These differences appear as early as six years old: girls that age already show more interest in helping and caring for others than boys do, and they already exhibit a greater orientation toward family versus career.
exhibit.cn: 这些差异在六岁时就已显现：这个年纪的女孩比男孩更愿意帮助和照顾他人，并且已经表现出更偏向家庭而非职业的倾向。

exile.en: This year, the programs range from one that turns the house into a collaborative essay to one that explores the meaning of exile .
exile.cn: 今年的活动主题多种多样，从将房子变成合作论文的场所，到探索流亡的意义，不一而足。

existence.en: Children don't just show up to the first day of kindergarten and have the idea of reputation pop suddenly into existence .
existence.cn: 孩子们并不是刚上幼儿园的第一天就突然有了声誉的概念。

expand.en: It has implemented a decision to expand business.
expand.cn: 该公司已实施扩大业务的决策。

expansion.en: But eventually, yields will likely suffer because the soil north of Iowa declines in quality — a legacy of glacial expansion.
expansion.cn: 但最终，产量很可能会下降，因为爱荷华州北部的土壤品质较差——这是冰河时期遗留下来的结果。
expansion.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

expectation.en: Meanwhile, more women reported an increase in their responsibilities and manager expectations after childbirth.
expectation.cn: 同时，越来越多的女性表示，在孩子出生后，她们的工作责任和上司的期望都有所增加。

expenditure.en: In rejecting exercise, some people may be discouraged too much by caloric-expenditure charts: for example, one would have to briskly walk three miles just to work off the 275 calories in one delicious Danish pastry.
expenditure.cn: 有些人拒绝运动，可能会因为卡路里消耗表而感到气馁：例如，一个人必须快走三英里才能消耗掉一个美味的丹麦酥饼中的 275 卡路里。
expenditure.source: 2005年1月英语四级 第1套 阅读

experimental.en: Experimental users may try drugs once or twice.
experimental.cn: 实验用户可能会尝试服用药物一到两次。

explode.en: Driving around town in a car is so normal to them that cycling seems weird and unusual — despite its boost from Covid, when bike sales exploded by 75 percent.
explode.cn: 对他们来说，开车在城里转是再正常不过的事，骑自行车反而显得怪异——尽管疫情期间自行车销量暴增了75%，骑行热潮高涨。

exploit.en: In contrast, the new intervention cleverly exploits teenagers' instinct for rebelliousness and autonomy, and the value they place on social justice.
exploit.cn: 相比之下，新的干预措施巧妙地利用了青少年的叛逆心理和自主意识，以及他们对社会正义的重视。

exploration.en: Moon Express's mission involves plans to land a suitcase-sized package of scientific equipment on the moon for ongoing exploration and commercial development.
exploration.cn: “月球快递”的任务涉及到计划在月球上放置一个手提箱大小的科学设备包，以进行持续的勘探和商业开发。
exploration.source: 2018年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

explosion.en: The phenomenon happens when thunder and lightning mix with a heavy snowstorm, sometimes causing loud claps that can be confused with explosions.
explosion.cn: 这种现象是由雷电与暴风雪交织而成，有时会伴随着巨大的响声，容易被误认为爆炸。
explosion.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

export.en: Seeking new ways to increase its exports .
export.cn: 寻求增加出口的新途径。

expose.en: Instead, he credits old-school games like Palace of Magic with exposing him to computers.
expose.cn: 相反，他认为是《魔法宫殿》这类老式游戏让他接触到了计算机。

exposure.en: Unfortunately, also like her mother, she developed blood cancer because of her exposure to radiation.
exposure.cn: 不幸的是，和她母亲一样，她也因为暴露在辐射中得了血癌。

expression.en: But it may also be an expression of a desire for going outdoors.
expression.cn: 但这也可能表达了人们对户外活动的向往。

extend.en: Whether you are taking a DNA test to build your extended DNA family tree, or want precise information on inborn health conditions, it is important to understand how accurate genetic tests are, and what information we can rely upon.
extend.cn: 无论你是通过DNA测试来构建家族谱系,还是想获取先天健康状况的精确信息,了解基因检测的准确性以及哪些信息可以信赖都至关重要。

extension.en: We see our children as an extension of ourselves, so if you're saying that my child is behaving inappropriately, then that's somehow a criticism of me."
extension.cn: 我们把孩子视为自身的延伸，所以如果你说我的孩子行为不端，那某种程度上就是在批评我。

extensive.en: In an extensive study published in 2015, researchers analyzed a total of 99 choice studies and specifically looked at those cases in which reducing choices helped to boost sales.
extensive.cn: 2015年发表的一项大规模研究中，研究人员分析了总共99个关于选择的研究案例，特别关注了那些通过减少选择来提升销售的情况。
extensive.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

extent.en: The 20% error rate observed in the study likely underestimates the extent to which people would struggle to tell an artificial face from the real thing outside of the lab.
extent.cn: 研究中发现的20%错误率很可能低估了人们在实际生活中区分人工面孔和真实面孔时所面临的困难程度。

exterior.en: Online office workers posted photos and videos of the raccoon, resting on window edges and climbing up the building's concrete exterior.
exterior.cn: 在线办公人员发布了浣熊的照片和视频，这些浣熊有的栖息在窗台上，有的则爬上了建筑物的混凝土外墙。
exterior.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

external.en: They think that any success is due to external circumstances or just luck and chance.
external.cn: 他们认为任何成功都归因于外部环境或仅仅是运气和偶然。
external.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

extinguish.en: A team of about 25 firefighters then spent about 25 minutes extinguishing the flames.
extinguish.cn: 随后，一支由约 25 名消防员组成的队伍花了大约 25 分钟扑灭了火焰。

extreme.en: Among the reasons given for the decision, the restaurant cited noise levels, lack of space for high chairs, cleaning up extreme messes, and the liability of kids running around the restaurant.
extreme.cn: 餐厅给出的理由包括：噪音过大、没有足够空间摆放儿童高脚椅、需要清理严重的脏乱，以及儿童在餐厅内乱跑可能引发的安全责任问题。

fabric.en: Through this lens, he shows us that the first laws passed in the 1200s to ensure that only the nobility were allowed to wear certain fabrics, colors and ornaments reflected the rise of the middle class, who were now able to imitate some of these fashions.
fabric.cn: 通过这一视角，福特向我们展示了12世纪初颁布的第一批律法，即只有贵族才能穿戴特定的面料、颜色和装饰，反映了中产阶级的崛起，因为他们开始能模仿其中的一些时尚。
fabric.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

facilitate.en: Helping to look after a pet can facilitate numerous aspects of a child's emotional development.
facilitate.cn: 帮助照顾宠物可以促进儿童情感发展的许多方面。
facilitate.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

facility.en: Great Barrier Island has no public facilities and the 950 people living there (though only about half permanently) rely on solar and wind energy, and bottled gas for cooking.
facility.cn: 大障礁岛没有公共设施，居住在那里的约950人（尽管其中只有大约一半是永久居民）依靠太阳能、风能和瓶装燃气做饭。
facility.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

factual.en: First, acquire a base of factual knowledge in any domain in which you want to perform well.
factual.cn: 首先，在任何想要表现出色的领域，必须掌握基础的事实性知识。
factual.source: 2014年6月大学英语六级考试真题（三）

faculty.en: Firing of less qualified faculty members.
faculty.cn: 解雇资质较差的教职员工。

fade.en: Wide awake at 3:30 am with our nine-year-old daughter on our lodge balcony, I stared for hours at the most incredible night sky I've ever seen before the dawn slowly started to rub out the stars on the horizon and the multiple shooting stars faded away.
fade.cn: 凌晨3:30，我和九岁的女儿坐在小屋阳台上彻夜未眠，我凝视着这辈子见过的最美的夜空，直到黎明慢慢开始抹去天边的星星，许多流星也渐渐消失。
fade.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

failure.en: Failures, on the other hand, are always internalised as the result of their own shortcomings.
failure.cn: 另一方面，失败总是被视为自身缺陷导致的结果。
failure.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

faint.en: What is most important, different layers of ocean water can act as channels for sounds, focusing them in the same way a stethoscope does when it carries faint noises from a patient's chest to a doctor's ear.
faint.cn: 最重要的是，不同层次的海水可以作为声音的通道，像听诊器将病人胸部的微弱声音传递到医生耳朵一样，将声音聚焦起来。

fairly.en: Though the study mentioned above was fairly small (only 191 women took the initial fitness test, which means it's hard to maintain statistical significance while breaking the group down into sub-categories of more or less fit), …
fairly.cn: 尽管上述研究规模较小（只有191名女性参加了最初的健身测试，这意味着在将群体细分为不同健康水平的子类别时难以保持统计显著性）……

fairy.en: In the show, Marie Kondo acts as a tiny garbage fairy for messy people, visiting their houses to share the wisdom of the "KonMari" method.
fairy.cn: 节目中，近藤麻理惠扮演垃圾小仙女，到邋遢的人家中拜访，给他们分享“麻理惠整理”方法的秘诀？
fairy.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第1套 听力

faithful.en: Why dogs can be faithful friends of humans.
faithful.cn: 为什么狗能成为人类忠实的朋友。
faithful.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

fake.en: “Maybe the best sign that Impossible Foods has cracked the code to realistic fake meat is that I couldn't stand to take another bite,” she wrote.
fake.cn: "或许'不可能食品'成功研发出逼真人造肉的最好证明就是我无法忍受再多吃一口，"她在文中写道。
fake.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

fame.en: He was retired soon after, but his public life and fame by no means decreased with the end of his career.
fame.cn: 他不久后便退休了，但他的公众生活和名望并没有随着职业生涯的结束而减少。

famine.en: Yet occurrences of shortages and droughts are causing famine and distress in some areas, and industrial and agricultural by-products are polluting water supplies.
famine.cn: 然而，一些地区却出现了物资短缺和干旱，导致饥荒和苦难，工业和农业副产品也污染了水源。
famine.source: 2001年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

fantastic.cn: 能够碰撞出令人惊叹的效果。
fantastic.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

fantasy.en: Lawrence Patihis at the University of Southern Mississippi recently studied around 20 people with HSAM and found that they scored particularly high on two measures: fantasy proneness and absorption.
fantasy.cn: 南密西西比大学的Lawrence Patihis最近研究了约20名患有HSAM的人，发现他们在两方面的分数特别高：幻想倾向和专注度。
fantasy.source: 2017年6月大学英语四级考试真题（一）

fare.en: How had the businesses on that street fared ?
fare.cn: 那条街上的商家经营状况到底怎么样？

fascinate.en: With E 10 to spend, they could have bought a fascinating children's toy called "Dazzle Racer".
fascinate.cn: 如果他们有 10 欧元可以花，他们就可以买到一款名为“炫彩赛车”的迷人儿童玩具。
fascinate.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

fashionable.en: Bear in mind they will last me several years and they are very fashionable too.
fashionable.cn: 请记住，它们可以穿好几年，而且也很时髦。
fashionable.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

fatal.en: It may also carry viruses that are fatal to native snakes, which do not have resistance.
fatal.cn: 它还可能携带对本地蛇类致命的病毒,而本地蛇类对这些病毒没有抵抗力。

fatigue.en: “Warning fatigue” and distracted driving are also causes for concern.
fatigue.cn: "警告疲劳"和分心驾驶同样令人担忧。
fatigue.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

faulty.en: To complain about the faulty. solar panels.
faulty.cn: 投诉有缺陷的太阳能电池板。
faulty.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

fearful.en: They will be fearful of potential consequences.
fearful.cn: 他们会担心潜在的后果。
fearful.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

feasible.en: …the toy was the winning entry in the museum’s 2015 Design Ventura competition, which brings the business of design to life for students aged 13 to 16 by challenging them to develop a new creative, sustainable and commercially feasible product for the Design Museum shop…
feasible.cn: ……这款玩具是博物馆2015年"设计创业"竞赛的获奖作品。该竞赛通过挑战13至16岁的学生为设计博物馆商店开发新颖、可持续且商业可行的产品，让设计业务在学生中栩栩如生……
feasible.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

federal.en: A three-month moving average of annual wage increases from the Atlanta Federal Reserve Bank's wage tracker shows that US job switchers got the highest wage increase last July, when the measure touched 8.5 percent.
federal.cn: 亚特兰大联储的工资追踪数据显示，去年七月，美国跳槽者获得了最高的工资增幅，当时这一数字达到8.5%。

feedback.en: Seventy-six participants completed a range of intelligence tests and received positive feedback on them, regardless of their actual performance.
feedback.cn: 76名参与者完成了一系列智力测试，无论实际表现如何，他们都得到了积极的反馈。

fellowship.en: Others in the US have found similar effects with National Institutes of Health early-career fellowships launching narrow winners far ahead of close losers.
fellowship.cn: 美国的研究人员也发现了类似的效应，美国国立卫生研究院的早期职业奖学金使得险胜者远远领先于略输者。

fence.en: Once the fires were over, the family had to fix the damage done to the farm as it was such a large property, which included rebuilding about 40 kilometers of fencing .
fence.cn: 火灾过后，由于农场面积很大，这家人不得不修复农场的损坏，其中包括重建约 40 公里的围栏。

fertile.en: In our always-connected world, boredom may be a hard-to-define state, but it is a fertile one.
fertile.cn: 在我们这个始终相连的世界里，无聊这种状态也许难以定义，却富于创新。
fertile.source: 2020年12月大学英语四级考试真题

fertilizer.en: Among the report's more outrageous findings-a German fertilizer described itself as "earthworm friendly" a brand of flour said it was "non-polluting" and a British toilet paper claimed to be "environmentally friendlier"
fertilizer.cn: 该报告中一些更令人震惊的发现包括：一种德国肥料自称“对蚯蚓友好”，一种面粉品牌声称其“无污染”，以及一种英国厕纸声称其“更环保”。

fiction.en: It's written by a Chinese science fiction writer.
fiction.cn: 这本书是一位中国科幻小说作家写的。
fiction.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

fierce.en: The fierce divide between store owners and bike-lane advocates seems similar to our larger culture wars over climate change.
fierce.cn: 店主与自行车道倡导者之间的激烈对立，似乎与我们在气候变化问题上更广泛的文化之争如出一辙。
fierce.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

file.en: USPS urges those without standing addresses to file change-of-address forms with their new location.
file.cn: 美国邮政署敦促没有固定地址的人提交地址变更表并附上新地址。
file.source: 2019年12月大学英语四级考试真题（三）

filter.en: A skilled backroom operator who speaks without a filter , Ecclestone said often that in his opinion, the sport was at its best when he was allowed to act as 'Ca dictator.
filter.cn: 埃克莱斯顿是一名技术娴熟的幕后经营者，他说话内容不经过滤，他经常说，在他看来，当他被允许扮演独裁者时，这项运动处于最佳状态。

finally.en: The villagers finally banded together and scared the beast away with firecrackers and drums.
finally.cn: 村民们终于团结起来，用鞭炮和鼓把野兽吓跑了。
finally.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

finance.en: A bank is more likely to hire a literature graduate who spent their summers working in their local bank than a finance or economics graduate who spent their summers surfing or traveling around Italy.
finance.cn: 银行更倾向于聘用那些曾在当地银行度过暑假的文学专业的毕业生，而非那些暑假期间去冲浪或游历意大利的金融或经济专业的毕业生。

financial.en: However, people did report a few disadvantages to pet ownership These included difficulty traveling and financial strains. 6% of pet owners said they'd fallen or injured themselves as a result of having a pet.
financial.cn: 然而，人们也指出了养宠物的一些不利因素，包括旅行困难和经济负担。6%的宠物主人表示，他们因为养宠物而跌倒或伤到自己。

finding.en: New findings suggest that the kinds of complex and strategic self-presentation behaviour we see in adults appear at a much younger age than previously known.
finding.cn: 新的研究结果表明，我们在成人身上观察到的那些复杂而有策略性的自我展示行为，其出现年龄要比此前已知的早得多。

flame.en: A team of about 25 firefighters then spent about 25 minutes extinguishing the flames.
flame.cn: 然后，大约25名消防队员用了25分钟左右的时间将火势完全扑灭。
flame.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

flaw.en: Or, in some unfortunate cases, they may focus only on your flaws and shortcomings.
flaw.cn: 还有一些很可悲的情况，他们只注意到你的缺点和瑕疵。
flaw.source: 2014年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

flee.en: Today, a greater and greater proportion of people living on the streets are there because of bad luck or a series of mistakes, or because the economy forgot them—they lost a job or were evicted or fled an abusive marriage just as the housing market was growing increasingly unforgiving.
flee.cn: 如今，露宿街头的人越来越多是因为运气不好或犯了一系列错误，或者是经济问题——就在房地产市场变得越来越不宽容的时候，他们失去了工作，或者被驱逐，或者从虐待性婚姻中逃离。
flee.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

fleet.en: This month, three U.S. bikeshare companies, Motivate, LimeBike and Spin, announced electric bicycles will be added to their fleets .
fleet.cn: 本月， 三家美国共享自行车公司Motivate、Lime Bike和Spin宣布他们的车队将增加电动自行车。

flexible.en: I responded in a whisper of flexible seating, thinking about our then current classroom.
flexible.cn: 我轻声回应说"灵活座位",脑海中浮现出当时教室的样子。

float.en: The navy rescued a man who survived 24 days floating in the sea on a boat by eating tomato sauce and vegetable powder.
float.cn: 海军救出了一名在海上漂流24天的男子，他通过食用番茄酱和蔬菜粉维持生命。

flock.en: For decades, tourists have been flocking to Palmador, which is located off the southeast coast of Spain.
flock.cn: 几十年来，游客一直蜂拥至位于西班牙东南海岸外的帕尔马多。
flock.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

flourish.en: Taking children along to the pet shop to buy food and supplies will support their cognitive development as their passion for learning flourishes .
flourish.cn: 带孩子一同去宠物店购买食物和用品，不仅能促进他们的认知发展，还能激发他们对学习的热情。

fluid.en: A dry mouth may reduce taste sensitivity, but taste is restored by drinking fluids.
fluid.cn: 口腔干燥可能会降低味觉敏感度，但喝水可以恢复味觉。
fluid.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

folk.en: But the folks who run local businesses simply aren't convinced, even when their own street performs.
folk.cn: 但当地商家经营者却不以为然，即便他们自己所在的街道表现出色。

forbid.en: Forbid him to draw in his workbook.
forbid.cn: 禁止他在练习本上画画。
forbid.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

forge.en: In the late 1960s, British brain scientist Geoffrey Raisman spied growth in damaged brain regions of rats through an electron microscope; their brains were forging new connections.
forge.cn: 20世纪60年代末，英国脑科学家杰弗里·莱斯曼通过电子显微镜发现，受损的老鼠脑区能够生长，并形成新的神经连接。

formal.en: It seems that wearing formal office wear puts us in the right frame of mind to conduct business.
formal.cn: 穿着正式的办公服装似乎能让我们保持正确的商务心态。

formation.en: It determines the formation of connections in the brain.
formation.cn: 它决定了大脑中连接的形成。

formula.en: When I think of the narrative of Formula One, it's a very different kind of audience.
formula.cn: 当我想到一级方程式的叙事时，则有着一群完全不同的爱好者。

formulate.en: Governments need to formulate energy policies that promote economically and environmentally sound development.
formulate.cn: 政府需要制定促进经济和环境健全发展的能源政策。

forth.en: By shaking it back and forth .

forum.en: Goel and his team developed several versions of Jill Watson before releasing her to the online forums.
forum.cn: 葛尔和他的团队开发出好几个版本的吉尔·沃森，然后才在线上论坛发行。
forum.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

fossil.en: Current spacecraft use a variety of fuels, but most are based on fossil fuels.
fossil.cn: 现有航天器虽然采用多种燃料，但主要还是依赖化石燃料。
fossil.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

foundation.en: Classical music and opera are the very foundation of what our modern music is based upon.
foundation.cn: 古典音乐和歌剧是现代音乐的基石。

fraction.en: A tiny fraction, 2%, of men said they did more of the childcare.
fraction.cn: 仅有2%的男性表示，在照顾孩子方面，是他们做得更多。
fraction.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

fragment.en: Many start off as part of larger plastic objects, which over time fragment into smaller and smaller pieces until they become tiny, 5 millimeters or less in diameter.
fragment.cn: 许多微塑料最初是较大塑料物体的一部分，随着时间的推移，它们会分解成越来越小的碎片，直径缩小至5毫米或更小。

frame.en: It seems that wearing formal office wear puts us in the right frame of mind to conduct business.
frame.cn: 穿着正式的办公服装似乎能让我们保持正确的商务心态。

framework.en: One can also paint the wooden frameworks the same colour as the walls, helping the rooms look bigger.
framework.cn: 人们还可以将木质框架涂成与墙壁相同的颜色，这样可以让房间看起来更大。

frank.en: The Scottish Environment Protection Agency has issued more than 35 flood warnings covering several regions, as Scotland continues to clean up after Storm Frank hit the country last Wednesday.
frank.cn: 苏格兰环境保护局已发布超过 35 项洪水预警，覆盖多个地区。此前，弗兰克风暴于上周三袭击苏格兰，目前苏格兰仍在进行灾后清理工作。
frank.source: 2016年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

freight.en: When that happens, up to 260 freight trains and 65 passenger trains will be able to pass through it every day.
freight.cn: 届时，每天将有多达 260 列货运列车和 65 列客运列车能够通过该线路。
freight.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第3套 听力

frequency.en: His high frequency of surfing the net.
frequency.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

frequent.en: Small business owners are frequent drivers who commute from other parts of the city by car, Grabar points out.
frequent.cn: 格拉巴尔指出，小企业主往往是经常开车的人，他们从城市其他地区驾车通勤。

fruitful.en: One researcher suggests it might be more fruitful to distribute grants on a relatively equal basis.
fruitful.cn: 一位研究人员认为，以相对平等的方式分配资助金可能更有成效。

frustrate.en: But now, new research has found the cause and researchers may have come up with a solution for this frustrating traffic pattern: maintaining equal spacing between cars on the road, rather than driving so closely behind another vehicle that a collision is likely if that vehicle brakes suddenly.
frustrate.cn: 但现在，新的研究发现了造成这种令人沮丧的交通状况的原因，研究人员可能已经找到了解决之道：保持道路上车辆之间的等距行驶，而不是跟车太近，以至于如果前车突然刹车，就可能发生碰撞。

fulfil.en: Our desire to be loved will be fulfilled.
fulfil.cn: 我们渴望被爱的愿望终将实现。
fulfil.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

fundamental.en: With a simple personal story, they can convey fundamental values.
fundamental.cn: 他们可以通过一个简单的个人故事传达基本价值观。
fundamental.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

furnish.cn: 为她的乡间别墅添置家具。

furthermore.en: Furthermore , this theory cannot explain the change in trend in the U.S. working week in the 1970s.
furthermore.cn: 此外，该理论无法解释 20 世纪 70 年代美国工作周趋势的变化。

fuss.en: But I don't like being the center of attention, receiving gifts and having a fuss made.
fuss.cn: 但我不喜欢成为人们关注的焦点，不喜欢接受礼物，不喜欢大惊小怪。
fuss.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

gamble.en: Boredom has been linked to behavior issues including inattentive driving, mindless snacking, excessive drinking, and addictive gambling.
gamble.cn: 无聊与一些行为问题有关，包括心不在焉地开车、漫不经心地吃零食、过度饮酒和赌博成瘾。
gamble.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

gang.en: In one recent case, an international gang used an extremely realistic mask to pose as a French minister, cheating business executives out of millions of pounds.
gang.cn: 近期一起案件中，一个国际犯罪团伙利用极其逼真的面具假冒法国部长，诈骗商界高管，骗取了数百万英镑。

gap.en: Last year, job switchers earned far higher wage increases than those staying in their jobs, but the gap is now closing.
gap.cn: 去年，跳槽者的工资增幅远高于留在原岗位的人，但这种差距正在缩小。
gap.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

gardener.en: They can hire a gardener to do the work.
gardener.cn: 他们可以雇佣园丁来完成这项工作。
gardener.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

gasoline.en: And a number of oil-producing countries are trimming their gasoline subsidies and raising taxes, so the net savings for global consumers is not as big as the oil price plunge might suggest.
gasoline.cn: 而且，许多产油国正在削减汽油补贴并提高税收，因此全球消费者的净节省额并没有油价暴跌所显示的那么大。
gasoline.source: 2016年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

gathering.en: Recently, I was at a gathering of colleagues when someone turned to me and asked, "So, what's new with you?"
gathering.cn: 最近再一次同事聚会上，有人转向我问到：“那么，你有碰上什么新鲜事吗？”
gathering.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

gaze.en: And when looking at angry humans, they tended to turn away their gaze .
gaze.cn: 当目视愤怒的人类时，它们趋向于移开视线。

gear.en: He had always had a good memory, but the thrill of young love seems to have shifted a gear in his mind: from now on, he would start recording his whole life in detail.
gear.cn: 他一直记忆力很好，但年轻时的恋爱激情似乎在他心中打了一次转：从今以后，他将开始详细记录自己的一生。

gender.en: UK universities are world leaders when it comes to advancing and promoting gender equality.
gender.cn: 在推动和促进性别平等方面，英国的大学是世界领袖。
gender.source: 2020年7月大学英语四级考试真题

generally.en: They generally rely on luck and chance for success.
generally.cn: 他们通常依赖运气和机会来取得成功。

generate.en: Siri lacks a proper editing function: saying, "Edit message to say we're at Silver Cloud restaurant and you should come find us," generates a message that repeats the original text instead of replacing it.
generate.cn: Siri缺乏合适的编辑功能：比如说"把信息编辑为我们在银云餐厅，你应该来找我们"，结果生成的信息只是重复了原文，而没有替换它。

generator.en: That's why we recently launched the Out of Office Email Generator , a free tool you can use before your next long weekend or trip.
generator.cn: 正因如此，我们才推出了自动回复邮件生成器这一免费工具，让您在下次享受长周末或出行前，能够轻松设置邮件自动回复。

generosity.en: To publicise their generosity in helping the needy.
generosity.cn: 为了宣传他们帮助穷人的慷慨行为。

generous.en: In sum: generous family-friendly policies do keep more women in the labor market, but they also tend to diminish their careers.
generous.cn: 概括来说，大量的有利于家庭的政策确实使得职场中有了更多女性的参与，但这些政策往往也会削弱她们的职业发展。
generous.source: 2014年6月大学英语六级考试真题（一）

genius.en: For example, you might recognize that you are intelligent, but realize that you are not a genius .
genius.cn: 例如，你可能会认识到自己很聪明，但也明白自己并非天才。

genuine.en: However, they fail to provide a genuine education with an emphasis on convenience rather than critical thinking.
genuine.cn: 然而，网课强调便利性而非批判思考，无法提供真正的教育。

geology.en: The letter was written by Darwin to thank an American geologist, Dr. Ferdinand Vandeveer Hayden, for sending him copies of his research into the geology of the region that would become Yellowstone National Park.
geology.cn: 达尔文写这封信是为了要感谢美国的地质学家费迪南德·范迪维尔·海登博士，感谢海登把他自己对一个区域所做的地质研究的副本寄给了他，该地区也就是后来的黄石国家公园。

germ.en: An urban food myth contends that if food spends just a few seconds on the floor, dirt and germs won't have much of a chance to contaminate it.
germ.cn: 一个关于食物的都市传说认为，如果食物在地上停留几秒钟，污垢和细菌就不会有太多机会污染它。
germ.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

gesture.en: Eventually, these gestures turned into full sign language.
gesture.cn: 随着时间推移，这些手势逐渐发展成了完整的手语系统。
gesture.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

ghost.en: Songdo's reputation is as a futuristic ghost town.
ghost.cn: 松岛市被誉为未来主义的鬼城。
ghost.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

giant.en: These devices are powered by software from the giant electronics company, KaiOS Technologies Limited.
giant.cn: 这些设备由电子巨头KaiOS技术有限公司的软件驱动。

gigantic.en: Regardless of their genetic makeup, infants have to learn an incredible amount of information in a short time, and curiosity is one of the tools humans have found to accomplish that gigantic task.
gigantic.cn: 无论基因构成如何，婴儿都必须在短时间内学习大量的信息，而好奇心是人类找到的完成这项艰巨任务的工具之一。

given.en: This finding is surprising, given that bitterness often serves as a warning mechanism to convince people to spit out harmful substances, scientists said.
given.cn: 科学家表示，这一研究结论颇为意外，因为苦味通常充当一种警示机制，促使人们把有害物质吐出来。
given.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

glance.en: At first glance , the town is a typical dying mill center.
glance.cn: 第一眼看去，这个小城是一个典型的正在衰退的工厂中心。

glimpse.en: This little story turns out to be a fascinating glimpse at the challenges cities face as they try to update their urban infrastructure — to clean up the air, reduce greenhouse emissions, and speed up travel by making towns more bike-friendly.
glimpse.cn: 这个小故事为我们提供了一个引人入胜的视角，让我们看到城市在升级基础设施时面临的挑战——净化空气、减少温室气体排放、通过打造更友好的骑行环境来提升出行效率。
glimpse.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

global.en: The global fruit and vegetable juices market was valued at $154 billion in 2016 and is expected to grow.
global.cn: 2016年全球果蔬汁市场价值达1540亿美元，预计将持续增长。
global.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

glorious.en: The island boasts a beautiful wilderness with dense forests, glorious , unspoilt sandy beaches and plenty of bays and a few mountainous areas where there are good walking tracks among the wetlands and valleys.
glorious.cn: 该岛拥有美丽的荒野，密林、壮丽且未受破坏的沙滩，众多海湾以及一些山地地区，其中有穿越湿地与山谷的良好步道。

glow.en: When night falls, red and blue and other colors cast a hazy glow over a city lit up by tens of thousands of neon signs.
glow.cn: 当夜幕降临时，红色和蓝色以及其他颜色在成千上万的霓虹灯标志照亮的城市上投下朦胧的光芒。

glue.en: It has some glue on it that has colored it slightly, but nothing that will prevent us from using it.
glue.cn: 信纸上面有些胶水，这些胶水使它有轻微变色，但是我们仍然可以使用它。

goodness.en: They believed in goodness , in community, and helping one another.
goodness.cn: 他们主张行善、信任社区、互帮互助。

gorgeous.en: It's not just the lack of light but the lack of noise that's so delightful on this unique and gorgeous scene.
gorgeous.cn: 这里的独特景色迷人，不仅因为灯光稀少，更因为寂静无声。

gossip.en: My co-workers would all be friendly with one another, without ever falling into the office gossip trap.
gossip.cn: 我的同事彼此间都非常友好，不会陷入办公室八卦的陷阱中。

govern.en: Instead of using words for precise quantities, these people rely exclusively on terms similar to "a few" or "some." In contrast, our own lives are governed by numbers.
govern.cn: 这些人不使用精确的数量词，只依赖类似“少量”或“一些”这样的词汇。相比之下，我们自己的生活是被数字支配的。

governor.en: But this is a green tax, which Bali Governor Wayan Koster has been working on for months, and which is designed to help clean up the island’s natural environment, and with good reason, too.
governor.cn: 不过，这是环保税，巴厘岛州长瓦严·科斯特为此努力了几个月。这项环保税是为了帮助清洁该岛的自然环境而设，合乎情理。
governor.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

grab.en: It's hot so you grab a bottle of water from a local vendor.
grab.cn: 天太热了，于是你连忙从当地小贩那里买了瓶水。

grace.en: Red Rum's spirit and grace had already begun to charm the leagues of Grand National fans.
grace.cn: Red Rum的斗志与优雅已开始赢得国家赛事粉丝们的心。
grace.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

gracious.en: For this reason, it can be helpful to be gracious in your response.
gracious.cn: 因此，礼貌地回应会很有帮助。
gracious.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

gradually.en: In the same way that learning a language or new skills takes time, building financial skills requires practice and years to gradually accumulate bits and pieces of knowledge.
gradually.cn: 就像学习语言或新技能需要时间一样，培养金融技能也需要练习和多年的时间才能逐渐积累知识。

graduate.en: Many years ago, I wrote about a study which found that employers are much more likely to hire a college graduate who has some work experience in the industry than a college graduate who took the “right” degree.
graduate.cn: 多年前，我写过一项研究，发现雇主更愿意雇佣有行业工作经验的大学毕业生，而不是拿着"对口"学位的毕业生。

grant.en: Today, most scientific research is funded by government grants, companies doing research and development, and non-profit foundations.
grant.cn: 如今，大部分科学研究是由政府资助、从事研发的公司或非营利基金会提供资金。
grant.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

grasp.en: Yes, you'll probably start to grasp information a lot quicker that way.
grasp.cn: 是的，或许你可以用这种方式更快地充分理解信息。
grasp.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

grassy.en: But when a grassy area was planted with bushes, the children got much more into fantasy play…
grassy.cn: 但当一片草地种上灌木，孩子们就更喜欢进行幻想游戏了。

grateful.en: I am so grateful to the team members who contributed through its nearly 25-year history.
grateful.cn: 我由衷感谢那些在近25年历程中为团队做出贡献的成员们。
grateful.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

gratitude.en: The social experiment showed that 99 out of 100 people expressed gratitude.
gratitude.cn: 社会实验表明，100 人中有 99 人表达了感激之情。
gratitude.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

grave.en: But there’s a growing body of evidence suggesting that today’s young adults are also drowning in credit-card debt—and that many of them will take this debt to their graves .
grave.cn: 但是越来越多的证据表明今天的年轻人也陷入了信用卡债务，很多人甚至要把这些欠债带进坟墓。

gravity.en: Whether it was the gravity force of the plane climbing or the noise of the engine, it put our three-year-old daughter instantly to sleep until we bumped down on the grass at Claris Airport.
gravity.cn: 不论是飞机爬升时的重力感，还是发动机的噪声，都让我们三岁的女儿瞬间入睡，直到我们在克拉里斯机场的草地上降落。

greenhouse.en: This little story turns out to be a fascinating glimpse at the challenges cities face as they try to update their urban infrastructure — to clean up the air, reduce greenhouse emissions, and speed up travel by making towns more bike-friendly.
greenhouse.cn: 这个小故事为我们提供了一个引人入胜的视角，让我们看到城市在升级基础设施时面临的挑战——净化空气、减少温室气体排放、通过打造更友好的骑行环境来提升出行效率。
greenhouse.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

grief.en: Sometimes people cannot cry despite genuine grief .
grief.cn: 有时候，人们尽管真的伤心，却也不能哭。

grind.en: Ahead—and so the traffic grinds to a halt over nothing, Horn said.
grind.cn: 前方——于是交通无缘无故地陷入停滞，霍恩如是说。
grind.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

grip.en: He was an extraordinary director who entertained his audience with engaging and gripping suspense movies.
grip.cn: 他是一位杰出的导演，以引人入胜的悬疑电影征服了观众。
grip.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

gross.en: The main measure of economic progress is the gross national product(GNP).
gross.cn: 衡量经济发展的主要指标是国民生产总值（GNP）。

guarantee.en: It guarantees the achievement of goals otherwise unattainable.
guarantee.cn: 它能确保实现原本难以达成的目标。

guideline.en: It could also help to enter these situations with clear guidelines and ideas of what you want from the range of options, which can narrow the possible choices, and also make you more confident about your ability to make the right decision.
guideline.cn: 在面对选择时，事先明确自己的标准和需求也会有所帮助，这样可以缩小选择范围，也能让你对自己做出正确决定更有信心。

guilt.en: More than half of the interviewees felt no sense of guilt over cheating.
guilt.cn: 超过半数的受访者对作弊行为没有丝毫愧疚感。
guilt.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

guilty.en: But most of us have conflicting feelings about dressing up and feel guilty about taking the time to focus on clothes.
guilty.cn: 但大多数人对精心打扮都有矛盾的心理，并为花时间关注服装而感到愧疚。

guitar.en: He is currently traveling through North America performing with his guitar and his enthusiasm on his Age of Disruption Tour.
guitar.cn: 他目前正在北美各地巡回演出，带着他的吉他和热情进行他的“颠覆时代”巡回演唱会。

gulf.en: After a 28-hour flight with two travel-sick children, our hearts sank when we saw the tiny twin engine 10-seater that was to take us the 90 km across the Hauraki Gulf to Great Barrier Island.
gulf.cn: 带着两个晕机的孩子完成28小时的飞行后，当我们看到要带我们穿越豪拉基湾前往大障礁岛的那架小型双引擎10座飞机时，我们的心一下子沉了下来。
gulf.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

gum.en: In addition to tooth decay, there are also gum diseases to watch out for.
gum.cn: 除了蛀牙，还需注意牙龈疾病。
gum.source: 2014年12月英语四级 第3套 听力

hail.en: Many women engineers hailed the benefits of their chosen career.
hail.cn: 众多女性工程师都对自己所选职业的优势赞不绝口。
hail.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

halt.en: These are generally known as “phantom” traffic jams, in which dense traffic crawls to a halt for no apparent reason at all.
halt.cn: 这些通常被称为"幻影"交通堵塞，指的是密集的车流在没有明显原因的情况下突然停滞。
halt.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

hand.en: She didn't hand in her first two assignments for chemistry, which started her out in the class with a failing grade.
hand.cn: 她前两次的化学作业没有上交，致使她在这门课程刚开始时就不及格了。
hand.source: 2018年6月大学英语四级考试真题（一）

handicap.en: Even people who have a physical disease or handicap may be "well," in this new sense, if they make an effort to maintain the best possible health they can in the face of their physical limitations.
handicap.cn: 即使患有身体疾病或残疾的人，如果努力在身体限制下保持尽可能好的健康状态，从这个新意义上讲，他们也可以是“健康的”。

handy.en: Taking whatever materials are handy and tinkering with them is a simple way to engage those important "maker" skills.
handy.cn: 利用手边的任何材料，让孩子们去鼓捣小玩意，这是运用那些重要的“制造者”技能的一个简单方法。

harden.en: This process can be compared to the way the skin hardens in response to constant rubbing or pressure.
harden.cn: 这一过程就像是皮肤在持续的摩擦或压迫下逐渐变硬一样。

hardware.en: And human drivers need to consent to take responsibility for the outcomes of the software and hardware.
hardware.cn: 此外，人类驾驶员还需要同意承担软件和硬件操作结果的责任。
hardware.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

harmonious.en: A harmonious relationship among its students.

harness.en: So executives at Aladdin hit on an idea that would harness the newfound popularity of television.
harness.cn: 所以阿拉丁的主管们想到了一个主意：利用新兴的、广泛普及的电视。
harness.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

harsh.en: It may sound harsh , but the truth is, nobody cares.
harsh.cn: 这话听起来可能有些刻薄，但真相是，没人关心。

haste.en: The middle-aged person, Barth continued, can see death in the distance, but moves with a "measured haste" to get big new things done while there is still time.
haste.cn: 巴特继续说道，中年人虽然能看到死亡的临近，但仍然会“有条不紊地加快步伐”，趁着还有时间去做一些新的大事。
haste.source: 2017年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

hatch.en: The changing climate makes it difficult for their eggs to hatch.
hatch.cn: 气候变化使它们的卵很难孵化。

haul.en: In the fable, Maui hauled the North Island of New Zealand from the bottom of the ocean with his hook.
haul.cn: 在那个寓言中，毛伊用钩子将新西兰北岛从海底拉了起来。

haunt.en: If we're lucky, the legal environment will change to make teenager's online lives less likely to haunt them later on.
haunt.cn: 如果幸运的话，法律环境将会改善，从而减少青少年网络行为对他们未来的负面影响。

hazard.en: Diets containing large amounts of fibre reduce the risk of heart disease, diabetes and other health hazards .
hazard.cn: 富含膳食纤维的饮食可以降低患心脏病、糖尿病和其他健康危害的风险。

heading.en: If you get a yes to your request for a chat, you'll be armed with some pretty powerful and helpful information heading into your interview!
heading.cn: 如果你的聊天请求获得批准，你将在面试前掌握一些非常强大且有用的信息！

headquarters.en: The Human Development Index — a measure of life expectancy, education and per capita income — gives East San Jose a score of 4.85 out of 10, while nearby Cupertino, where Apple’s headquarters sits, receives a 9.26.
