headquarters.cn: 人类发展指数衡量预期寿命、受教育程度和人均收入，按照这个指标，东圣何塞得分为4.85分（满分为10分），而附近的苹果总部所在地库比蒂诺得分为9.26分。
headquarters.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

heal.en: Don't worry, usually ankle injuries heal quickly if you stop regular activities for a while.
heal.cn: 别担心，如果你停止一段时间的日常活动，通常脚踝的伤势很快就会痊愈。

heap.en: The moon is also home to lunar orbiters that mapped the moon before they crashed into its surface, adding to the garbage heap.
heap.cn: 月球上还曾放置过月球轨道探测器，这些探测器在撞击月球表面之前绘制了月球地图，最终也因此成为了月球垃圾堆的一部分。
heap.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

heel.en: "I'm a fashionable person, so now I'm back in my 3-inch heels," she says.
heel.cn: 她说：“我是一个时尚的人，因此我现在又穿上了我3英寸高的高跟鞋。”
heel.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（三）

heighten.en: Put another way, people who have a heightened ability to taste the bitterness of coffee learn to associate"good things with it," Cornelis said.
heighten.cn: “换句话说，更能尝出咖啡苦味的人，会学会把它与‘好事’联系起来，”科内利斯说。
heighten.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

helpless.en: Exercise alone is not likely to prevent Alzheimer's, but the study shows people are not helpless in the face of one of the most feared, costliest and common diseases of old age, he added.
helpless.cn: 他补充道，单靠运动不太可能预防阿尔茨海默病，但研究显示，人们在面对这种最令人畏惧、费用最高且普遍的老年疾病时并非无能为力。

hence.en: Hence , his movies are symbolic of the guilt and innocence of the wrongdoer and the victim.
hence.cn: 因此，他的电影往往象征性地展现了犯罪者的罪行与受害者的无辜。

herd.en: The new baby expands the zoo's elephant herd to six that includes the baby's parents, a sister, a brother and an adult female.
herd.cn: 新出生的幼崽将动物园象群的成员数扩大到了6头，其中包括这头幼崽的父母，姐姐，兄长和一头成年母象。
herd.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

heritage.en: The area around Mahmudia, which is a UNESCO World Heritage site, is the third-most biodiverse in the world, after Australia's Great Barrier Reef and the Galapagos Islands.
heritage.cn: 马赫穆迪亚周边地区是联合国教科文组织世界遗产，是世界上生物多样性第三丰富的地区，仅次于澳大利亚的大堡礁和加拉帕戈斯群岛。
heritage.source: 2020年7月英语四级 第1套 听力

hesitate.en: …I have never hesitated to head for even the most remote of places…
hesitate.cn: 即使是最遥远的地方，我也毫不犹豫地前往……

highlight.en: The key is to highlight the emotional response a consumer will have by using the product.
highlight.cn: 关键在于突出消费者使用产品后所产生的情感反应。

highly.en: Highly processed foods — the kinds made with lots of sugar, fat and salt — make up as much as sixty percent of the average American diet, but a new study shows that their low price and convenience come at a cost to health.
highly.cn: 高度加工食品——那些含有大量糖、脂肪和盐的食品——占美国人通常饮食的60%，但一项新研究显示，它们的低价和便利性是以健康为代价的。

hijack.en: But obviously it didn't hijack the news agenda in the manner of a major terrorist attack or declaration of war.
hijack.cn: 但很显然，它没有以重大恐怖袭击或宣战的方式来控制新闻议程。
hijack.source: 2020年7月大学英语六级考试真题

hindrance.en: It was simply a hindrance they had to get over to excel.
hindrance.cn: 这只是他们取得优异成绩必须克服的一个障碍。
hindrance.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

hint.en: Indeed, the study adds to previous research hinting at a dark side of emotional intelligence.
hint.cn: 事实上，这项研究进一步证实了之前的研究结果，这些研究暗示了情商的阴暗面。

historic.en: The labor market is likely cooling, because even a shortage of workers isn't overcoming the historic imbalance between employers and employees in the US: the volume of income that workers take home as a proportion of what the US economy produces is still falling.
historic.cn: 劳动力市场可能正在冷却，因为即使劳动力短缺，也无法克服美国雇主与雇员之间的历史性失衡：工人收入占美国经济产出的比重仍在下降。

historical.en: That's a month earlier than normal and something that's happened only once before in the historical record in 2016.
historical.cn: 这比正常情况早了一个月，且这样的情况在有历史记录以来仅在2016年出现过一次。

hollow.en: The hollowed -out A300 was of everything potentially harmful to the environment and sunk off the Aegean coast today.
hollow.cn: 这架被掏空的A300飞机装满了所有可能对环境有害的物质，今天沉没在爱琴海沿岸。

hook.en: Our daughter was especially taken with Hilde's narrating of the Maori myth of Maui's fish hook to explain the shape of Scorpius.
hook.cn: 我们的女儿尤其喜欢希尔德讲述毛利神话中毛伊用鱼钩解释天蝎座形状的故事。
hook.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

horizon.en: The importance of broadening children's horizons .
horizon.cn: 拓展儿童视野的重要性。

horizontal.en: replace straight, horizontal bars with chevrons
horizontal.cn: 用人字形图案代替笔直的水平条纹

horn.en: The result is a piece of bone like a horn that sticks out from the head by the neck.
horn.cn: 因此，头部颈侧就会长出类似角状的骨突。
horn.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

horror.en: "There's part of this sickening horror of knowing you're walking on the edge with this, that I kind of like, knowing that it could all fall apart at any second." Chast's designs, such as a worried man alone in a tiny rowboat, reflect that delicateness.
horror.cn: “知道自己如履薄冰走在危险边缘——我有点儿喜欢这种感觉——知道它随时都可能会被打碎，我会感受到些许令人作呕的恐惧。”查斯特的设计，比如一个独自坐在小划艇里发愁的男性，就反映了这种脆弱。
horror.source: 2017年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

hospitality.en: Takotna has gained a reputation for its dessert-based hospitality since the 1970s. It started with one person, Jan Newton.
hospitality.cn: 自 1970 年代以来，塔科特纳村就以其甜点款待而闻名。这始于一个人，简・牛顿。
hospitality.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

hostile.en: "Antarctica creates a hostile environment," says the operations director for the British Antarctic Survey, "if you are not careful, it'll come around and bite you."
hostile.cn: “南极洲创造了一个恶劣的环境，”英国南极调查局的运营主管说，“如果你不小心，它会反噬你。”

housing.en: Well, I know a great housing agent.
housing.cn: 嗯，我认识一个非常优秀的房产经纪人。

hug.en: ...a child leaving for a field trip might steal one last reassuring hug from Mom before stepping on the bus.
hug.cn: 一个去野外旅行的孩子在踏上巴士之前，可能会从妈妈那儿偷偷获取最后一个令人安心的拥抱。

humanity.en: Such planting is a small step for humanity—in the right direction.
humanity.cn: 这样的植树造林是人类朝着正确方向迈出的一小步。
humanity.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

humble.en: But researchers have come to realize that being humble generally indicates the presence of deeply admirable personal qualities.
humble.cn: 但是研究人员已经意识到，谦逊通常表明具备令人深感钦佩的个人品质。

hut.en: Brands, which also owns Taco Belland Pizza Hut , has launched a chicken sandwich that costs around $5.
hut.cn: 旗下还拥有 Taco Bell 和 Pizza Hut 的 Brands 公司推出了一款售价约为 5 美元的鸡肉三明治。

icy.en: In particular, dangerous conditions such as icy roads or wet ground could cause difficulty for drivers.
icy.cn: 值得注意的是，道路结冰或地面湿滑等恶劣天气条件可能会给驾驶员造成麻烦。
icy.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

ideal.en: The ideal level of perfectly livable habitat was found to be only 80% of an area, with the remainder either too harsh or too affected by human activity.
ideal.cn: 研究发现，理想的完全宜居栖息地比例应该只占区域的80%，其余部分要么环境过于恶劣，要么受到人类活动的影响。
ideal.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

identical.en: By comparing identical twins, who share nearly 100 percent of their genes, and non-identical twins, who share about half, researchers have found overwhelming evidence for genetic effects on behaviors.
identical.cn: 通过比较几乎共享全部基因的同卵双胞胎与约共享一半基因的异卵双胞胎，研究人员找到了大量基因对行为产生影响的有力证据。

identification.en: There are tools to compare one's DNA with others'to find distant relatives based on their genetic identification.
identification.cn: 现有工具可以将个人DNA与他人进行比对,根据基因特征寻找远房亲戚。
identification.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

identify.en: The researchers were able to identify the causes behind these seemingly paradoxical results, too: themselves less with machines than with other people.
identify.cn: 研究人员也能找出这些看似矛盾结果的背后原因：他们与机器的关系比与其他人的关系要相对疏远。
identify.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

idle.cn: 别再原地踏步，要胸怀大志。

ignorance.en: However, after talking to my friends who felt the same, I quickly realised that it wasn't my ignorance but the lack of financial education in our schooling system that is leaving high schoolers seriously behind in the modern world of money.
ignorance.cn: 然而，在与有同样感受的朋友们交谈后，我很快意识到，这不是我的无知，而是我们学校教育体系中缺乏金融教育，导致高中生在现代金融世界中严重落后。

illegal.cn: 反对者将其称作非法露营。

illusion.en: Although Leslie perhaps paints a bit broadly in contending that most of us are unaware of how much we don’t know, he’s surely right to point out that the problem is growing: “Google can give us the powerful illusion that all questions have definite answers.”
illusion.cn: 莱斯利认为我们中的大多数人都没有意识到自己到底有多少不知道的东西，尽管在这一点上莱斯利或许有点言过其实，但他指出这个问题在不断加剧无疑是有道理的：“谷歌会使我们产生一个巨大的错觉，即所有问题都有明确的答案。

illustrate.en: To illustrate how to tell a story using music.

illustration.en: The color of the wrapper is similar, as are the illustrations of the features.
illustration.cn: 包装纸的颜色相似，产品特征的图案设计也很相近。

imaginary.en: Things haven't turned out exactly as I imagined, but I wouldn't change what I have now for that imaginary world.
imaginary.cn: 事情的发展与我想象的不完全一致，但我不会愿意用现有的一切去换取理想中的那个世界。

imaginative.en: Some of these students are very imaginative .
imaginative.cn: 这些学生中有些人极具想象力。

imitate.en: Newer varieties imitate the look, flavor, and texture of meat.
imitate.cn: 新一代的植物肉在外观、风味和口感上都更加逼真地模仿了真肉。

imitation.en: Most imitation meats are highly processed and contain high amounts of sodium compared to traditional beef.
imitation.cn: 大多数仿肉产品都经过高度加工，与传统牛肉相比含有较高的钠含量。
imitation.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

immense.en: Since Steve Jobs resigned as chief executive of Apple, much has been said about him as a peerless business leader who has created immense wealth for shareholders, and guided the design of hit products that are transforming entire industries, like music and mobile communications.
immense.cn: 自从史蒂夫·乔布斯辞去苹果公司首席执行官一职以来，人们对他作为一位无与伦比的商业领袖的评价很高，认为他为股东创造了巨大的财富，并指导设计了正在改变整个行业的爆款产品，例如音乐和移动通信。

immigrant.en: Over 40% of Fortune 500 companies had a founder who was either an immigrant or the child of one.
immigrant.cn: 超过 40% 的财富 500 强公司创始人是移民或移民子女。
immigrant.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

immigrate.en: Most students don't, for example, learn about the laws that for years excluded Asians from immigrating to the U. S.
immigrate.cn: 例如，大多数学生并不了解多年来阻止亚洲人移民到美国的法律。

impatient.en: He has become somewhat impatient with the woman.
impatient.cn: 他对那个女人有些不耐烦了。
impatient.source: 2015年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

implement.en: The decision was not made lightly, but some recent events pushed them to implement this new policy.
implement.cn: 这一决定并非草率做出，而是近期发生的一些事件促使他们实施了这项新政策。

implication.en: Chief executive John Kampfner of the Creative Industries Federation thinks that this drop in figures has worrying implications for the skills pipeline in Britain's hugely successful arts and creative industries.
implication.cn: 创意产业联合会的首席执行官约翰·坎普夫纳认为，这一数据下降对英国极为成功的艺术和创意产业的人才培养渠道有着令人担忧的影响。

imply.en: What does the author imply people in developed countries should do to keep healthy?
imply.cn: 作者暗示发达国家的人们应该如何保持健康？

import.en: Additionally, recycling facilities may be improved at a local council level and recycled plastic could be imported.
import.cn: 此外，回收设施可能会在地方议会层面得到改善，回收塑料可以进口。
import.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

impose.cn: 同时还会处以300美元的罚款。

impress.en: I'm always impressed by the levels of confidence and the support the students get from their teachers.
impress.cn: 学生们表现出的自信水平以及他们从老师那里获得的支持总是让我印象深刻。

impression.en: It's important not to undermine the significance of the first few days of your job, since this is the best time to create a solid first impression .
impression.cn: 不要忽视入职头几天的重要性，因为这是留下良好第一印象的最佳时机。

impressive.en: Now, this impressive new accomplishment validates Eleven Madison Park's decision to take meat off the menu and embrace plant-based foods, with Michelin's 2022 New York guide branding it a 'bold vision of luxury dining'.
impressive.cn: 如今，这一令人瞩目的新成就验证了十一麦迪逊公园餐厅将肉类撤出菜单、拥抱植物性食品的决定，米其林2022年纽约指南将其誉为"奢华餐饮的大胆愿景"。
impressive.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

improvement.en: Today's historians agree that overall, the standards of living increase. They do not agree, however, on when this improvement occurred. In an effort to solve this controversy, historians have attempted to define exactly what "standard of living" means.
improvement.cn: 当今的历史学家普遍认为，生活水平整体上提高了，但他们对这一改善发生的时间并不一致。为了化解这一争议，历史学家试图准确定义“生活水平”的含义。
improvement.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

incidence.en: In a few years, researchers should be able to offer clearer advice on exercise and other lifestyle changes for reducing the incidence of Alzheimer's.
incidence.cn: 在未来几年内，研究人员应该能够就减少阿尔茨海默病发病率的运动和其他生活方式改变提供更明确的建议。

incident.en: It also highlights incidents of fishing boats being involved in groundings, oil spills and accidents, which posed a serious threat to the Antarctic ecosystem.
incident.cn: 报告还强调渔船遭遇搁浅陆地事件、石油流出及其他事故，都会对南极生态系统构成严重的威胁。
incident.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（三）

inclination.en: It takes advantage of teenagers' natural inclination .
inclination.cn: 它利用了青少年天生的这种倾向。

incline.en: We are inclined to think that a lack of knowledge prevents us from advancing to a better future.
incline.cn: 我们往往认为，知识的匮乏阻碍了我们迈向更美好的未来。

inclusive.en: Having women properly represented in all aspects of university life is not only a sign of a fair and inclusive society; it can also lead to a more cohesive, collaborative academic community.
inclusive.cn: 让女性在大学生活的各个方面起一定的代表作用不仅是社会公平和包容的一个标志，它也能引领一个更具凝聚力和协作力的学术社群。

increasingly.en: "Most large animals that eat meat live in increasingly fragmented landscapes,” said Sillero, who was not involved in the research.
increasingly.cn: "大多数食肉大型动物如今生活在日益碎片化的环境中，"未参与该研究的西勒罗说。
increasingly.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

incredible.en: Wide awake at 3:30 am with our nine-year-old daughter on our lodge balcony, I stared for hours at the most incredible night sky I've ever seen before the dawn slowly started to rub out the stars on the horizon and the multiple shooting stars faded away.
incredible.cn: 凌晨3:30，我和九岁的女儿坐在小屋阳台上彻夜未眠，我凝视着这辈子见过的最美的夜空，直到黎明慢慢开始抹去天边的星星，许多流星也渐渐消失。
incredible.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

independence.en: What do you mean by financial independence ?
independence.cn: 你说的财务独立是什么意思？

independent.en: This is the first trial that demonstrates that there is something about highly processed foods independent of those nutrients that causes people to overeat.
independent.cn: 这次试验首次证明，高度加工食品本身有导致人们过度饮食的原因，而不仅仅是因为其营养成分。

index.en: Researchers have shown that body mass index is related to wages and income.
index.cn: 研究人员表明，体重指数与工资和收入息息相关。
index.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

indicate.en: In the presence of many visitors, elephants were less likely to use repetitive behaviours which often indicate boredom.
indicate.cn: 当有大量访客在场时，大象不太容易表现出那些常被视为无聊的重复行为。

indication.en: Despite these limitations, the study's results are yet another indication of the power of physical activity, even in small amounts.
indication.cn: 即便受到这些限制，该研究的结果依旧强调了即便是少量的身体活动也不容小觑。

indifferent.en: They are less and less indifferent to it.
indifferent.cn: 他们对此越来越不冷漠了。

indispensable.en: According to one father, equal parental leave is indispensable to achieving gender equality in the workplace.
indispensable.cn: 一位父亲认为，平等的育儿假对于实现职场性别平等至关重要。
indispensable.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

individual.en: As communities diversified, mutual support could have broadened to include individuals not linked by blood.
individual.cn: 随着社会日趋多元，互助合作的范围可能逐渐扩展至没有血缘关系的个体。

indoor.en: What about playing an indoor sport, like badminton?
indoor.cn: 要不试试室内运动？比如打羽毛球？
indoor.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

induce.en: It's all about making the traveling experience less stressful and blue is said to induce a feeling of calm.
induce.cn: 这都是为了减少旅途的压力，据说蓝色可以引起一种平静的感觉。
induce.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第2套 阅读

industrial.en: One of the biggest controversies over the Industrial Revolution is how it affected the working class.
industrial.cn: 关于工业革命最大的争议之一是它如何影响工人阶级。

industrialize.en: This conclusion is echoed by work with anumeric children in industrialized societies.
industrialize.cn: 这一结论得到了对工业化社会中无数字概念儿童的研究的响应。
industrialize.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

inevitable.en: Remember, failure is Inevitable , and every failure you survive is a learning experience.
inevitable.cn: 记住，失败是不可避免的，你每一次从失败中坚持下来都是一次学习的经历。

infant.en: Adults dream during REM (rapid eye movement) sleep and infants have loads of REM. So, it might be fair to assume that babies have tons of dreams.
infant.cn: 成年人在快速眼动睡眠(REM)期间做梦,而婴儿有大量的快速眼动睡眠。因此,我们有理由认为婴儿也会做很多梦。

infect.cn: 这条蛇是否感染了病毒。
infect.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

infectious.en: Is it possible to enjoy a peaceful life in a world that is increasingly challenged by threats and uncertainties from wars, terrorism, economic crises and a widespread outbreak of infectious diseases?
infectious.cn: 在一个日益受到战争、恐怖主义、经济危机以及大范围爆发的传染病带来的种种威胁和不确定因素挑战的世界，人们是否能享受平静的生活呢？
infectious.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

infer.en: What can we infer about nightmares from the passage?
infer.cn: 从文章中我们可以推断出关于噩梦的哪些信息？

inferior.en: Brain scientists call this effect "asymmetric dominance" and it means that people gravitate toward the choice nearest a clearly inferior option.
inferior.cn: 大脑科学家称这种效应为“不对称影响力”，这意味着人们倾向于选择最接近明显劣势的选项。

infinite.en: They are an infinite source of human knowledge.
infinite.cn: 它们是人类知识的无穷源泉。

inflation.en: According to the Bank of England's inflation calculator, 200 pounds in 1921 would be worth 7,750 pounds today.
inflation.cn: 根据英格兰银行的通胀计算器，1921年的200英镑在今天价值7,750英镑。

influence.en: This sensitivity isn't simply a matter of taste, either, but rather is influenced by a person's genetic makeup, the researchers said in the study.
influence.cn: 研究人员在论文中指出，这种敏感性不仅仅是口味问题，而是受个人基因构成的影响。

influential.en: Famously referred to as "The Master of Suspense," Hitchcock is one of the most influential filmmakers in the history of cinema.
influential.cn: 希区柯克被誉为"悬疑大师"，是电影史上最具影响力的导演之一。

inform.en: They weren't informed of the school's updated rules.
inform.cn: 他们事先并不了解学校更新后的规章制度。

ingredient.en: If you’ve ever looked at the ingredients list while grocery shopping, chances are you’ve seen the term “natural flavors”.
ingredient.cn: 在采购食品杂货时，如果你有看到过商品的成分表，那么你有可能见过“天然香料”这一词语。
ingredient.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

inhabitant.en: Davida Herzl, Aclima's boss, says they have revealed pollution highs on days when San Francisco's transit workers went on strike and the city's inhabitants were forced to use their cars.
inhabitant.cn: 该公司的老板达维达·赫茨尔称，在旧金山运输工人罢工，城市居民被迫使用私家车的那段时间里，他们揭露出污染数值达到高点。
inhabitant.source: 2018年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

inherit.en: It may be inherited or cultivated.
inherit.cn: 它可能是遗传的，也可能是后天培养的。

initial.en: After initial exercise tests in middle age, researchers followed the women for 44 years.
initial.cn: 在中年时期进行初步的运动测试后，研究人员对这些女性进行了长达44年的跟踪研究。
initial.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

initiate.en: The study also found that someone who is humble is more likely to initiate a romantic relationship, perhaps because they're less likely to see themselves as "too good" for someone else.
initiate.cn: 该研究还发现，谦逊的人更有可能开始一段恋情，或许这是因为他们往往不会认为自己对别人来说“高不可攀”。

initiative.cn: 其他地方也有类似的举措。

injure.en: However, people did report a few disadvantages to pet ownership These included difficulty traveling and financial strains. 6% of pet owners said they'd fallen or injured themselves as a result of having a pet.
injure.cn: 然而，人们也指出了养宠物的一些不利因素，包括旅行困难和经济负担。6%的宠物主人表示，他们因为养宠物而跌倒或伤到自己。
injure.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

inland.en: But it may be that some smaller towns inland remain not very well connected, is that OK?
inland.cn: 但内陆一些较小的城镇可能仍然交通不便，这样可以吗？

innocent.en: A soldier deviates when they choose not to follow orders to kill an innocent civilian.
innocent.cn: 当士兵选择不服从杀害无辜平民的命令时，他们就越轨了。
innocent.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

innovation.en: For all the innovation and choice that define the food and drink industries, if you want to make money, you could do a lot worse than fill a bottle with water and sell it.
innovation.cn: 尽管食品饮料行业充满了创新和选择，但如果你想赚钱，装瓶水出售也算是一个不错的选择。

input.en: The work is just helping out with data input .
input.cn: 这份工作就是帮助输入数据。

inquire.en: To inquire about the vegetarian food festival.
inquire.cn: 询问有关素食美食节的信息。
inquire.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

inquiry.en: I have an inquiry to make.
inquiry.cn: 我有个问题想咨询一下。
inquiry.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

insert.en: With his letter, Aderhold inserted West Windsor-Plainsboro Regional School District into a national discussion about the intense focus on achievement at elite schools, and whether it has gone too far.
insert.cn: 通过这封信，阿德霍尔德把西温莎—普林斯堡学区引入了一场关于精英学校极其关注学习成绩，以及该问题是否已经太过严重的全国性讨论之中。

insight.en: However, it's crucial that you get to know the people who have decision-making authority to gain insight regarding how the business is run and decisions are made.
insight.cn: 然而，结识那些拥有决策权的人至关重要，这样才能深入了解企业的运营方式和决策过程。

insist.en: Over the years, many scholars have insisted that time online does not necessarily take away time spent engaging with traditional media or on other activities.
insist.cn: 多年来，许多学者坚持认为，上网时间不一定会挤占用于接触传统媒介或其他活动上的时间。

inspect.en: They set off to inspect the site of the plane crash.
inspect.cn: 他们出发前往飞机坠毁现场进行勘察。

inspector.source: 2015年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

inspiration.en: It's easy to spend all day searching for inspiration .
inspiration.cn: 很容易就会花上一整天时间来找灵感。

inspire.en: Telling stories is one of the most powerful means leaders have to influence, teach and inspire.
inspire.cn: 讲故事是领导者影响、教育和激励的最有效的手段之一。
inspire.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

instinct.en: Human brains come equipped with certain quantitative instincts that are refined with age, but these instincts are very limited.
instinct.cn: 人类的大脑天生具备某种定量本能，随着年龄的增长会不断完善，但是这种本能是有限的。
instinct.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

institution.en: Today, researchers are likely to be funded by a mix of grants from various government agencies, institutions , and foundations.
institution.cn: 如今，研究人员通常会获得来自不同政府机构、院校和基金会的多种资助。

instruct.en: For example, in one task, research participants were instructed to create new college majors by combining two or more existing academic Arts or Science programs at their university.
instruct.cn: 譬如，在一项任务中，受试者被要求结合自己大学里现有的两门或多门文科或理科课程来创建出新的大学专业。

instruction.en: And it has never been easier or cheaper to gain instruction in new skills, thanks to the internet.
instruction.cn: 多亏了互联网，学习新技能从未如此容易和便宜。

instructor.en: The study found that students sitting in the front and center had a clearer view of the blackboard and could focus more attention on the instructor .
instructor.cn: 研究发现，坐在前排中间的学生看黑板更清楚，能更专注地听讲。

instrument.en: For example, descriptive writing might list the colors an artists used in the painting, or the instrument a composer included in a musical composition, so as to make pictures or sound in the readers' mind, by calling up specific details of the work.
instrument.cn: 例如，描述性写作可能会列出艺术家在绘画中使用的颜色，或者作曲家在音乐作品中使用的乐器，通过唤起作品的具体细节，在读者的脑海中形成画面或声音。
instrument.source: 2009年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

insult.en: How weird would it be if, one day in the future, everyone had such a car No crazy driving, no insults, no cutting in; traffic laws would be respected and driving much safer.
insult.cn: 如果未来有一天，每个人都开上了这样的车，那该有多奇怪啊！没有疯狂驾驶，没有侮辱，没有插队；交通规则会得到遵守，驾驶也会安全得多。
insult.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

insurance.en: In the U.S., 29% of drivers admit they surf behind the wheel, according to insurance firm State Farm.
insurance.cn: 根据保险公司State Farm的数据，美国29%的司机承认他们开车时会上网冲浪。

intake.en: A greater intake of sugar and salt.
intake.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

integrate.en: It shouldn’t be just a one-day event but a course integrated throughout the whole of high school that would allow students to gradually expand their financial literacy, and would prevent the need for a ‘catch up’ phase once we’re out on our own after graduation.
integrate.cn: 这不应该只是一次性的短期活动，而应该是一门贯穿整个高中阶段的课程。这样不仅能让学生循序渐进地提高金融素养，还能避免他们毕业后独立生活时需要"补课"的窘境。

integrity.en: While outperforming your rivals may provide short-term benefits, the loss of your integrity will have long-term consequences.
integrity.cn: 虽然在竞争中胜出可以带来短期好处，但一旦失去了诚信，就可能面临长远的负面影响。

intellectual.en: A permanent underestimation of one's own abilities is often accompanied by the fear that this supposed intellectual deception will be exposed sooner or later and that they will pay the price for this.
intellectual.cn: 对自身能力的长期低估常伴随着一种恐惧，害怕这种所谓的智力欺骗迟早会被揭穿，并为此付出代价。
intellectual.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

intelligence.en: Seventy-six participants completed a range of intelligence tests and received positive feedback on them, regardless of their actual performance.
intelligence.cn: 76名参与者完成了一系列智力测试，无论实际表现如何，他们都得到了积极的反馈。
intelligence.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

intelligent.en: They observed that there is a particularly high number of successful women who do not think they are very intelligent.
intelligent.cn: 他们发现，有相当多的成功女性并不认为自己很聪明。
intelligent.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

intend.en: The use of rows and their minimal adaptations to "U" shape were traditionally intended to maximize on-task behavior.
intend.cn: 过去，采用直线布局并对其进行最小程度的“U”形调整，其目的在于最大程度地促进任务相关行为。

intense.en: Police suspect the eggs came from a freighter that lost part of its cargo during an unusually intense storm, the worst to hit Germany's northeastern coast since 2006.
intense.cn: 警方怀疑这些蛋来自一艘货轮，这艘货轮在一场异常强烈的风暴中损失了部分货物，这是自2006年以来袭击德国东北海岸的最严重风暴。
intense.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 阅读

intensity.en: Yet whereas most countries have detailed, evidence-backed guidelines on the type and intensity of exercise required for various physical health benefits, such guidelines do not yet exist for exercise and mood.
intensity.cn: 然而，虽然大多数国家都制定了详尽的、有证据支持的关于各类对身体健康有益的所需运动类型和强度的指南，但针对运动与情绪之间关系的这类指南尚未建立。

intensive.en: Despite intensive academic debate on these developments, there has been little study on how workers react to being replaced through technology.
intensive.cn: 尽管学术界对这些发展进行了激烈的争论，但就工人如何回应被技术取代的研究却少之甚少。

intent.en: "There is always this kind of slip between concern, intent and changed behaviour," says Giles Quick, an analyst of bottled water.
intent.cn: 瓶装水分析师吉尔斯·奎克表示：“在关注、意图和行为改变之间总是存在这种脱节现象。”

intention.en: He says: "When we practice something, we are involved in the deliberate repetition of a process with the intention of reaching a specific goal."
intention.cn: 他说：“当我们练习某件事时，我们是在有意识地重复某个过程，目的是达到某个特定的目标。”
intention.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

interact.en: And research shows that interacting with pets can bring many of the same benefits.
interact.cn: 研究表明，与宠物互动也能带来许多相似的好处。
interact.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

interaction.en: Teachers reported forming stronger connections with students who sat in front, possibly due to increased eye contact, visibility, and interaction .
interaction.cn: 教师表示，他们与坐在前排的学生建立了更紧密的联系，这可能是因为眼神交流、可见度和互动都更多。

interfere.en: These changes are severe enough to interfere with social or occupational functioning.
interfere.cn: 这些变化严重到足以干扰社会或职业功能。
interfere.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

interference.en: This type of memory (where you are trying to remember new, but similar information) is particularly vulnerable to interference .
interference.cn: 这一记忆类型（你试着记忆新的但类似的信息）是特别容易受到干扰的。

interior.en: According to one interior designer, when people return home, they want to see colours that cheer them up and give them a hug.
interior.cn: 根据一位室内设计师的说法，当人们回家时，他们希望看到能让他们振作起来并“给他们一个拥抱”的颜色。

intermediate.en: Since fewer than half of Americans say they cook at an intermediate level and only 20% describe their cooking skills as advanced, the crisis is one of confidence.
intermediate.cn: 因为不到一半的美国人形容自己的烹饪技能在中等水平，只有20%的人觉得自己烹饪水平很高，这是一种自信的危机。

internal.en: Europe has abolished many internal borders.
internal.cn: 欧洲已经废除了许多内部边界。
internal.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 听力

interpret.en: Instead, they have decided to interpret how the Industrial Revolution was affected by other events.
interpret.cn: 相反，他们决定解读工业革命如何受到其他事件的影响。
interpret.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

interpretation.en: By influencing our interpretation of symbolic messages.
interpretation.cn: 通过影响我们对符号信息的解读。

interrupt.en: It interrupted traffic for several hours running.
interrupt.cn: 它导致交通中断持续数小时。

interval.en: She'd wake up early, turn on her laptop and chat on Internet dating sites and instant-messaging programs – leaving her bed for only brief intervals.
interval.cn: 她会很早就起床，然后打开笔记本电脑在网络交友网站和即时通信软件上聊天，中间只会离开床一会会儿。
interval.source: 2010年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

interview.en: If you want that new job, you have to learn the job skills, then the interview skills, then the dress part—and you must be perfect at all of them.
interview.cn: 如果你想获得那份新工作，你需要先掌握相关技能，学会面试技巧，再考虑着装形象——而且这些方面都必须做到尽善尽美。

intimate.en: Using voice interaction feels far more intimate than surfing the net the old-fashioned way.
intimate.cn: 使用语音交互比用老式的方式上网要亲密得多。
intimate.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

invalid.en: My benefits became invalid the second I moved out of Ohio.
invalid.cn: 我搬出俄亥俄州的那一刻，我的福利就失效了。

invariably.en: They invariably strengthened connections among colleagues.
invariably.cn: 它们无疑加强了同事之间的联系。

invasion.en: Lying just off the North Sea coast, it found itself struck by an invasion of colored plastic eggs — much to the delight of local children, because the eggs contained toys.
invasion.cn: 北海海岸附近遭到了彩色塑料蛋的入侵——这让当地儿童很高兴，因为蛋里有玩具。

investigate.en: A new study has investigated this question.
investigate.cn: 一项新的研究深入研究了这个问题。

investigation.en: Jordan Jax and Tarod Goodman, both 23, were arrested after evidence gathered in an investigation showed the pair stole mail on multiple occasions using a postal key.
investigation.cn: 调查收集的证据显示，23岁的乔丹·贾克斯和塔罗德·古德曼曾多次使用邮政钥匙盗取邮件，两人因此被捕。

investment.en: They would improve remarkably with more research and investment .
investment.cn: 只要投入更多研究和资金，它们将会有显著的改善。

invisible.en: It creates a kind of cognitive blindness — all of the factors external to a person’s drive and choices that they've made become invisible and fade from view.
invisible.cn: 它造成了一种认知盲点ーー所有外在于个人努力和选择的因素都变得无足轻重，从人们的视野中消失。
invisible.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

involvement.en: But their purpose was limited to providing money for urgent government crises, such as American involvement in the war of 1812.
involvement.cn: 但它们的目的仅限于为紧急的政府危机提供资金，比如美国卷入1812年的战争。
involvement.source: 2020年9月大学英语六级考试真题

irrational.en: People can be so irrational sometimes.
irrational.cn: 人们有时候就是会这么不理性。
irrational.source: 2020年9月大学英语六级考试真题

irrigation.en: Until genetic engineering comes to fruition, other strategies might also help in some places, including applying more fertilizer, implementing better irrigation, using machinery that gets crops out of the field faster or installing storage facilities to delay spoilage.
irrigation.cn: 在等待基因工程硕果的同时，其他一些策略或许也能在特定地区发挥作用，诸如增加施肥量、改进灌溉系统、采用加快作物收割的机械化作业，或者建立储藏设施以减缓食品腐败。
irrigation.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

isolate.en: To prevent themselves from being isolated .

item.en: Well, you’d expect the Design Museum to commission and make some interesting items, but this one was different.
item.cn: 当然，人们会期待设计博物馆委托制作一些有趣的物品，但这件作品却与众不同。
item.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

jail.en: Some of my friends went to jail. Some were killed.
jail.cn: 我的一些朋友坐了牢，一些被杀害。
jail.source: 2020年7月英语四级 第1套 听力

jealousy.en: Although the negative emotions associated with romantic love-fear of loss, disappointment and jealousy-are fairly consistent across cultures, the positive feelings can vary.
jealousy.cn: 尽管与浪漫爱情相关的负面情绪——害怕失去、失望和嫉妒——在不同文化中相当一致，但积极的情感却可能有所不同。
jealousy.source: 2013年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

jeans.en: What does the man say about Japanese jeans at the end of the conversation?
jeans.cn: 对话最后，这位男士对日本牛仔裤说了些什么？
jeans.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

jewel.en: Others elevate the egg into a fancy art, like the heavily jewel -covered "eggs" that were favored by the Russians starting in the 19th century.
jewel.cn: 其他一些传统会提升鸡蛋的地位，将其制成精致的艺术品，比如从19世纪开始受到俄国人喜爱的覆有大量珠宝的“鸡蛋”。

jog.en: And when joggers jog, they don't run the streets.
jog.cn: 慢跑者在慢跑时，并不会去街上跑。

joint.en: Joint efforts to improve the local community.
joint.cn: 共同努力改善当地社区。
joint.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

journal.en: The study, published Wednesday in the journal Neurology, couldn't prove that exercise prevented dementia, and the findings aren't a surprise — it's long been known there's a correlation between exercise and decreased dementia risk — but the results were particularly dramatic.
journal.cn: 这项研究发表在周三的《神经病学》杂志上，虽然无法证明运动可以预防痴呆，结果也并不令人意外——人们早已知道运动与降低痴呆风险之间存在联系——但结果尤为显著。
journal.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

jungle.en: Visitors had a similar effect on some other species too, including polar bears, certain jungle cats and black-tailed plain dogs.
jungle.cn: 访客对包括北极熊、某些丛林猫和黑尾原野犬在内的一些其他物种也产生了类似影响。
jungle.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

junior.en: I designed an eight-session workshop for 91 students whose math grades were declining in their first year of junior high.
junior.cn: 我为91名初中一年级数学成绩下滑的学生设计了一个为期八节的研讨会。其中48名学生只接受了学习技巧方面的指导，而其他学生则参加了学习技巧课程和成长型思维模式课程相结合的学习，在课程中他们学习了成长型思维模式以及如何将其应用于学校作业。
junior.source: 2016年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

jury.en: For now, the jury is still out as to how successful those endeavors will be.
jury.cn: 至于这些尝试能否成功，目前仍未有明确的结论。
jury.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

justice.en: In contrast, the new intervention cleverly exploits teenagers' instinct for rebelliousness and autonomy, and the value they place on social justice .
justice.cn: 相比之下，新的干预措施巧妙地利用了青少年的叛逆心理和自主意识，以及他们对社会正义的重视。

justify.en: The gasoline tax, for instance, is sometimes justified using the benefits principle.
justify.cn: 例如，使用受益原则征收的石油税有时也是合理的。
justify.source: 2014年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

keen.en: Many of the highest earners have a keen interest in and love for what they are doing.
keen.cn: 许多高收入者都对自己的工作抱有极大的兴趣和热情。

kit.en: Winning entries in past years have included a make-your-own cloth kit called Dove Bunting and a threefold, wallet-sized travel game with goals at each end, called Badoiiing.
kit.cn: 过去几年的获奖作品包括一款名为“鸽群旗”的自制布艺工具包，以及一款三折便携旅行游戏“弹趣”——这款皮夹大小的游戏在两端均设有得分区。

label.en: This is in contrast to books that did not name images or books that had the same label under each image.
label.cn: 这和没有给图像命名的图书或每个图像下都是相同标签的图书形成了对比。

laborious.en: Entering the world of Tarahumaras has been a laborious project for Copeland.
laborious.cn: 进入塔拉乌马拉人的世界对科普兰来说是一项费时费力的工程。
laborious.source: 2020年9月大学英语六级考试真题

lace.en: Worse, when Asian Americans do make an appearance in lesson books, it is often laced with problems.
lace.cn: 更糟糕的是，当亚裔美国人出现在教科书中时，却常常伴随着一些问题。

lag.en: Yes, the part about overcoming jet lag was interesting.
lag.cn: 是的，关于克服时差的那部分确实很有意思。

landlord.en: Mr. Mail Man, Mr. Insurance Man, Mr. White-and-Chocolate Milk Man, Mr. Landlord Man, Mr. Police Man: we called white people by their trade, like characters in a mystery play.
landlord.cn: 邮递员先生、保险员先生、白巧克力牛奶先生、房东先生、警察先生：我们像神秘剧中的角色一样，根据职业称呼白人。

landscape.en: Large education bureaucracies and unions came to dominate the landscape, confusing activity with achievement.
landscape.cn: 大型教育官僚机构和工会开始去控制这个形势，它们把成就和活动混淆。
landscape.source: 2014年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

largely.en: One's behavior is largely determined by their genetic traits.
largely.cn: 一个人的行为在很大程度上由其遗传特征所决定。
largely.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

laser.en: Beginning their astronomical PowerPoint demonstration using a green laser pointer, Hilde and Orla showed us the Messier 4 spherical cluster with white dwarf stars, Saturn and its rings, the Southern Cross and the Milky Way, which stretched across the sky.
laser.cn: 希尔德和奥拉使用绿色激光笔开始了他们的天文PowerPoint演示，向我们展示了梅西耶4球状星团及其中的白矮星、土星及其光环、南十字座和横亘天际的银河。

last.en: Sales of grass-fed yogurt and kefir on the other hand, have in the last year increased by over 38%.
last.cn: 另一方面，草饲酸奶和克菲尔的销售额在去年增长了38%以上。
last.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（二）

laundry.en: Werbachgives the example of several Disneyland hotels in Anaheim, Caiifornia, which used large digital leaderboards to display how efficiently laundry workers were working compared to one another.Some employees found the board motivating.
laundry.cn: 韦尔巴赫举例说，加州阿纳海姆的几家迪士尼乐园酒店使用大型数字排行榜来显示洗衣工彼此之间的工作效率对比。一些员工觉得这个排行榜很激励人心。

lawn.en: All the big trees, the green lawns , and the old buildings with tall columns.
lawn.cn: 所有的大树、绿茵茵的草坪和带有高大柱子的老建筑。

layout.en: The typical supermarket layout has barely changed over the past 90 years.
layout.cn: 在过去的90年里，超市的典型布局几乎没有改变。
layout.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

lead.en: "There is a large potential for wastewater agriculture to both help and hurt great numbers of urban consumers," said Liqa Raschid-Sally, who led the study.
lead.cn: “污水农业给城市的众多消费者带来帮助和伤害的可能性都很大。”牵头这项研究的利卡·拉希德-萨莉说道。
lead.source: 2016年6月大学英语六级考试真题（二）

leading.en: Nigel Goode is a leading aviation designer who works at a company which has been delivering aircraft interiors for airlines for 30 years.
leading.cn: 奈杰尔·古德是一位杰出的航空设计师，他所在的公司已经为航空公司提供飞机内饰30年了。

lean.en: They leaned toward wanting primary responsibility for such tasks.
lean.cn: 他们倾向于希望主要负责这类任务。

leap.en: Politicians, policymakers, commissioners and school leaders must be brave enough to make the leap towards reimagining schools as providers of health as well as education services.
leap.cn: 政治家、政策制定者、专员和学校领导必须有足够的勇气，向着将学校重新塑造为健康和教育服务提供者的方向飞跃。

learning.en: It happens when the parts of your brain used for learning, memory, decision making, and language are damaged or diseased.
learning.cn: 当大脑中用于学习、记忆、决策和语言的部分受到损伤或疾病影响时，痴呆就会发生。
learning.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

lease.en: Food-import anxiety is even leading to new efforts by food-importing countries to buy or lease farmland in other countries.
lease.cn: 对于食品进口的焦虑甚至正在促使粮食进口国做出新的努力：在其他国家购买或租赁土地。

legal.en: A recent study tackles the issue of over-trusting drivers and the resulting system misuse from a legal viewpoint.
legal.cn: 最近一项研究从法律角度着手，探讨了驾驶员对自动驾驶系统过度信任以及由此引发的系统滥用问题。

legend.en: "There's an ancient legend that as long as these eggs are made, evil will not prevail in the world," says Joan Brander, a Canadian egg-painter who has been painting eggs for over 60 years, having learned the art from her Ukrainian relatives.
legend.cn: “有一个古老的传说，只要做好了这些鸡蛋，恶魔就不会在世间横行。”琼·布兰德说，她是一位已经画了60多年鸡蛋的加拿大鸡蛋绘画者，她从乌克兰亲戚那里学会了这门艺术。

legislation.en: There’s a lot on the internet about a state-wide ban in Florida, but a few days worth of digging by a historian at the Florida State Historical Society found no such legislation.
legislation.cn: 网上很多人说佛罗里达州全州禁用金属饭盒，但是佛罗里达州历史协会的一位历史学家经过几天的搜索并没有发现这样的立法。
legislation.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

leisure.en: In a new paper, Friedman tries to figure out why that increased productivity has not translated into increased leisure time.
leisure.cn: 在一篇新论文中，Friedman试图探究为什么提升的生产效率并未转变为更多的休闲时间。

lens.en: Seen through the lens of the present self versus the future self, our self-defeating actions—like choosing to watch television rather than go to the gym—suddenly make perfect sense.
lens.cn: 从现在和未来的自我角度来看，我们那些自我挫败的行为——比如选择看电视而不是去健身房——突然显得合情合理。

lest.en: Some say we should never meet our heroes, lest they disappoint us when we find out how normal they are.
lest.cn: 有人说我们不应该与自己的偶像见面，以免发现他们其实很普通，从而感到失望。

liability.en: Among the reasons given for the decision, the restaurant cited noise levels, lack of space for high chairs, cleaning up extreme messes, and the liability of kids running around the restaurant.
liability.cn: 餐厅给出的理由包括：噪音过大、没有足够空间摆放儿童高脚椅、需要清理严重的脏乱，以及儿童在餐厅内乱跑可能引发的安全责任问题。
liability.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

liable.en: They are more liable to have depression.

liberal.en: The liberal arts in higher education help enrich students' spiritual life.
liberal.cn: 高等教育中的博雅教育有助于丰富学生的精神生活。
liberal.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

liberate.en: Before we collectively tear our hair out — how are we supposed to find our way in a landscape this confusing?— here is a thought from Dr. Philip Sloane, a geriatrician at the University of North Carolina: “In a way, that could be liberating for families.”
liberate.cn: 在我们集体绞尽脑汁，想在这种混乱不堪的状态下找出一条光明大道之前，北卡莱罗纳大学的老年病学专家菲利普·斯隆博士一语中的：“从某种意义上来说，这对于家庭而言是一种解放。”
liberate.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

likelihood.en: In particular, studies of millions of bats emerging at dusk from caves in Southeast Asia showed that each bat used a form of bilateral control to reduce the likelihood of collisions with other bats in the densely packed swarm, Horn said.
likelihood.cn: 霍恩说，对东南亚黄昏时分从洞穴中出来的数百万只蝙蝠进行的研究尤其表明，每只蝙蝠都使用了一种双边控制方式，以减少在密集的蝙蝠群中与其他蝙蝠发生碰撞的可能性。

likewise.en: Likewise, the of this warming will be very different depending on where you are—coastal areas must worry about rising sea levels, while Siberia and northern Canada may become more habitable and for humans than these areas are now.
likewise.cn: 同样，这种变暖的影响也会因地域而异——沿海地区必须担心海平面上升，而西伯利亚和加拿大北部可能会变得比现在更适宜人类居住。
likewise.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

lily.en: The new parents have yet to name the sixth baby, but are considering either Lily or Rose.
lily.cn: 这对新手父母还没有给第六个孩子取名字，但他们正在考虑莉莉或罗斯。

limb.en: It has got one of its limbs injured.

limitation.en: Recognize his own limitations and weaknesses.
limitation.cn: 认清自身的局限与不足。

linear.en: I would love to say that my gaming skills allow me to destroy cancer using linear accelerators like photon blasters, but that's not quite the reality.
linear.cn: 我很想说我的游戏技能让我能像使用光子炮那样用直线加速器摧毁癌细胞，但现实并非如此。

liter.en: Called "Better Cotton", this environmentally conscious product will save millions of liters of water a year simply from the demands of cotton production.
liter.cn: 这款名为“优质棉花”的环保产品，每年仅棉花生产所需用水量就能节约数百万升水。

literacy.en: There are undoubtedly hundreds of great resources out there for those wishing to improve their financial literacy, but while I was researching, I still kept wishing that I didn’t have to play catch-up with the money world.
literacy.cn: 毫无疑问，对于那些想提高理财能力的人来说，外面有数不胜数的优质资源。不过，在我查阅资料的过程中，我还是忍不住希望自己不必在理财方面从零开始追赶。
literacy.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

literary.en: Such literary accomplishments highlight an important point.
literary.cn: 这些文学成就凸显了一个重要事实。
literary.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

literature.en: “I'm very keen to encourage young people,” she says, observing that design brings together other subjects such as literature, art, history, geography and science.
literature.cn: "我非常希望能激励年轻人，"她说，并指出设计能够融合文学、艺术、历史、地理和科学等多个学科。
literature.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

litter.en: They are not having their litter collected properly or the dustbins emptied.
litter.cn: 他们没有正确地收集垃圾或清理垃圾箱。

liver.en: This is because the liver enzyme these drugs target is more active at night.
liver.cn: 这是因为这些药物作用的肝脏酶在夜间更为活跃。

loan.en: One big reason they're struggling is attributed to college loans, of which the average amounts to $37,000.
loan.cn: 他们面临困境的一个重要原因是大学贷款，其平均额度达到了37,000美元。
loan.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

lobby.en: Simply being in the nearest wood has such health benefits that the Woodland Trust successfully lobbied for it to be prescribed by doctors.
lobby.cn: 仅仅置身于附近的树林就能带来巨大的健康益处，这一点已得到充分认可。林地信托基金甚至成功游说医生将"亲近森林"开具为处方。

locate.en: Karen is the managing director of Cube Movie Theatre located on Underhill Road.
locate.cn: 凯伦是Cube电影院的常务董事，Cube电影院位于安德希尔路。
locate.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 听力

lodge.en: Wide awake at 3:30 am with our nine-year-old daughter on our lodge balcony, I stared for hours at the most incredible night sky I've ever seen before the dawn slowly started to rub out the stars on the horizon and the multiple shooting stars faded away.
lodge.cn: 凌晨3:30，我和九岁的女儿坐在小屋阳台上彻夜未眠，我凝视着这辈子见过的最美的夜空，直到黎明慢慢开始抹去天边的星星，许多流星也渐渐消失。
lodge.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

lodging.en: Schools should be cautious when making decisions about student lodging.
lodging.cn: 学校在处理学生住宿问题时应该小心谨慎。
lodging.source: 2011年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

log.en: Research from the exhaustive study of groundwater from over 950 drilling logs has just been published.
log.cn: 一项对超过 950 个钻井记录的地下水进行详尽研究的成果刚刚发表。
log.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

logic.en: Good communication is the first step in effective persuasion, but logic and reasoning are just as important.
logic.cn: 良好的沟通是有效说服的第一步，但逻辑与推理也同样关键。

logical.en: Dementia, as defined in medical dictionaries, is a broad term that describes a loss of thinking ability, memory, attention, logical reasoning, and other mental abilities.
logical.cn: 医学词典中定义的痴呆，是一个广泛的术语，用于描述思维能力、记忆力、注意力、逻辑推理和其他精神能力的丧失。
logical.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

loose.en: The video shows him launching the helicopter into the air and flying just far enough to successfully remove the loose tooth.
loose.cn: 视频显示，他驾驶直升机升空，飞行距离刚好足以成功拔除松动的牙齿。

loosen.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

lot.en: But it takes a lot more than a nearby airport to be a city of the future.
lot.cn: 但要成为未来城市，需要的不仅仅是附近的机场。
lot.source: 2019年12月大学英语四级考试真题（二）

lover.en: Recently, chocolate lovers were heartbroken as scientists claimed that they can become extinct by 2050!
lover.cn: 最近，一个令巧克力爱好者心碎的消息传来：科学家预测，巧克力可能在2050年前消失殆尽！

lower.en: The district said the decreased budget means it cannot provide the same mental health supports, social and emotional services or specialized programming to schools with lower enrollments.
lower.cn: 学区表示，预算减少意味着无法为入学人数较少的学校提供同等的心理健康支持、社会和情感服务或专业化课程。
lower.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

loyal.en: The supermarket is known for its loyal customers, but now has a different kind of visitor that has appeared over the last year.
loyal.cn: 这家超市以拥有一批忠实顾客而闻名，但在过去一年里，却出现了一种不同寻常的访客。

loyalty.en: They are known for their loyalty to their owners.
loyalty.cn: 它们以对主人忠诚而闻名。

lump.en: A 16th century castle in Scotland is close to collapsing after lumps of soil were washed away by floods, threatening its foundations.
lump.cn: 苏格兰一个16世纪城堡濒于倒塌，因为大块土地被洪水冲走，威胁到其地基。

lunar.en: About 100 current and past members of the dance group—which has been performing since 1956—will be among the 220 groups marching through Chinatown in Manhattan for the 18th Lunar New Year Parade on February 5.
lunar.cn: 该舞蹈团自 1956 年以来一直在表演，约有 100 名现任和前任成员将与其他 220 个团体一起，于 2 月 5 日在曼哈顿唐人街参加第 18 届农历新年游行。

luxurious.en: We stayed at Mount St Paul's Estate, a luxurious lodge run by the friendly Chris and Teara, both from Canada.

magnetic.en: If we redirect our attention toward cultivating inner qualities, we might find a magnetic attraction that moves us from something superficial to something that connects us to our depths.

magnificent.en: Formula One teams race far more technologically advanced vehicles around tracks all over the world—in magnificent events in places like Malaysia, Monaco, Singapore and the United Arab Emirates, and on tradition-rich tracks like Silverstone in England and Monza in Italy too.

maiden.en: Once upon a time, it was just customary for a bride to take her groom's last name as her own and abandon her maiden name completely.

maintain.en: Though the study mentioned above was fairly small (only 191 women took the initial fitness test, which means it's hard to maintain statistical significance while breaking the group down into sub-categories of more or less fit), …

majority.en: But whatever the type of animal, the vast majority of owners said their pets boosted their mental and physical health.

mammal.en: Compared with other mammals, our numerical instincts are not as remarkable as many assume.

manual.en: The author of How to Be Interesting: An Instruction Manual , Hagy spends a lot of time thinking about what's interesting to her.

manufacture.cn: 曼彻斯特大学的一项研究计算了微波炉在每个阶段（从生产到废物处理）的二氧化碳排放量，而二氧化碳是引起气候变化的主要温室气体。
