monetary.cn: 雷曼说：“相对较小的奖金很有意思。”

monster.en: Stories vary about how lion dancing came to be, but most of them include a monster named Nian who would terrorize a village.
monster.cn: 关于舞狮是如何产生的，故事各不相同，但大多数故事都包括一个名叫年的怪物，这个怪物会恐吓一个村庄。

monstrous.en: The monstrous pearl, measured at 1 foot wide and 2.2 feet long, is going to be verified by local experts and international authorities before hopefully going on display to attract more tourists in the little town.
monstrous.cn: 这颗巨大的珍珠宽1英尺，长2.2英尺，将由本地专家和国际权威机构检测，然后有望在这个小城里展览，以吸引更多游客。

monument.en: What is the roadside monument I see on my way to work everyday?
monument.cn: 我每天上班路上看到的路边的纪念碑是什么？
monument.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

moral.en: For as long as there are homeless people, there is a tendency to blame the victims themselves for their condition—to see their failure to thrive as an issue of character, of moral weakness, of laziness.
moral.cn: 因为只要有无家可归的人，就有将他们的状况归咎于受害者自己的趋势——将他们未能发达视为性格、道德软弱和懒惰的问题。
moral.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

morality.en: Words that were more difficult to visualize, for example, “justice” or “ morality ” were considered to be more abstract.
morality.cn: 例如‘正义’或‘道德’这样难以形象化的词汇，算作是抽象词汇。

mortgage.en: Often there'll be a car loan and perhaps a mortgage, but credit cards often seem to be the gateway to debt related financial difficulties for many.
mortgage.cn: 通常情况下，人们会背负汽车贷款，或许还会背负房贷，但对许多人来说，信用卡似乎才是导致债务缠身、陷入财务困境的罪魁祸首。
mortgage.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

motel.en: The history of a century-old motel .

motion.en: They believe that constant motion somehow generates leadership as a byproduct.
motion.cn: 他们相信不断的行动会带来作为副产品的领导权。
motion.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

motivate.en: One strategy to be a good conversationalist is to motivate your partner to tell their own stories.
motivate.cn: 成为一名优秀的健谈者的一大方法就是激发谈话对象说出自己的故事。
motivate.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

motorway.en: What did drivers on the motorway to Warsaw find?
motorway.cn: 开往华沙的高速公路上的司机们发现了什么？

mount.en: We stayed at Mount St Paul's Estate, a luxurious lodge run by the friendly Chris and Teara, both from Canada.
mount.cn: 我们住在圣保罗山庄，这是一家由来自加拿大的友善的克里斯和蒂娅拉经营的奢华旅馆。
mount.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

multiple.en: Dementia refers to a loss of multiple mental abilities such as memory and logical reasoning.
multiple.cn: 痴呆症指的是多种智力能力的丧失，如记忆力和逻辑推理能力。

multiply.en: In the early days, as the supermarket multiplied, so did our suspicion of it.
multiply.cn: 早期，随着超市数量的激增，我们对超市的怀疑也与日俱增。
multiply.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

municipal.en: At the same time, public municipal pools were often closed, leaving low-income people nowhere to swim.
municipal.cn: 与此同时，公共市政游泳池经常关闭，导致低收入人群无处游泳。
municipal.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

muscular.en: The other is next to a muscular, fierce-looking man.
muscular.cn: 另一个人身旁是一名肌肉发达、神情凶猛的男子。
muscular.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 听力

mutual.en: Rather, we would not have been likely to spend enough time getting to know each other due to the lack of immediately visible mutual interests.
mutual.cn: 相反，由于缺乏显而易见的共同兴趣，我们不太可能花足够的时间互相了解。
mutual.source: 2012年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

mysterious.en: The quest to attain this mysterious state has dominated discussion around careers for years—especially for working parents.
mysterious.cn: 多年来，如何达到这种神秘状态一直是职业生涯讨论的焦点——尤其是对于职场父母而言。

mystery.en: Policeman John Forster said in a statement: "The circumstances remain a mystery so we would welcome any information that will help us get to the bottom of these random incidents."
mystery.cn: 警察约翰·福斯特在一份声明中说：“情况仍然是个谜，所以我们欢迎任何能帮助我们查明这些随机事件真相的信息。”

myth.en: If these are the central characters of our story about poverty, what layers of perceptions, myths, and realities must we unearth to find meaningful solutions and support?
myth.cn: 如果这些人是我们关于贫穷的故事的核心人物，那么我们必须要揭露哪些层面的观念、谬论和现实去寻找重要的解决方案和支持呢？
myth.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

naked.en: Usually there is only one or two a year bright enough to be seen with the naked eye.
naked.cn: 通常一年中只有一两颗亮度足以用肉眼看到的太阳。
naked.source: 2015年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

namely.en: We get to enjoy the very concrete, immediate benefits of our actions while someone else ( namely , our future selves) suffers the hypothetical, far-off consequences.
namely.cn: 我们可以享受行动带来的非常具体、直接的好处，而其他人（即未来的我们自己）却要承受假设的、遥远的后果。

narration.en: According to Foulkes, Children's dream life seems to be similar to their waking imagination and narration .
narration.cn: 根据福尔克斯的说法,儿童的梦境生活似乎与他们清醒时的想象和叙述相似。

naturally.en: For some of us, persuasion is an instinctive quality and the power of influencing comes naturally.
naturally.cn: 对于一些人而言，说服是与生俱来的能力，影响他人也就顺其自然。
naturally.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

naval.en: She was retired after her naval service.
naval.cn: 她在海军服役期满后退休了。
naval.source: 2018年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

necessarily.en: It may not necessarily give you a longer life, but there's a compelling body of work that it will give you more good years.
necessarily.cn: 它可能不会让你活得更久，但大量研究显示，它会让你的生活更有质量。
necessarily.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

necessity.en: Big houses are advertized as a reward for hard work and diligence, turning housing from a basic necessity into a luxury.
necessity.cn: 大房子被宣传为对辛勤工作和勤奋的奖励，把住房从基本必需品变成了奢侈品。

negative.en: They have determined that the Industrial Revolution had an overall positive effect, but it quite possibly was neutralized by negative events such as wars, high taxes, and rapid population growth.
negative.cn: 他们确定工业革命总体上带来了积极影响，但很可能被战争、高税收和人口迅速增长等负面事件抵消。

neglect.en: It leads students to neglect their studies.
neglect.cn: 这会导致学生荒废学业。
neglect.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

negotiate.en: Carey's ambitious plan is two-fold: first, change the business model of … that had a largely narrow vision when it came to negotiating partnership deals; and second, alter the way fans experience the sport, … so that connections between the audience and people within the series are easier to make.
negotiate.cn: 凯里雄心勃勃的计划有两个方面：第一，改变商业模式，……以前在谈判合作协议时，（一级方程式）的远见很狭窄；第二，改变球迷体验这项运动的方式，使爱好者和系列赛中的人之间更容易建立联系。

nerve.en: Teeth have three layers, only one of which—the innermost layer of the tooth—can hurt, as that layer of the tooth contains both blood vessels and nerves .
nerve.cn: 牙齿有三层，其中只有最里面的一层会疼，因为那一层里既包含了血管又有神经。

network.en: The human brain has the ability to constantly form new networks and connections between brain cells.
network.cn: 人类大脑有能力不断在神经细胞之间建立新的网络和连接。

neutral.en: Since then, there have been a number of legal cases against companies involving paternity leave — including cases against JP Morgan Chase and Estée Lauder — which have helped put pressure on companies to make their parental leave policies gender neutral .
neutral.cn: 自那以后，出现了众多涉及陪产假的法律诉讼，其中就包括针对摩根大通和雅诗兰黛的案件。这些诉讼对企业构成了压力，促使它们的育儿假政策朝着性别中立的方向改进。

nevertheless.en: Nevertheless, while the woman's intention was to feed birds, it is clear that rats were also benefiting.
nevertheless.cn: 然而，虽然这位女士的本意是喂鸟，但很明显老鼠也从中受益。
nevertheless.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

nightmare.en: Since your baby doesn't dream at this stage of brain development, it's safe to assume babies do not have nightmares , either.
nightmare.cn: 由于在这个大脑发育阶段,宝宝还不会做梦,因此可以确定婴儿也不会做噩梦。

nonsense.en: Bureaucrats regularly rewrite curriculums, talk nonsense about the theories of education, and require ever more administrators.
nonsense.cn: 官僚们经常重写课程，对教育理论一通胡说八道，并且要求更多的管理者。
nonsense.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

norm.en: In the coming era of budget cuts to education, distance learning could become the norm .
norm.cn: 在即将到来的教育款项减少的时代，远程学习可能会成为惯例。

normally.en: They taught a series of dance moves to a group of patients with conditions like sleepwalking, in which the sleeper engages in the kind of physical movement that is normally inhibited during slumber.
normally.cn: 他们向一组梦游症患者教授了一系列舞步，在梦游的时候会完成一些在睡眠中往往被抑制的肢体动作。
normally.source: 2020年7月英语四级 第1套 阅读

notable.en: A notable criticism of the golden rule is that its application can lead to undesirable outcomes, when it conflicts with laws and ethical principles.
notable.cn: 有关黄金法则的一个值得注意的批评是，在法律和伦理的冲突中，它的应用可能会导致不良后果。
notable.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

noticeable.en: Their enrollment has been on a noticeable decline.
noticeable.cn: 他们的入学人数明显下降。

notify.en: Harris, who became head teacher this year, said he notified parents of the updated rules in an email in June.
notify.cn: 今年上任的校长哈里斯表示,他在六月份通过电子邮件向家长们通报了更新后的规定。
notify.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

notion.en: Research by the Boston College Center for Work & Family, which surveyed new parents at four large US companies who were qualified for taking at least six weeks paid parental leave, found that 81% of the 1,240 employees surveyed said the notion of fathers taking leave has become more acceptable.
notion.cn: 波士顿学院工作与家庭中心对四家大型美国公司的新父母进行了调研，这些人获得了至少六周带薪父母假。研究显示，在1240名接受调查的员工中，有81%的人认为社会对父亲休产假的接受度有所提高。

nourish.en: To write his 2010 book, The 5-Factor World Diet, nutritionist Harley Pasternak traveled to the healthiest countries around the world to learn more about what made their meals extra nourishing .
nourish.cn: 为了撰写 2010 年出版的《五因素世界饮食法》一书，营养学家哈雷·帕斯捷尔纳克走访了世界各地最健康的国家，以了解是什么让他们的膳食格外营养。

nourishment.en: The corn provides nourishment across the globe.
nourishment.cn: 玉米为全球人民提供了重要的营养来源。
nourishment.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

novelty.en: Hundreds of studies show that infants prefer novelty .
novelty.cn: 数百项研究表明，婴儿更喜欢新奇事物。

nuisance.en: It might be a nuisance to the loyal shoppers.
nuisance.cn: 这可能会给忠实顾客带来不便。

numerous.en: Numerous studies have shown that drinking fruit juice doesn't make us consume any less of other foods throughout the day.
numerous.cn: 大量研究表明，喝果汁并不会减少我们一天中对其他食物的摄入量。
numerous.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

nursery.en: "They worry they'll be mistaken for grandparents, or that they'll need help getting up out of those little chairs in nursery school," says Joann Galst, a New York psychologist.
nursery.cn: 纽约心理学家乔安·加尔斯特说：“他们担心自己会被误认为是祖父母，或者担心自己在幼儿园里需要帮助才能从那些小椅子上站起来。”
nursery.source: 2006年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

obedience.en: When your dog obeys a simple request of "come here, sit," it is showing obedience and respect for you.
obedience.cn: 当你的狗听从“过来，坐下”这样的简单指令时，它就是在向你表达服从和尊重。

object.en: Plastics have for years been used to make nearly everything that surrounds us, but along the way they escaped the confines of packaging and objects and settled in the environment, the food we eat and the air we breathe.
object.cn: 多年来，塑料被用于制造我们周围几乎所有的东西，但在这个过程中，塑料突破了包装和物品的界限，进入了环境、我们吃的食物和我们呼吸的空气中。

objection.en: …to raise objections against another man's speech, it is a very easy matter…
objection.cn: 对他人的演说提出异议是很容易的事……
objection.source: 2015年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

objective.en: Practice involves repeating a process intentionally to attain a particular objective .
objective.cn: 练习是指为了达到特定目标而有意识地重复某个过程。

obligation.en: We become frustrated by our obligations even though we were the ones who said "yes" to them in the first place.
obligation.cn: 尽管最初是我们自己答应的，我们仍会因这些责任感到沮丧。

oblige.en: Hmm, that's nice of you, but I don't want to feel obliged to buy one of his cars.
oblige.cn: 嗯，谢谢你的好意，但我不想迫于压力去买一辆他的车。

observation.en: Share your observations about the world around you—interesting stories you heard or things you noticed—and you may be surprised by the universal connection they inspire.
observation.cn: 要分享你对周遭世界的观察所得——听到的趣闻或者注意到的事物——可能出乎你意料的是，它们能激发普遍的联结。
observation.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

observer.en: They will vary their behaviour in order to appear moral or socially good in the eyes of key observers .
observer.cn: 他们会改变自身行为，以便在重要观察者眼中显得品行端正或具备良好的社会形象。

obstacle.en: For Ginger and Red Rum, though, it was just an obstacle to greatness that had to be overcome.
obstacle.cn: 但对于姜汁红朗姆酒来说，这只是通往成功道路上必须克服的一个障碍。

obtain.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

occasion.en: We all take a little extra effort to look nice for special occasions .
occasion.cn: 在特殊场合，我们都会多花些心思让自己看起来更体面。

occasional.en: This differed from the findings of a study from Harvard University in the U.S., which concluded that missing a few occasional days because of the weather did not damage learning.
occasional.cn: 这与美国哈佛大学的研究结果不同。哈佛的研究表明，因天气原因偶尔缺课几天并不会影响学习效果。

occasionally.en: Even worse, people will occasionally fight to do things that waste time.
occasionally.cn: 更糟糕的是，人们有时会为了做浪费时间的事情而争吵。
occasionally.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

occupation.en: The decline of manufacturing and the increase in the number of people working in less labor-intensive occupations also has contributed to the trend, says Abraham, who researches work and retirement decisions of older Americans.
occupation.cn: 研究美国老年人工作与退休决策的亚伯拉罕表示，制造业的衰退以及从事低劳动强度职业人数的增加，也助推了这一趋势。

occupy.en: You may not actually experience emotional wellbeing at home if you remain occupied with what happened at work.
occupy.cn: 如果你一直想着工作上发生的事情，回到家后可能就无法真正体验到情绪上的幸福感。

occur.en: This occurs when business leaders implement IT initiatives with little consideration of how those changes will impact the end user.
occur.cn: 如果在实施信息技术计划时，业务领导很少考虑这些更改将如何影响终端用户，这种情况就会发生。

occurrence.en: According to the study, the occurrence of foreign objects in children is generally attributed to curiosity.
occurrence.cn: 根据这项研究，儿童发生体内异物事件通常是因为他们好奇。
occurrence.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

odd.en: I genuinely find it odd, for if you nap properly, it’s like waking up from a full night’s sleep and you can double your day’s worth of concentration.
odd.cn: 我真的觉得这很奇怪，因为如果小睡质量很高，就像从一整夜的睡眠中醒来一样，你可以让你一天的注意力加倍。
odd.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

offend.cn: 他们可能会感到被冒犯。
offend.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 阅读

offensive.en: It is possible that your future husband will find this choice offensive .
offensive.cn: 你未来的丈夫可能会觉得这个选择冒犯了他。

official.en: Officials wanted to highlight South Dakota's two largest industries, tourism and agriculture.
official.cn: 政府官员希望借此机会推广南达科他州的两大支柱产业：旅游业和农业。

omit.en: Obviously you will still be you even if you've taken on your husband's last name and omitted yours entirely.
omit.cn: 即使你随了丈夫的姓，完全舍弃了自己的姓氏，你显然还是你自己。
omit.source: 2023年3月英语四级 第1套 阅读

onward.en: The "millennials" who will soon make up half the workforce in rich countries were raised from nursery school onwards to work in groups.
onward.cn: “千禧一代”的人很快将会占据富裕国家中一半的劳动力，这群人从幼儿园往后就被培养要团队合作。

operation.en: It minimizes the use of controversial pesticides in its operations.
operation.cn: 它在经营中尽量减少使用存在争议的农药。
operation.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

operator.en: He is an experienced press operator .
operator.cn: 他是一位经验丰富的印刷机操作员。

opponent.en: They could also choose to express sympathy with their opponent to appear pleasant.
opponent.cn: 他们还可以选择向对手表达同情，以营造亲和的形象。

oppose.en: Debates on social media show some parents are opposed to ending the "snow day" tradition.
oppose.cn: 社交媒体上的讨论表明，一些家长不支持取消“雪日”这一传统。

optimism.en: In fact many experts argue that the most important 21st-century skills aren't related to specific technologies or subject matter, but to creativity; skills like imagination, problem-finding and problem-solving, teamwork, optimism, patience and the ability to experiment and take risks.
optimism.cn: 事实上，许多专家认为，21世纪最重要的技能与特定技术或主题无关，而与创造力有关，如想象力、发现问题和解决问题的能力、团队合作、乐观、耐心，以及做实验和冒险的能力。
optimism.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

optimistic.en: An optimistic vision of vegan foods becoming mainstream.
optimistic.cn: 对素食食品成为主流的乐观展望。
optimistic.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

option.en: In the absence of environmentally and economically feasible recycling options , fast fashion manufacturers pump out low quality clothes produced in high volumes that are worn only a few times, and then discarded.
option.cn: 在缺乏环保且经济可行的回收方案的情况下，快时尚制造商大量生产质量低劣的服装，这些衣物往往只穿几次就被丢弃。

oral.en: What should one pay attention to when making an oral presentation?
oral.cn: 做口头报告时应该注意什么？

orbit.en: The tour saw him control a robot on Earth, remotely from orbit .
orbit.cn: 在太空任务中，他曾从轨道上远程控制地球上的机器人。

orchestra.en: Even so, it can be difficult for those who do not study music theory to see this as an indicator, since it is subtle and just shows the impact symphonic orchestras have had on society's taste in music.
orchestra.cn: 然而，对于那些没有学习音乐理论的人来说，这种影响很难察觉，因为它非常微妙，只是显示了交响乐团对社会音乐品味的塑造。
orchestra.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

orderly.en: They never know where they are going, and do not walk in an orderly manner.
orderly.cn: 他们永远不知道他们要去哪里，也不会有秩序地走路。

organic.en: Is organic food worth the higher price?
organic.cn: 有机食品值不值得较高的价格？

organism.en: All living organisms on Earth are exposed to a 24-hour day-night cycle.
organism.cn: 地球上所有生物都受到24小时昼夜循环的影响。
organism.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

organize.en: With the help of Denis Hayes, a graduate student at Harvard University, Nelson organized the first Earth Day on April 22, 1970, educating participants in the importance of environmental protection.
organize.cn: 在哈佛大学研究生丹尼斯·海斯的协助下,尼尔森于1970年4月22日组织了首届地球日,向参与者普及环境保护的重要性。

orient.en: Proto-Indo­ European was decimally oriented because, as in so many cultures, our ancestors' hands served as the gateway to the realization that "five fingers on one hand is the same as five fingers on the other".
orient.cn: 原始印欧语系适应十进制的原因是，在众多文化中，我们祖先的手让人们首次认识到 “一只手上的五根手指和另一只手上的五根手指是等量的”。
orient.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

orientation.en: They hit me right out of gate with a $160 fee to attend my freshman orientation , a price which does not include the cost of travel to and from the District.
orientation.cn: 刚开学，他们就收了我160美元的新生迎新费用，这还不包括往返学区的路费。

origin.en: There are a number of different versions about the origin of the lion dance.
origin.cn: 关于舞狮的起源，有许多不同的版本。

original.en: But it turns out Japan still has some very old mills with the traditional weaving tools used to make jeans the original way.
original.cn: 但它揭示出，日本仍然有一些非常古老的工厂使用传统编织工具，以最开始的方式生产牛仔裤。

originate.en: It may have initially originated in individuals linked by blood.
originate.cn: 它最初可能起源于有血缘关系的个体之间。

ounce.en: The fifth largest city in the US passed a significant soda tax proposal that will levy 1.5 cents per liquid ounce on distributors.
ounce.cn: 美国第五大城市通过了一项意义重大的苏打饮料税提案，将对经销商征收每液体盎司1.5美分的税。
ounce.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

outbreak.en: Amid all the election drama, air pollution problems, and disease outbreaks, five tourists' good work is being spread online.
outbreak.cn: 在选举风波、空气污染问题和疾病爆发的背景下，五位游客的善举正在网上传播。
outbreak.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

outcome.en: Harris held that strengthened rules around school uniforms improved student outcomes and behavior.
outcome.cn: 哈里斯认为,加强校服管理改善了学生的学业表现和行为规范。

outlet.en: By allowing employees to donate their time during work hours, the workplace becomes an outlet for personal fulfillment without affecting personal time.
outlet.cn: 通过允许员工在工作时间参与志愿服务，工作场所成为员工实现个人成就感的渠道，同时不占用个人时间。
outlet.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

outline.en: It is, therefore, important for you to adapt retain texts or outlines for presentations.
outline.cn: 因此，对演示文稿进行调整并保留文本或提纲非常重要。

outlook.en: Professor Goel has a much rosier outlook on the future of artificial intelligence than, say, Elon Musk, Stephen Hawking, Bill Gates or Steve Wozniak.
outlook.cn: 和埃隆·马斯克、史蒂芬·霍金、比尔·盖茨或史蒂夫·沃兹尼亚克相比，葛尔教授对人工智能的未来的看法更加乐观。

outset.en: U.S. government officials outset to approve a mission by privately held space company-Moon Express to travel outside of the earth orbit in late 2017.
outset.cn: 2017 年底，美国政府官员开始批准私营太空公司 Moon Express 执行一项飞出地球轨道的任务。
outset.source: 2018年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

outstanding.en: I admit the academic record is very strong, with many outstanding awards for achievements in science and math, but he is just not mature enough to live on his own at this point.
outstanding.cn: 我承认他的学业成绩确实非常优秀,在科学和数学方面获得了许多杰出奖项,但现阶段他还不够成熟,无法独立生活。

oval.en: Eggs have an oval shape appealing to artists.
oval.cn: 鸡蛋呈椭圆形，这很受艺术家们的喜爱。
oval.source: 2017年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

overall.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

overhead.en: It's like fixing up an airplane engine and ignoring that the pilot is on his third drink at the bar and a massive storm is overhead.
overhead.cn: 这就像是修理了飞机引擎，却忽视了飞行员在酒吧喝了第三杯酒，而一场剧烈的风暴就在上空。
overhead.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

overhear.en: About six years ago I was eating lunch in a restaurant in New York City when a woman and a young boy sat down at the next table, I couldn't help overhearing parts of their conversation.
overhear.cn: 大约六年前，我在纽约市的一家餐馆吃午饭，这时一位女士和一个小男孩在隔壁桌坐了下来，我不禁听到了他们谈话的部分内容。

overlook.en: There's a social dimension to health that we've completely overlooked in our efforts to find the best and most cutting-edge medical care.
overlook.cn: 在我们努力寻找最好和最尖端的医疗保健时，我们完全忽略了"健康"尤其社会层面。
overlook.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

overnight.en: She won a TV competition and became a millionaire overnight .
overnight.cn: 她赢得了一档电视比赛,一夜之间成了百万富翁。

overseas.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

overtake.en: For a long time after this renovation project, it was the tallest building in the United Kingdom, but it was eventually overtaken by the Millbank Tower.
overtake.cn: 此次翻新工程之后的很长一段时间里，它一直是英国最高的建筑，但最终被米尔班克大厦超过。

overwhelm.en: I'm a bit overwhelmed with the amount of data I still need to collect to finish my thesis, but I still need to relax sometimes.
overwhelm.cn: 我还有大量的数据需要收集才能完成论文，这让我有点不知所措，但我还是需要偶尔放松一下。

overwhelming.en: By comparing identical twins, who share nearly 100 percent of their genes, and non-identical twins, who share about half, researchers have found overwhelming evidence for genetic effects on behaviors.
overwhelming.cn: 通过比较几乎共享全部基因的同卵双胞胎与约共享一半基因的异卵双胞胎，研究人员找到了大量基因对行为产生影响的有力证据。
overwhelming.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

owe.en: Coal prices also are low, owing to over-supply and the scaling-down of demand...
owe.cn: 由于供应过剩和需求缩减，煤炭价格也很低……

ownership.en: However, people did report a few disadvantages to pet ownership These included difficulty traveling and financial strains. 6% of pet owners said they'd fallen or injured themselves as a result of having a pet.
ownership.cn: 然而，人们也指出了养宠物的一些不利因素，包括旅行困难和经济负担。6%的宠物主人表示，他们因为养宠物而跌倒或伤到自己。
ownership.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

pace.en: They are advertised as a way for adults to finish their education and students to learn the material at their own pace—it is far more compatible for people with busy schedules.
pace.cn: 他们被宣传为一种让成年人完善自身教育、学生根据自己节奏学习教学内容的方式——非常适合日程忙碌的人群。
pace.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

pack.en: One had to quit abruptly on a given day, going from about a pack a day to zero.
pack.cn: 一组要在指定的一天突然戒烟，从一天一包变为一根也不抽。

package.en: There is another depressing reality hidden within even the largest financial aid packages: Colleges often offer the most generous packages during freshman year as a way to attract new students.
package.cn: 即使是金额最高的助学金计划，也隐藏着另一个令人沮丧的现实：大学通常在大一期间提供最慷慨的助学金计划，以此来吸引新生。
package.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

pad.en: Heat from an electric pad or a warm bath can also help.
pad.cn: 电热垫或热水澡的热气也可以有所帮助。
pad.source: 2015年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

painful.en: Yet, there are valid reasons boredom may feel so painful .
painful.cn: 然而，无聊可能会让人感到痛苦，这是有合理理由的。

palm.en: If that weren't already implied by the landscape — rolling green hills, palm trees, sun-kissed flowers — then it’s evident in the many stories of people who grew up poor in these sleepy neighborhoods and rose to enormous success.
palm.cn: 这里有连绵起伏的青山、棕榈树、阳光亲吻的花朵，如果这种风景还没有暗示出这一点的话，那么从许多人的故事里也可以明显地看出这一点。在这些安静的社区里，他们在贫穷中长大，然后取得了巨大的成功。

panel.en: I'm not sure how many panels he has up there, but he does have a large family of six.
panel.cn: 我不确定他在屋顶上装了多少块太阳能板，不过他家确实有六口人。

panic.en: The price of school uniforms can spark panic among families struggling with the high cost of living.
panic.cn: 校服价格可能让生活成本高企的家庭倍感压力。
panic.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

paperback.en: It is probably true that fewer kids are heavy readers compared with two generations ago，when cheap paperbacks boosted rates of reading.
paperback.cn: 很可能现在热爱阅读的孩子们比起两代人以前要少，那时候平价的平装书促进了阅读率的上升。

parade.en: About 100 current and past members of the dance group—which has been performing since 1956 will be among the 220 groups marching through Chinatown in Manhattan for the 18th Lunar New Year Parade on February 5.
parade.cn: 约100名自1956年以来一直活跃的舞蹈团体成员，将参加2月5日举行的第18届农历新年游行，该活动将在曼哈顿唐人街举行，共有220个团体参与。
parade.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

paragraph.en: What do we learn about American society from the first paragraph?
paragraph.cn: 从第一段中我们能了解到美国社会的哪些信息？
paragraph.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

parallel.en: While you need to employ both to get to a finished result, they cannot work in parallel no matter how much we might like to think so.
parallel.cn: 虽然你需要同时运用这两种方法来达到最终结果，但它们不能并行工作，无论我们多么希望如此。
parallel.source: 2007年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

parental.en: It doesn’t include the temptation to run from society or make an excuse to avoid one’s obligations — such as life-saving medical work or the parental obligation to buy groceries.
parental.cn: 它既不诱惑大家远离社会，也不制造借口逃避义务——比如拯救生命的医疗工作或父母购买食品杂货的义务。
parental.source: 2020年12月大学英语六级考试真题

parliament.en: Part of remedying this social disease would be for parliament to pass a “right to grow” law, allowing anyone to turn underused public spaces into vegetable and fruit gardens.
parliament.cn: 要解决这一社会问题，一个可行的办法是让议会通过"种植权"法案。该法案将允许民众把闲置的公共空间改造成蔬果园，这不失为一种有效的应对之策。
parliament.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

partial.en: Operations at one of Australia's largest gold mines had to be temporarily suspended on Friday after a partial wall collapse at one of the mine's dams.
partial.cn: 澳大利亚最大的金矿之一的其中一个矿坝发生部分墙体坍塌，导致该矿周五不得不暂时停止运营。
partial.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

partially.en: In part, this reflects the fact that official campsites have been wholly or partially closed, or are overflowing in a summer when fewer people are going abroad.
partially.cn: 部分原因是，官方露营地全部或部分关闭，或者在夏季出国旅行的人较少的情况下人满为患。

participant.en: Seventy-six participants completed a range of intelligence tests and received positive feedback on them, regardless of their actual performance.
participant.cn: 76名参与者完成了一系列智力测试，无论实际表现如何，他们都得到了积极的反馈。

participate.en: That and other Alzheimer's- related studies are always looking for volunteers to participate , he said.
participate.cn: 他表示，其他与阿尔茨海默病相关的研究也一直在寻求志愿者参与。

particle.en: Based on available data, Americans take in an estimated 74,000 to 121,000 microplastic particles every year.
particle.cn: 根据现有数据，美国人每年大约摄入74,000到121,000个微塑料颗粒。

particularly.en: You'd expect that people who are particularly sensitive to the bitter taste of caffeine would drink less coffee, said study senior researcher Marilyn Cornelis.
particularly.cn: “你或许会认为，对咖啡因苦味格外敏感的人会少喝咖啡，”研究资深作者玛丽琳·科内利斯说。

passion.en: She introduces a new concept that talent may be overrated, and if you want real success, what you need is grit, the perfect combination of passion and persistence.
passion.cn: 她提出了一个新观点，认为天赋可能被高估了，如果你想获得真正的成功，你需要的是坚毅——激情和持久力的完美结合。

passive.cn: 被动学习也能创造知识。
passive.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

pat.en: The music would sound not quite right: attempts to pat the beat off just so.
pat.cn: 音乐听起来不太对：试着这样打打节拍。

patch.en: They have been attracted by a patch of land that is close to wilderness, and it is their responsibility to keep it that way.
patch.cn: 既然露营者被接近于自然状态的地貌吸引，那么维护这块土地的自然状态也应当是他们的责任。

pattern.en: To arrive at this conclusion, the researchers examined the linguistic patterns of men and women in over 600, 000 blog posts written on websites.
pattern.cn: 为了得出这一结论，研究者们调查了网站上超过六十万篇男女博客文章的语言模式。

paw.en: Some owners even shower with their Savannah Cats, presenting a water bowl to Savannah may also prove a challenge, as some will promptly begin to bat all the water out of the bowl until it is empty using their front paws.
paw.cn: 有些主人甚至会和他们的萨凡纳猫一起洗澡，给萨凡纳猫准备水碗也可能是一个挑战，因为有些萨凡纳猫会立即用前爪把碗里的水全部拍出来，直到碗空为止。
paw.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

peak.en: That suggests the demand for workers has reached or is at least nearing its peak .
peak.cn: 这表明对劳动力的需求已经达到或至少接近峰值。

peculiar.en: To illustrate people's peculiar shopping behavior.
peculiar.cn: 为了说明人们独特的购物行为。

peculiarity.en: I have written about this peculiarity in human nature before with my friend Dan Ariely, who studied this phenomenon extensively after noticing pricing for subscriptions to The Economist .
peculiarity.cn: 我曾和我的朋友丹·艾瑞里写过关于这一人性独特之处的文章，他在注意到《经济学人》的订阅价格后，对这一现象进行了广泛的研究。

pedestrian.en: "Cyclists and pedestrians are consumers too," notes Professor Susan Handy.
pedestrian.cn: "骑车人和行人也是消费者，"苏珊·汉迪教授指出。

peer.en: In these twin studies, identical and non-identical twins are asked, for example, to split a sum of money with a peer .
peer.cn: 在这些双胞胎研究中，研究人员会要求同卵和异卵双胞胎将一笔钱与同伴平分，以此作为测试之一。

penalty.cn: 同时还会处以300美元的罚款。

penetrate.en: The experience of using IT penetrates almost the entire work field.
penetrate.cn: 信息技术的使用几乎渗透到整个工作领域。

perceive.en: In one survey, 89% of employees perceived companies that sponsored volunteer activities as creating a better working environment, and 75% said volunteering was critical to their well-being.
perceive.cn: 一项调查显示，89%的员工认为组织志愿活动的公司能创造更好的工作环境，75%的员工表示志愿服务对他们的身心健康至关重要。

perception.en: "Hiring managers have a strong perception bias against 45, job candidates — they believe that members of this age group have poor skills and low adaptability," Generation's analysts report.
perception.cn: "招聘经理对45岁以上的求职者存在强烈的认知偏见——他们认为这个年龄段的人技能欠佳、适应能力差，"Generation的分析师在报告中指出。
perception.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

perfection.en: Grit is different because it tells us that perfection isn't the goal.
perfection.cn: 毅力的不同之处在于，它让我们明白完美并非目标所在。

perform.en: Almost half of our daily actions are part of our habits and not decisions, so once the correct habits are in place, you will automatically perform those tasks on a day-to-day basis.
perform.cn: 我们每天的行为中，几乎有一半是基于习惯而非决策。因此，一旦形成了正确的习惯，这些任务便会自动化地日复一日地被执行。
perform.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

peril.en: The sense of eagerness that comes with having a rival can not only cause you to make poorer decisions, but it can also lead you to take greater risks that put your venture in peril .
peril.cn: 面对竞争对手，那种急于求成的感觉不仅会让你做出更糟糕的决定，还会让你承担更大的风险，从而使你的事业陷入危险之中。

period.en: Sadly, the data also showed face-to-face socializing and sports activity had declined over the period covered by the survey.
period.cn: 遗憾的是，数据还显示，在调查期间，人们面对面的社交活动和体育活动都有所减少。
period.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（一）

periodic.en: Online time has doubled since 2006, and social media use has moved from a periodic activity to a daily one in the same period.
periodic.cn: 2006年以来，上网时间翻了一番；与此同时，社交媒体的使用也从定期活动变成了日常活动。
periodic.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

permanent.en: Customers loved the outdoor seating so much that cities are making it permanent : A New York City study of several streets closed during Covid found storeowners making more than before, and diners enjoying the outdoor lifestyle.
permanent.cn: 顾客对户外座位喜爱有加，以至于许多城市决定将其永久保留：一项针对疫情期间纽约市若干封闭街道的研究发现，店主的收入比以前更高，食客也享受着户外生活方式。

permission.en: It would make sense that wild campers need to ask for permission to camp from landowners, especially outside Scotland, where the law is far more restrictive.
permission.cn: 在苏格兰以外的地区，野营者应当向地主申请露营许可，因为这些地区的法律更为严格。
permission.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

persevere.en: Yet the persevering losers still came out on top.
persevere.cn: 然而，那些坚持不懈的失败者最终还是取得了胜利。

persist.en: Researchers found that enjoyment rather than importance enabled people to persist in their goals.
persist.cn: 研究者发现，享受过程而非重视程度，是使人们坚持目标的关键因素。
persist.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

persistence.en: She introduces a new concept that talent may be overrated, and if you want real success, what you need is grit, the perfect combination of passion and persistence .
persistence.cn: 她提出了一个新观点，认为天赋可能被高估了，如果你想获得真正的成功，你需要的是坚毅——激情和持久力的完美结合。

personality.en: Tests that offer to find your perfect romantic match and those claiming to predict personality or talents based on your DNA are pure nonsense.
personality.cn: 那些声称能通过DNA找到你的完美伴侣,或者能根据DNA预测性格或天赋的检测,完全是无稽之谈。

personnel.en: There is a growing shortage of medical personnel.
personnel.cn: 医疗人员短缺问题日益严重。
personnel.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

perspective.en: And if it seems like finding that perfect balance remains difficult to achieve, the experts say that keeping some perspective can help.
perspective.cn: 如果感觉很难找到完美的平衡点，专家表示，保持一定的视角会有所帮助。

persuasion.en: The art of persuasion means convincing others to agree with your point of view or to follow your course of action.
persuasion.cn: 说服的艺术在于让他人认同你的观点或者采纳你的行动方案。

pessimistic.en: In the last seven years, Americans have grown more pessimistic about the power of education to lead to success.
pessimistic.cn: 在过去的七年里，美国人对教育能否带来成功越来越悲观。
pessimistic.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

petroleum.en: A rapid increase in U.S. petroleum chemical production.
petroleum.cn: 美国石油化工产品产量迅速增长。

phase.en: It shouldn’t be just a one-day event but a course integrated throughout the whole of high school that would allow students to gradually expand their financial literacy, and would prevent the need for a ‘catch up’ phase once we’re out on our own after graduation.
phase.cn: 这不应该只是一次性的短期活动，而应该是一门贯穿整个高中阶段的课程。这样不仅能让学生循序渐进地提高金融素养，还能避免他们毕业后独立生活时需要"补课"的窘境。

philosopher.en: One American philosopher stated that addressing the needs of the poor and vulnerable is about more than money – it is mostly about creating conditions under which prosperity and opportunity can thrive.
philosopher.cn: 一位美国哲学家指出，解决贫困和弱势群体的需求不仅仅是金钱的问题，更重要的是创造条件，使繁荣和机遇得以蓬勃发展。

photography.en: In support of that suggestion, a 2014 study by Denise C. Park of the University of Texas at Dallas and colleagues demonstrated that learning to knit or do digital photography enhanced memory function in older adults.
photography.cn: 为了支持这一观点，德克萨斯大学达拉斯分校的 Denise C. Park 及其同事在 2014 年进行的一项研究表明，学习编织或进行数码摄影可以增强老年人的记忆功能。
photography.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

pierce.en: She was pierced by a chicken bone.
pierce.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

pigeon.en: A rat or pigeon might not be the obvious choice to tend to someone who is sick, but these creatures have some superior skills that could help the treatment of human diseases.
pigeon.cn: 老鼠或鸽子可能不是照顾病人明摆着的选择，但这些动物有一些优秀技能可以帮助治疗人类疾病。

pinch.en: Penny- pinching UK consumers choose cheaper products from discounters such as Aldi and Lidl rather than luxury alternatives.
pinch.cn: 异常节省、锱铢必较的英国消费者会在像奥乐齐和利德连锁超市这样的折扣店里选择更加便宜的产品，而不是去其他奢侈的商店。

pit.en: While digging two pits at a site in the central plains of China, scientists discovered fragments from pots and vessels.
pit.cn: 在挖掘中国中原地区某个遗址的两个地坑时，科学家们发现了罐子和容器的碎片。

pitch.en: You can learn about the best way to make a sales pitch , but the only way to actually land customers is to practice making sales calls.
pitch.cn: 你可以学习如何进行最佳的销售推销，但真正获得客户的唯一方法是练习拨打销售电话。

plague.en: The same problem plagues many who do have a budget.
plague.cn: 同样的问题困扰着许多有预算的人。

plantation.cn: 它们被用作果树种植园。

plastic.en: Plastics have for years been used to make nearly everything that surrounds us, but along the way they escaped the confines of packaging and objects and settled in the environment, the food we eat and the air we breathe.
plastic.cn: 多年来，塑料被用于制造我们周围几乎所有的东西，但在这个过程中，塑料突破了包装和物品的界限，进入了环境、我们吃的食物和我们呼吸的空气中。
plastic.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

platform.en: To conduct the study, the team partnered with an online job listings platform , which emails postings relevant to individuals and their job search criteria.
platform.cn: 为了开展这项研究，研究团队与一家在线求职平台展开合作。该平台会根据求职者的个人情况和求职要求，通过电子邮件推送相关职位信息。

pledge.en: First Minister Nicola Sturgeon welcomed the pledge and said: "Today's announcement between ScottishPower and Glasgow City Council—to make Glasgow the UK's first net-zero city—is a very welcome step.
pledge.cn: 首席大臣尼古拉·斯特金对这一承诺表示欢迎，他说：“苏格兰电力公司和市议会宣布，格拉斯哥将成为英国第一个净零排放城市，这是令人欣喜的一步。
pledge.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

plentiful.en: Carême's cooking displays became the symbol of fine French dining; they were plentiful , beautiful and imposing.
plentiful.cn: 卡雷姆餐厅的烹饪展示成为法国高级餐饮的象征；它们数量众多、精美绝伦、气势恢宏。

plot.en: He had a gift for creating stories that consisted of deceit, robbery, murder, corruption, and other criminal offences with incredible plot twists in the storyline.
plot.cn: 他有一种天赋，能创作出包含欺骗、抢劫、谋杀、腐败和其他犯罪行为的故事，并在剧情中安排令人惊叹的转折。

plug.en: It only means that the gender gap disappears when we plug in the negative reciprocity variable.
plug.cn: 这仅仅意味着，当我们引入负互惠变量时，性别差距就消失了。
plug.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

plunge.en: A number of oil-producing countries are trimming their gasoline subsidies and raising taxes, so the net savings for global consumers is not as big as the oil price plunge might suggest.
plunge.cn: 许多石油生产国正在削减汽油补贴，增加赋税，所以对于全球的消费者而言，从汽油上节省下来的钱可能并没有像油价暴跌所暗示的那么多。

poison.en: In fact, farmers used to poison them in large numbers.
poison.cn: 实际上，农民曾经大量毒杀它们（野鸭）。
poison.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

polar.en: Visitors had a similar effect on some other species too, including polar bears, certain jungle cats and black-tailed plain dogs.
polar.cn: 访客对包括北极熊、某些丛林猫和黑尾原野犬在内的一些其他物种也产生了类似影响。

pole.en: A small plane with two sick U.S. workers arrived safely in Chile late Wednesday after leaving Antarctica in a daring rescue mission from a remote South Pole research station.
pole.cn: 一架载有两名患病美国工作人员的小型飞机于周三晚些时候安全抵达智利。此前，该飞机从南极洲一个偏远的研究站执行了一次大胆的救援任务。

polish.en: Many of us spend far too much time, energy, and money trying to polish an image of what we think will bring attention, love, and connection.
polish.cn: 我们很多人花费太多时间、精力和金钱去塑造一个我们认为能吸引关注、爱和连接的形象。

politics.en: Politics interferes with serious scientific debate.
politics.cn: 政治干扰了严肃的科学辩论。
politics.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

poll.en: People looking to stay well as they age may want to adopt a pet animal, according to new data from the University of Michigan National Poll on Healthy Aging.
poll.cn: 根据密歇根大学关于健康老龄化的全国民意调查的新数据，希望随着年龄增长保持健康的人可能会考虑收养一只宠物。
poll.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

popularity.en: Another reason for fruit juice's recent popularity is the argument that it can help to remove poisonous or harmful substances from the body.
popularity.cn: 果汁近期流行的另一个原因是有人认为它能帮助排出体内的毒素或有害物质。
popularity.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

portable.en: They sent calls for help via a portable radio.
portable.cn: 他们通过便携式无线电发出求救信号。

portion.en: "The best example is five a day, the recommendation to have at least five portions of fruit and vegetables every day.
portion.cn: “最好的例子就是每天五份，也就是建议每天至少摄入五份水果和蔬菜。”
portion.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

pose.en: It reduces various health risks posed by meat consumption.
pose.cn: 它能降低食用肉类带来的各种健康风险。
pose.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

positive.en: The opposite results of our study suggest coffee consumers acquire a taste for or an ability to detect the bitterness of caffeine due to the learned positive reinforcement brought out by caffeine.
positive.cn: “而我们得到的却是相反的结果：咖啡饮用者之所以会逐渐喜欢或更能辨别咖啡因的苦味，是由于咖啡因带来的习得性正向强化所致。

possess.en: One who enjoys playing games that require management skills to win might possess more qualities of a manager.
possess.cn: 喜欢玩需要管理技巧才能获胜的游戏的人，可能更具备管理者的素质。
possess.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

possibility.en: Crises, after all, have a way of opening people's eyes to possibilities.
possibility.cn: 毕竟，危机总能让人们看到新的可能性。
possibility.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

potential.en: They will be fearful of potential consequences.
potential.cn: 他们会担心潜在的后果。

poverty.en: By sharing knowledge of agriculture and climate with peers in countries most vulnerable to poverty and hunger, scientists can help reduce these problems.
poverty.cn: 科学家们可以与最易受贫困和饥饿问题影响的国家的同行分享农业和气候知识，从而帮助减少这些问题。

pray.en: The most interesting people aren't those who've gone on some Eat, Pray , Love journey to find themselves.
pray.cn: 最有趣的人，不是那些踏上类似《吃、祈祷、爱》式的寻爱之旅去寻找自我的人。

preach.en: Thomas, now a speaker and author of several books, also created small, independently-run residences with their own bedrooms and bathrooms, and he has been preaching a singular message that getting old is not a bad thing.
preach.cn: 托马斯现在是一名演说家，也是几本书的作者，他还建造了独立经营的小型（养老）住宅，有独立的卧室和卫生间，他一直在宣扬一个独特的信息，即变老并不是一件坏事。
preach.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

precaution.en: Advise Tunisian civilians on how to take safety precautions .
precaution.cn: 向突尼斯平民提供安全防范建议。

precious.en: They feel much of their precious time, energy and resources is wasted.
precious.cn: 他们觉得自己的大量宝贵时间、精力和资源都被浪费了。

precise.en: Whether you are taking a DNA test to build your extended DNA family tree, or want precise information on inborn health conditions, it is important to understand how accurate genetic tests are, and what information we can rely upon.
precise.cn: 无论你是通过DNA测试来构建家族谱系,还是想获取先天健康状况的精确信息,了解基因检测的准确性以及哪些信息可以信赖都至关重要。

precision.en: In a million words written over 20 years, he captured the full range of human emotions and conflicts with a precision that remains sharp today.
precision.cn: 他在用二十多年写下的百万文字中，精确地刻画了人类情感和矛盾的所有方面，其精确程度用于今日仍然十分犀利。
precision.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

predict.en: Analysts don't expect the meat-free movement to slow anytime soon; a 2021 report predicts the market will skyrocket to $74 billion by 2030—a 957 percent surge.
predict.cn: 分析师预计无肉饮食潮流不会很快减退；2021年的一份报告预测，到2030年该市场规模将飙升至740亿美元——增长幅度高达957%。

prediction.en: Keynes’s prediction of a shorter working week rests on the idea that the standard of living would continue rising for everyone.
prediction.cn: 凯恩斯预测工作周将缩短，这一预测建立在一个观点上：生活标准将持续为所有人提高。
prediction.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

preface.en: Asked how to approach a parent in this situation, psychologist Meredith Fuller answers: "Explain your needs as well as stressing the importance of the friendship. Preface your remarks with something like: 'I know you'll think I'm silly but in my house I don't want…'"
preface.cn: 当被问及在这种情况下如何与家长沟通时，心理学家梅雷迪思·富勒回答说：“解释你的需求，同时强调友谊的重要性。你可以这样开头：‘我知道你会觉得我傻，但在我家我不想……’”

preferable.en: What should people take into consideration in deciding on the most preferable protein intake?
preferable.cn: 人们在决定最佳蛋白质摄入量时应该考虑哪些因素？
preferable.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

preference.en: This is generally attributed to backward thinking and conservative values, but new research shows that such differences could be linked to differences in the preferences of males and females.
preference.cn: 这通常被认为是因为落后的思维方式和保守的价值观，但新的研究表明，这样的差异可能与男女偏好上的不同有关。

prejudice.en: Problems with this technique include the fact that it can lead to errors and prejudice.
prejudice.cn: 这种技巧的问题包括它可能会导致错误和偏见。
prejudice.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 听力

preliminary.en: A preliminary review of Mexico’s taxation found a fall in purchases of taxed drinks as well as a rise in sales of untaxed and healthier drinks.
preliminary.cn: 对墨西哥税收的初步审查发现，被征税的酒类购买数量有所下降，同时，没被征税的、相对更加有益健康的饮品的购买量有所增加。
preliminary.source: 2016年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

prescribe.en: When doctors prescribe medicine for people, they rarely consider the best time to take it.
prescribe.cn: 医生给病人开药时，很少考虑最佳服药时间。
prescribe.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

prescription.en: But UCLA pediatrician Carlos Lerner acknowledged that the pediatricians' new prescription may meet with skepticism from parents, who are anxious for advice on how to give their kids a leg up in the world.
prescription.cn: 但加州大学洛杉矶分校儿科医生卡洛斯·勒纳承认，儿科医生们的新建议可能会遭到家长的质疑，他们急于寻求如何让孩子在社会上更有优势的建议。
prescription.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

presence.en: This research found college students were more likely to choose healthy food in the presence of an observer of a different race as opposed to an observer from their own race.
presence.cn: 这项研究发现，在其他人种观察者的在场下，大学生们更倾向于选择健康食物，相比之下，同种族观察者的在场就没有这种效果。
presence.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

presentation.en: For the presentation, I'll bring my own laptop and hook it up to their projector.
presentation.cn: 关于演示报告，我会带上我自己的笔记本电脑，并连接到投影仪上。
presentation.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

presently.en: People who are not presently experiencing any symptoms of disease.
presently.cn: 目前未出现任何疾病症状的人。

preservation.en: It applies to the preservation of pandas too.
preservation.cn: 这同样适用于熊猫的保护。
preservation.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

preserve.en: They value the environmental quality they preserve over their oil imports from abroad.
preserve.cn: 他们重视他们所保护的环境质量超过从国外进口石油。

pressure.en: For college students under pressure , a dog may be the best stress fighter around according to the finding of a recent study.
pressure.cn: 最新研究显示，对于承受压力的大学生而言，养一只狗或许是缓解压力的最佳方式。

pretty.en: It's pretty incredible how it has managed to hijack the genes of the algae on which it feeds.
pretty.cn: 它窃取了它赖以生存的藻类的基因，这种方式相当难以置信。
pretty.source: 2019年12月大学英语四级考试真题（一）

prevail.en: With a literacy rate in some parts of Africa at only 22.6%, farmers are often "underpaid for their produce because they might be unaware of the prevailing prices," says Francis Dittoh, a researcher behind Mr Meteo, a speech-based weather information service.
prevail.cn: 非洲某些地区的识字率只有 22.6%，农民往往“因为不了解当前的价格而无法获得应有的农产品报酬”，语音天气信息服务 Mr Meteo 的研究员 Francis Dittoh 表示。
prevail.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

prevalent.en: For young adults without a bachelor's degree, as of 2008 living at home with their parents was more prevalent than living with a romantic partner.
prevalent.cn: 截至 2008 年，对于没有学士学位的年轻人来说，与父母同住比与伴侣同住更为普遍。

prevention.en: Activities helpful in the prevention of Alzheimer's also prevent heart disease.
prevention.cn: 有助于预防阿尔茨海默病的活动也有助于预防心脏病。

previous.en: The authors noted that previous research revealed gender differences in attitudes towards family and career.
previous.cn: 作者指出，先前的研究揭示了在家庭和职业态度上的性别差异。
previous.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

priest.en: You're subsidizing people to become priests and poets and so forth…
priest.cn: 你在资助人们成为神职人员或诗人等等。

primarily.en: Therefore, patients are directed to take most drugs during the morning or evening primarily to ensure compliance.
primarily.cn: 因此，医生通常会让患者在早晨或晚上服药，主要是为了确保用药依从性。
primarily.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

primary.en: They leaned toward wanting primary responsibility for such tasks.
primary.cn: 他们倾向于希望主要负责这类任务。
primary.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

prime.en: When he returned in 1977 to try again, he was largely regarded as past his prime.
prime.cn: 1977年Red Rum重返赛场争夺冠军时，众人普遍认为它已过巅峰。
prime.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

primitive.en: The primitive tools early humans used tell a lot about their life, but my favorite is the coin collection.
primitive.cn: 早期人类使用的原始工具能揭示他们生活的许多信息，但我最喜欢的还是钱币收藏。

principal.en: When planning for this year, our principal asked what needed to change.
principal.cn: 在制定今年的计划时,我们的校长问道:需要改变什么?

principle.en: The findings show: In principle, most people view it more when workers are replaced by other people than by robots or intelligent software.
principle.cn: 研究结果表明：原则上，大多数人更倾向于认为工人被其他人取代，而不是被机器人或智能软件取代。
principle.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

prior.en: Absorbing new information is helpful in making better decisions prior to action.
prior.cn: 吸收新信息有助于在行动前做出更好的决策。

priority.en: When making decisions, we give priority to our current frame of mind without thinking much of the consequences.
priority.cn: 在做决策时，我们往往会优先考虑自己当前的心理状态，而忽略了可能带来的后果。
priority.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

privilege.en: It has given him exceptional privilege as an ambassador.
privilege.cn: 这赋予了他作为大使的特殊特权。

probable.en: The most probable reason for the popularity of plastic lunch boxes is that they are less expensive.
probable.cn: 塑料饭盒受欢迎最可能的原因是它们价格比较便宜。
probable.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

procedure.en: A poll showed that half of medical technicians had admitted texting during a procedure .
procedure.cn: 调查表明，一半的医疗技术人员承认在外科手术过程中发过短信。

proceed.en: Ultimately, misleading results will be corrected as science proceeds; however, this process takes time.
proceed.cn: 最终，科学的发展会纠正那些误导性的结果；然而，这一过程需要时间。
proceed.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

productive.en: In a busy world, being busy doesn't stand out, nor does it mean productive, creative, accomplished, or professional.
productive.cn: 在这个忙碌的世界中，忙碌并不能让你脱颖而出，也不代表你就是高效、富有创造性、成就卓越或专业。
productive.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

productivity.en: There would be no mystery in this if Keynes had been wrong about the power of technology to increase the economy’s productivity, which he thought would lead to a standard of living “between four and eight times as high as it is today.”
productivity.cn: 如果凯恩斯对技术增强经济生产力的观点是错误的，那么这并不奇怪。他曾预测这会使得生活水平提升至今日的四至八倍。
productivity.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

professional.en: Science now suggests the right dress may give ourselves the extra edge in our professional and personal lives.
professional.cn: 科学研究现在表明，恰当的着装可能会在我们的职业和个人生活中带来额外优势。
professional.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

proficient.en: They are also just as proficient in food preparation and cooking skills.
proficient.cn: 他们也同样精通食物准备和烹饪技巧。

profit.cn: 所有收益都用于慈善事业。

profitable.en: All of which, of course, has made it highly profitable .
profitable.cn: 当然，所有这一切都让它利润丰厚。

profound.en: “We’ve seen profound changes in the last decades in what we eat largely as a result of international trade, and I think that trend toward more diversification will continue,” Janis says.
profound.cn: “在过去的几十年里，由于国际贸易的影响，我们的饮食结构发生了深刻变革。我认为，这种多元化的趋势将会继续下去，”贾尼斯表示。
profound.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

progressive.en: San Jose had social mobility comparable to Denmark’s and Canada’s and higher than other progressive cities such as Boston and Minneapolis.
progressive.cn: 圣何塞的社会流动性堪比丹麦和加拿大，比波士顿和明尼阿波利斯等进步城市还高。
progressive.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

prohibit.en: It is prohibited to feed any wild animals including birds in Rhode Island City.
prohibit.cn: 在罗德岛市，禁止喂食任何野生动物，包括鸟类。
prohibit.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

prohibition.en: In those where ties to family and community are strong, lifelong marriages can be promoted by practices such as the cultural prohibition of divorce and arranged marriages that are seen as a contract between two families, not just two individuals.

propose.en: Game Academy proposes to help gamers develop their skills using critical thinking.

proposition.cn: 这一使命基于这样的观点:所有人,无论种族、性别、收入或地域,都享有获得健康、可持续环境的道德权利。

protest.en: Taking out those parking spots, as they argued at protests and in letters to the city council, would ruin stores and restaurants along Skillman.

register.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

regulate.en: He notes that the state can only regulate public institutions in this way, but he hopes private institutions in Ohio follow the lead of the state and post similar information.
regulate.cn: 亚当·洛因博补充道，虽然州政府仅能对公立院校实施这种监管，但他希望俄亥俄州的私立院校也能效仿，主动公布相关信息。
regulate.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

regulation.en: It escapes regulation and misleads consumers.
regulation.cn: 它逃避监管，误导消费者。

reinforce.en: Our job as designers is to reinforce the airline's brand and make it more recognizable, he says.
reinforce.cn: 他说：“作为设计师，我们的工作就是强化航空公司的品牌，并增加其辨识度”。

reject.en: Workers who rejected working long hours tended to make regular adjustments in order to achieve work-life balance.
reject.cn: 拒绝长时间工作的员工往往会定期调整工作安排，以实现工作与生活的平衡。

relative.en: According to evolutionary scientists, cooperative behavior may have evolved first among relatives to promote the continuation of their genetic line.
relative.cn: 据进化科学家分析，合作行为最初可能在亲属之间演化形成，以促进基因血脉的延续。
relative.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

relativity.en: Thus, time and time's relativity are measurable by any hourglass, alarm clock, or atomic clock that can measure a billionth of a second.
relativity.cn: 因此，任何能够测量十亿分之一秒的沙漏、闹钟或原子钟都可以测量时间和时间的相对性。

relay.en: They don't relay well to speakers who read from a manual script.
relay.cn: 对于照本宣科的演讲者来说，这种表达方式效果并不好。
relay.source: 2012年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

release.en: Coca-Cola also released data detailing its funding of several medical institutions and associations between 2010 and 2015.
release.cn: 可口可乐公司还公布了相关数据，详述其在2010年至2015年期间资助数家医疗机构和协会的情况。
release.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

relevant.en: Skills acquired through gaming can be very relevant to certain areas.
relevant.cn: 通过游戏习得的技能在某些领域可能非常适用。

reliable.en: For example, tests for traits that depend on a single gene provide much more reliable results, because you can see whether a disease-causing trait is present.
reliable.cn: 例如,依赖单一基因的性状检测结果更为可靠,因为可以直接看出是否存在致病基因。

relief.en: And then there was relief when the plane came to a stop." An email from JetBlue read, "our team is working to accommodate customers on later flights.
relief.cn: 然后，当飞机停下来时，大家松了一口气。”捷蓝航空通过电子邮件表示，“我们的团队正努力为乘客安排后续航班。
relief.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

relieve.en: I've been using one since the start of last semester, and it has really helped relieve a lot of study pressure.
relieve.cn: 我从上个学期初开始一直在使用，它真的帮我缓解了很多学习压力。

religion.en: Music is often ceremonial: used in religion , ceremony, and celebration.
religion.cn: 音乐常用于宗教、仪式和庆典，具有仪式性。

religious.en: I'm deeply attached to the Puritan tradition, not in a religious sense, but they believed in working for something, working for goals, and I like that.
religious.cn: 我深深地依恋清教徒的传统，不是宗教意义上的依恋，而是他们相信要为某些东西而努力，为目标而奋斗，我喜欢这一点。
religious.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

reluctant.en: Hiring managers admit they are reluctant to hire those over 40 or 45, arguing they probably won't be a good "fit", their experience won't be relevant to the workplace, and they'll be unable or unwilling to learn new skills.
reluctant.cn: 招聘经理坦言他们不愿雇用40岁或45岁以上的求职者,理由是这些人可能不够"契合",工作经验与当前职场不相关,而且他们无法或不愿学习新技能。

rely.en: Besides, teamwork and leadership rely heavily on the power of persuasion to get things done.
rely.cn: 此外，团队合作与领导力极其依赖说服力来实现目标。

remainder.en: The ideal level of perfectly livable habitat was found to be only 80% of an area, with the remainder either too harsh or too affected by human activity.
remainder.cn: 研究发现，理想的完全宜居栖息地比例应该只占区域的80%，其余部分要么环境过于恶劣，要么受到人类活动的影响。
remainder.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

remark.en: What can we conclude about Impossible Foods' products from Joan Solsman's remark ?
remark.cn: 从琼·索尔斯曼的评论中，我们可以对Impossible Foods的产品得出什么结论？

remedy.en: But many tech home remedies can be explained by a little science.
remedy.cn: 但许多科技产品带来的家庭疗法都可以用一些科学原理来解释。
remedy.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

remote.en: The new prevalence of remote and flexible working models will likely all play important roles in how we balance our professional and personal lives.
remote.cn: 远程办公和灵活办公模式的日益普及，很可能在我们如何平衡职业生活和个人生活方面发挥重要作用。

removal.en: Every year, an average of 1,218 nose and 2,479 ear removals took place between 2010 and 2016.
removal.cn: 在2010年到2016年之间，每年平均发生了1218场鼻异物取出手术和2479场耳异物取出手术。
removal.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

render.en: The claimed health benefits of fruit and vegetable juices have rendered the industry very profitable.
render.cn: 人们宣称果蔬汁对健康有益，这使得该行业利润丰厚。

renew.cn: 她希望邀请函能再次发出。
renew.source: 2018年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

renovate.en: Great. If you don't mind, I’d like to pick your brains a bit more. Jonathan and I are thinking of renovating our sitting room, not the whole house, not yet anyway. And we'd love to get some inspiration from your experience. Are you free to come over for a coffee early next week?
renovate.cn: 太棒了。如果你不介意的话，我想向你多请教一下。乔纳森和我想翻新客厅，不是整个房子，至少不是现在。我们希望能从你的经历里得到一些灵感。你下周初有时间来喝杯咖啡吗？
renovate.source: 2020年12月大学英语四级考试真题

repay.en: "When somebody refuses to repay a loan, I turn the tables by requesting one myself," she says.
repay.cn: “当有人拒绝偿还贷款时，我就反过来向他们申请贷款，”她说。
repay.source: 2015年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

repeatedly.en: By stopping us hurting the same muscles repeatedly.
repeatedly.cn: 通过防止我们反复损伤同一块肌肉。
repeatedly.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

repetition.en: He says: "When we practice something, we are involved in the deliberate repetition of a process with the intention of reaching a specific goal."
repetition.cn: 他说：“当我们练习某件事时，我们是在有意识地重复某个过程，目的是达到某个特定的目标。”

replace.en: Whether it is going to replace conventional food is still unclear.
replace.cn: 它是否会取代普通食品，目前尚不明朗。

replacement.en: But Mr Roth says it is not sufficient as a replacement .
replacement.cn: 但罗斯先生表示，这并不能充分替代。

represent.en: This represents a considerable transfer of value from employees to employers.
represent.cn: 这象征着大量价值从员工手中转移到雇主手中。
represent.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

representation.en: Reich-Shapiro and fellow researchers made several recommendations to increase male representation in the field.
representation.cn: 赖希·夏皮罗及其研究员同事提出了一些建议，以提升男性在该领域的代表。

representative.en: Only one representative , Jad Tabet from Lebanon, tried to raise the issue.
representative.cn: 只有一名来自黎巴嫩的代表贾德·塔贝特试图提起这个问题。

reproduce.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

reproduction.en: Pandas' natural habitats are becoming less suitable for reproduction .
reproduction.cn: 熊猫的自然栖息地越来越不适宜繁殖。

reputation.en: Another possibility is that humans cooperate to gain some advantage, such as boosting reputation .
reputation.cn: 另一种可能是，人类通过合作来谋取某种利益，例如提升自身声誉。

rescue.en: The navy rescued a man who survived 24 days floating in the sea on a boat by eating tomato sauce and vegetable powder.
rescue.cn: 海军救出了一名在海上漂流24天的男子，他通过食用番茄酱和蔬菜粉维持生命。
rescue.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

resemblance.en: Physical resemblance between people was not a factor.
resemblance.cn: 外貌相似度并非考虑因素。

resemble.en: But the team found that participants' brain activity while considering their future selves more closely resembled their brain activity while thinking about a current other rather than the current self.
resemble.cn: 但研究团队发现，参与者在思考未来的自己时，大脑活动更接近于思考当前的他人，而不是思考当前的自己。

resent.en: Unfortunately many employees resent compulsory bonding and often regard these exercises as a nuisance.
resent.cn: 不幸的是，许多员工对强制性担保感到不满，并常常认为这些活动是一种麻烦。

reserve.en: The best defense against memory loss is to try to prevent it by building up your brain's cognitive reserve, Daffner says.
reserve.cn: 对抗健忘最好的办法就是通过建立大脑的认知储备来努力阻止它，达夫勒说道。
reserve.source: 2018年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

reside.en: They reside in our minds, numerical artifacts that not all humans inherit conceptually.
reside.cn: 它们存在于我们的头脑中，是一种数字工艺品，并非所有人都能从在观念上获得。
reside.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

residence.en: Thomas, now a speaker and author of several books, also created small, independently-run residences with their own bedrooms and bathrooms, and he has been preaching a singular message that getting old is not a bad thing.
residence.cn: 托马斯现在是一名演说家，也是几本书的作者，他还建造了独立经营的小型（养老）住宅，有独立的卧室和卫生间，他一直在宣扬一个独特的信息，即变老并不是一件坏事。

resident.en: It allowed Denver residents to apply for $400 in government funds before buying an electric bike from a participating shop.
resident.cn: 该计划允许丹佛居民在从参与商店购买电动自行车之前申请400美元的政府资金。
resident.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

residential.en: Officials described the structure as a mixed-use building that features commercial businesses on the first floor and residential on the second and third floors.
residential.cn: 官方表示，该建筑为混合用途楼宇，一楼为商业用房，二楼及三楼则设有住宅。
residential.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

resign.en: The following year, things got worse and Gerald Ratner was forced to resign .
resign.cn: 第二年，事情变得更糟了，杰拉德·拉特纳被迫辞职。

resignation.en: After all, existing jobs open up every day due to promotions, resignations , terminations, and retirements. (Yes, people are retiring even in this economy.)
resignation.cn: 毕竟，由于职位晋升、辞职、解雇和退休，每天都会有新的工作岗位出现。（是的，甚至在目前经济形势下，人们也要退休。）

resist.en: Neither children nor adults could resist the temptation of a free toy.
resist.cn: 孩子和成年人都无法抵挡免费玩具的诱惑。

resistance.en: It may also carry viruses that are fatal to native snakes, which do not have resistance .
resistance.cn: 它还可能携带对本地蛇类致命的病毒,而本地蛇类对这些病毒没有抵抗力。

resistant.en: The researchers are already working with food companies keen to see if their products can be made resistant to bacterial attack through alterations to the food's structure.
resistant.cn: 研究人员已经与一些食品公司合作，这些公司渴望了解是否可以通过改变食品的结构来使他们的产品能够抵抗细菌的侵袭。
resistant.source: 2000年1月英语四级 第1套 阅读

resolution.en: But if that resolution was to volunteer more, now is the best time to start.
resolution.cn: 但如果你的愿望是多参加志愿活动，现在正是开始行动的最佳时机。
resolution.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

resolve.en: Any and all "training", including inexpensive and informal training, is going to help resolve their worries about hiring someone over 45.
resolve.cn: 任何形式的培训，包括低成本的和非正式的培训，都有助于缓解他们对雇佣45岁以上人员的顾虑。
resolve.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

resort.en: They may resort to unethical means to outperform their rivals.
resort.cn: 他们可能会采取不道德的手段来超越竞争对手。
resort.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

respect.en: At the same time, your name is associated with the identity you've built up and hyphenation allows you to respect that while also respecting tradition and your husband's family's identity.
respect.cn: 同时，您的名字与已建立的身份相关联，连字符让你重视已建立的身份，同时也重视传统和你丈夫家庭的身份。

respectable.en: Vegetable planting has a respectable tradition.
respectable.cn: 种植蔬菜是一项历史悠久的传统。
respectable.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

respective.en: Grant awarders tend to favor researchers already recognized in their respective fields.
respective.cn: 科研经费授予机构往往更倾向于资助在其各自领域内已获得认可的研究人员。

respectively.en: They were established in 1185 and 1209 respectively .
respectively.cn: 它们分别成立于 1185 年和 1209 年。

respond.en: He doesn't know how to respond.
respond.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

response.en: The key is to highlight the emotional response a consumer will have by using the product.
response.cn: 关键在于突出消费者使用产品后所产生的情感反应。

responsible.en: For example, a young boy had a significant portion of his brain removed for medical reasons, which included the part of the brain responsible for sight.
responsible.cn: 例如，一个小男孩因医疗原因被切除了大脑的相当大一部分，其中包括大脑中负责视觉的区域。
responsible.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

rest.en: The rest is feedlot confined and fed grain and corn.
rest.cn: 其他的都是圈养在饲养场，用谷物和玉米喂养。
rest.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（二）

restore.en: A dry mouth may reduce taste sensitivity, but taste is restored by drinking fluids.
restore.cn: 口腔干燥可能会降低味觉敏感度，但喝水可以恢复味觉。

restrain.en: Imagine how much time we lose each moment we restrain our authentic selves in an effort to be liked.
restrain.cn: 想一想，为了让别人喜欢而压抑真实自我时，我们究竟浪费了多少宝贵时间。

restraint.en: By examining the restraints imposed on it.
restraint.cn: 通过考察对其施加的限制。
restraint.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

restrict.en: “When creating treatment plans, the aim is to optimise the radiation dose to the tumour and restrict it as much as possible to healthy surrounding tissues and organs,"" he says.
restrict.cn: "在制定治疗方案时，目标是优化肿瘤的放射剂量，同时尽可能减少对周围健康组织和器官的辐射，"他说。
restrict.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

resultant.en: Second, after identifying the cause, they zeroed in on their resultant emotions.
resultant.cn: 其次，在确定了原因之后，他们集中精力研究了由此产生的情绪。
resultant.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

resume.en: Only apply for positions you are qualified for, and make each application count, personalizing each cover letter and updating and editing your resume .
resume.cn: 只申请你有资格胜任的职位，并且认真对待每一次申请，个性化撰写每一封求职信，并更新和修改你的简历。

retail.en: The vast majority of the UK's 200,000 tons of retail sector’s annual food waste comes from supermarkets.
retail.cn: 英国零售业每年约20万吨的食品浪费，绝大部分来自超市。
retail.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

retain.en: One way we can improve the effects of fruit juice on our health is making sure we select ripe fruit to retain as much of its goodness as possible, according to Roger Clemens, professor of pharmaceutical sciences at the University of Southern California.
retain.cn: 南加州大学药物科学教授罗杰·克莱门斯表示，改善果汁对健康影响的一个方法是确保选择成熟的水果，这样可以最大程度地保留其营养价值。

retirement.en: Katharine Abraham, an economics professor, was chatting with her hairdresser about retirement plans.
retirement.cn: 经济学教授凯瑟琳·亚伯拉罕正与她的理发师闲聊退休计划。
retirement.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

retreat.en: The first is the postponement of, if not retreat from, marriage.
retreat.cn: 第一种情况是推迟结婚，甚至放弃结婚。
retreat.source: 2019年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

reunion.en: We were going to my wife's big family reunion in Auckland, New Zealand, but when we found out that Great Barrier Island, just off the coast, had been recently awarded Dark Sky Sanctuary status — a typically remote area … — we thought it would be the perfect place to relax before our busy schedule.
reunion.cn: 我们原本打算去新西兰奥克兰参加我妻子的大家庭聚会，但当我们得知距离海岸不远处的大堡礁岛最近刚被授予“暗夜天空庇护地”称号……一个典型的偏远地区时，我们觉得这里将是放松身心、缓解繁忙行程的绝佳地点。
reunion.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

reveal.en: The authors noted that previous research revealed gender differences in attitudes towards family and career.
reveal.cn: 作者指出，先前的研究揭示了在家庭和职业态度上的性别差异。
reveal.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

revenue.en: An increasing amount of data indicates that installing bike lanes raises local business revenues .
revenue.cn: 越来越多的数据表明，修建自行车道可以提高当地企业的收入。

reverse.en: This preference reverses , however, when it refers to people's own jobs.
reverse.cn: 然而，当涉及到人们自己的工作时，这种偏好则会发生逆转。

revolutionary.en: The revolutionary idea of a self-service grocery, where people could hunt and gather food from aisles rather than asking a clerk to fetch items from behind a counter, first came about in America.
revolutionary.cn: 自助式杂货店的革新想法最先出现在美国，人们可以在过道里寻找和收集食物，而不是让店员从柜台后面取东西。

revolve.en: Different people tend to be exposed to different forms of the golden rule, based on factors such as the religion in their society. However, all forms of the golden rule revolve around the same concept.
revolve.cn: 基于诸如社会宗教等因素的影响，不同人们往往会接触到不同形式的黄金法则。但是，所有形式的黄金法则以相同的概念为中心。

rhythm.en: Music is tied to specific perceptual, mental, and emotional faculties, including language, motor control, sound analysis (all musical systems have a distinct pitch and quality), and aesthetics (their tunes and rhythms are balanced between repetitiveness and chaos).
rhythm.cn: 音乐与特定的感知、心理和情感能力有关，包括语言、运动控制、声音分析（所有音乐系统都有独特的音高和音色），以及审美（他们的曲调和节奏在重复与混乱之间保持平衡）。

rib.en: …And in May Burger King introduced barbecue pork ribs at $7 for eight.
rib.cn: 五月份，汉堡王推出了烤猪肋，八根售价7美元。

ribbon.en: Back at rehearsal , Justin Le, aged 18, tied a red ribbon around his waist to practice jumping.
ribbon.cn: 回到彩排时，18岁的Justin Le在腰间系了一条红色丝带来练习跳跃。

ridicule.en: It's a common story—one we frequently ridicule and readily dismiss, for example, by claiming that women tend to complain more than men, despite the growing sum of research that underlines the problem.
ridicule.cn: 这是一个经常听到的故事——一个我们频频对之加以嘲弄、欣然忽视的故事（比如，我们会说女性往往比男性更爱抱怨），尽管越来越多的研究强调了这一问题。
ridicule.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

riot.en: Food riots and hunger make news. The trend lying behind these matters is rarely talked about.
riot.cn: 粮食暴动和饥饿会成为新闻。这些问题背后的趋势却很少有人提及。

rip.en: They extensively rip off legitimate websites and use a different website name.
rip.cn: 他们从合法网站大量剽窃内容，然后换一个网站名称。

rival.en: Having a rival can keep you committed to achieving your goals and enhance your overall performance.
rival.cn: 拥有一个竞争对手能激励你坚持实现个人目标，并进一步提升你的整体表现。
rival.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

roar.source: 2015年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

roast.en: A pair of entrepreneurs are planning to build and launch a spacecraft that would carry and roast coffee beans in outer space.
roast.cn: 两名企业家正计划建造并发射一艘宇宙飞船，该飞船会把咖啡豆带到外太空烘焙。

rod.en: Ben Franklin, one of America's founding fathers, didn't just invent the lightning rod .
rod.cn: 美国开国元勋之一本杰明·富兰克林发明的不仅仅是避雷针。

role.en: But poor diet and physical inactivity also each increase the risk of heart disease and have a role to play in the development of some cancers.
role.cn: 然而，不良的饮食习惯以及缺乏运动也会增加患心脏病的风险，并且会对癌症的形成产生作用。
role.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（一）

roller.source: 2016年6月大学英语六级考试真题（一）

romance.en: If you believe that you have found true romance, and your culture tells you that this is what a long-term relationship should be based on, there is less need to rely on social or family pressures to keep couples together, O'Sullivan argues.
romance.cn: 要是你相信你已经找到了真爱，你的文化也告诉你这就是长期的关系应该建立的基础，那么你们就不用那么需要社会和家庭压力来维系夫妻关系了，奥沙利文如此认为。
romance.source: 2013年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

romantic.en: Tests that offer to find your perfect romantic match and those claiming to predict personality or talents based on your DNA are pure nonsense.
romantic.cn: 那些声称能通过DNA找到你的完美伴侣,或者能根据DNA预测性格或天赋的检测,完全是无稽之谈。

rouse.en: Still, that's not always the case: When roused during REM sleep, 25% of the kids in Foulkes' studies had no recollection of dreaming, a trend that continues through age 9.
rouse.cn: 不过情况并非总是如此：在福尔克斯的研究中,25%的儿童在快速眼动睡眠期间被唤醒时完全不记得做过梦,这种现象一直持续到9岁。

route.en: The city analyzed the data for businesses along those routes and found that by the third year, sales grew faster on five of the streets than in the district overall, on average — up to five times faster, in fact.
route.cn: 市政府分析了沿线商家的数据，发现到第三年，其中五条街道的销售额增速超过了所在区域的整体水平——平均而言，最高甚至快了五倍。
route.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

routine.en: It's great to stay fit and healthy, but standard exercise routines and sports only work the same muscles repeatedly.
routine.cn: 保持身体健康非常重要，但传统的锻炼方式和运动项目往往只是反复锻炼同一组肌肉。

royalty.en: The first known collections were held by royalty, and were not open to the public.
royalty.cn: 已知最早的动物收藏属于皇室所有，并不对公众开放。
royalty.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

rub.en: This process can be compared to the way the skin hardens in response to constant rubbing or pressure.
rub.cn: 这个过程可以比作皮肤在不断摩擦或压力下变硬的过程。

rug.en: Last year, she made a trip to Morocco, and returned with rugs, pots, dishes, and pans.
rug.cn: 去年，她去了趟摩洛哥，带回了地毯、锅、碟和盆子。

rural.en: Most Africans live in rural areas that are tough to wire for Internet access.
rural.cn: 大多数非洲人居住在农村地区，这些地区难以架设网络线路接入互联网。
rural.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

sack.en: Plastic boxes changed to lined cloth sacks , and eventually, globalism brought tiffin containers from India and bento boxes from Japan.
sack.cn: 塑料饭盒变成了有衬里的布袋子，最终，全球化还带来了印度的午餐盒以及日本的便当盒。

sacrifice.en: They make many personal sacrifices in exchange for income today.
sacrifice.cn: 他们为了获得今天的收入，做出了许多个人牺牲。

safe.en: As soon as it's safe enough to be outside, couriers start distributing accumulated mail on the still-accessible routes.
safe.cn: 一旦确认外出是安全的，邮递员就开始沿着可通行的路线派发囤积的邮件。
safe.source: 2019年12月大学英语四级考试真题（三）

saint.en: It will take place at the Saint James playing fields in Glasgow on Saturday, 18 May from 10:00 am until 7:00 pm.
saint.cn: 比赛将于5月18日星期六上午10点至下午7点在格拉斯哥圣詹姆斯运动场举行。

sample.en: It's relatively easy to tell whether two DNA samples belong to close relatives.
sample.cn: 判断两份DNA样本是否来自近亲相对容易。
sample.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

satellite.en: Moving on to communications, very soon, cars will be linked to GPS satellites , so they'll do all the driving for you.
satellite.cn: 说到通讯，汽车很快将和GPS卫星连线，这样它们就会帮你开车。

satisfaction.en: Customer satisfaction takes a hit as well.
satisfaction.cn: 客户满意度也受到了影响。

satisfactory.en: They find it satisfactory on the whole.

sauce.en: The navy rescued a man who survived 24 days floating in the sea on a boat by eating tomato sauce and vegetable powder.
sauce.cn: 海军救出了一名在海上漂流24天的男子，他通过食用番茄酱和蔬菜粉维持生命。
sauce.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

saving.en: The staff believe he squeezed himself out of a gap located around new energy-saving bulbs installed inside the snake house.
saving.cn: 工作人员认为，他从蛇舍内新安装的节能灯泡周围的缝隙中挤了出来。
saving.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

scan.en: To help explain this seemingly irrational behavior, Hershfield and his team scanned the brains of study participants while asking them to what degree various traits—like "honorable" or "funny" —applied to their current self, their future self, a current other, or a future other.
scan.cn: 为了解释这种表面上非理性的行为，赫什菲尔德和他的团队对研究被试进行了大脑扫描，同时询问他们在多大程度上认为诸如“光荣”或“风趣”等特质适用于他们目前的自己、未来的自己、现在的他人或未来的他人。
scan.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

scandal.en: In 2012, 125 students at Harvard were caught up in a scandal when it was discovered they had cheated on a take-home exam for a class entitled "Introduction To Congress".
scandal.cn: 2012年，哈佛大学的125名学生卷入了一场丑闻，当时他们被发现在一次带回家完成的名为“国会入门”课程的考试中作弊。

scarcity.en: As my colleague Vann Newkirk reported, Puerto Rico is still confronting economic and structural destruction and resource scarcity from 2017's Hurricane Maria.
scarcity.cn: 正如我的同事 Vann Newkirk 报道的那样，波多黎各仍在应对 2017 年飓风玛丽亚造成的经济和结构破坏以及资源短缺问题。

scare.en: And it scared them a bit, Dichtwald said.
scare.cn: 迪希特瓦尔德认为，这让他们感到有些害怕。

scatter.en: It may well be that the messy nature of their relationship with human efforts induces more animals to scatter or travel further, and might result in greater genetic connectivity and enhanced population persistence.
scatter.cn: 人类保护措施与熊猫之间这种若即若离的关系，很可能会导致更多熊猫扩散到更远区域，从而可能增强基因交流并提高种群存续能力。
scatter.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

schedule.en: We were going to my wife's big family reunion in Auckland, New Zealand, but when we found out that Great Barrier Island, just off the coast, had been recently awarded Dark Sky Sanctuary status — a typically remote area … — we thought it would be the perfect place to relax before our busy schedule .
schedule.cn: 我们原本打算去新西兰奥克兰参加我妻子的大家庭聚会，但当我们得知距离海岸不远处的大堡礁岛最近刚被授予“暗夜天空庇护地”称号……一个典型的偏远地区时，我们觉得这里将是放松身心、缓解繁忙行程的绝佳地点。

scheme.en: Greenpeace, among others, is also pushing for a "deposit return" scheme.
scheme.cn: 包括绿色和平组织在内的许多组织也在推动“押金返还”计划。
scheme.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

scholar.en: When Stanford University scholar Andrea Lunsford gathered data on the rates of errors in “freshman composition” papers going back to 1917, she found that they were virtually identical to today.
scholar.cn: 斯坦福大学学者安德里亚·伦斯福德搜集了自1917年以来大学新生作文中的错误率数据，结果发现这些数据与现在的错误率几乎没有区别。

scholarship.en: It's not as popular as some sports, which means he has better odds of possibly getting an athletic scholarship in the future.
scholarship.cn: 篮球虽然不及某些运动那么热门，但这反而意味着他日后争取体育奖学金的机会可能更大。
scholarship.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

schooling.en: At the same time, one of the hottest trends in public schooling is what's often called dual-language or two-way immersion programs.
schooling.cn: 与此同时，当今公立学校教育中最热门的趋势之一就是常说的双语或双向的沉浸式教学课程。
schooling.source: 2020年9月大学英语六级考试真题

scope.en: “The scale and scope of their answers were amazing," he says.
scope.cn: "他们回答的规模和广度令人惊叹，"他说。

scratch.en: He apologized for scratching an athlete's gold medal.
scratch.cn: 他为划伤一名运动员的金牌而道歉。

screw.en: They can screw us up and set us back.
screw.cn: 他们可能会让我们陷入困境，使我们受到打击。

script.en: I forgot to bring my scripts .

seal.en: Police have sealed off the runway and say it is unclear if it was an accident or an attempted robbery.
seal.cn: 警察已封锁机场跑道，并称尚不确定这是一场意外还是蓄意抢劫。
seal.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

secondary.en: We find that if pupils take part in Design Ventura in Year Nine it can be the trigger which leads them to opt for it at General Certificate of Secondary Education, so we are helping to keep alive something which is crucial to industry and entrepreneurship.
secondary.cn: 我们发现，如果学生在九年级参加"设计创业"项目，这可能成为他们之后选择普通中等教育证书课程的契机，因此我们正在帮助保持这种对工业和创业至关重要的活动。
secondary.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

section.en: What's more, that section of road saw new businesses open, while Queens overall had a net loss.
section.cn: 更重要的是，这段路上有新商家开业，而皇后区整体却出现了商户净减少。

secure.en: In the U.S. labor market, the primary concern of people with less schooling and fewer skills is to secure any employment even if it is low-paid.
secure.cn: 在美国劳动市场中，学历较低和技能较少的人最关心的是能否找到工作，哪怕这份工作的薪水很低。
secure.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

seemingly.en: A day later the students were offered a choice of snacks and drinks in a seemingly unrelated context.
seemingly.cn: 一天后，学生们在一个看似无关的场景中被提供了零食和饮料供选择。
seemingly.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

segment.en: It is in no one's interest to keep a large segment of the population on the margins of society.
segment.cn: 将一大部分人留在社会的边缘不符合任何人的利益。

select.en: The theme for last year's competition was “Move”, and Hourican began with three groups working in lunch breaks and after school before selecting the group with the most innovative idea.
select.cn: 去年比赛的主题是"移动"，霍里肯最初组织了三个小组在午休和放学后工作，随后选择了拥有最具创新理念的那个小组。

selection.en: When trial participants were asked to choose between photographs of faces of a different race from theirs, response times were slower and selections were 5% less accurate.
selection.cn: 当要求参与者从不同于自身种族的面孔照片中进行选择时，他们的反应时间变长，选择的准确率也下降了5%。
selection.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

semester.en: I've been thinking about moving off campus next semester.
semester.cn: 我在考虑下学期搬出校园住。
semester.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

senator.en: He's even written to his state senator about the torture of dolphins in sea parks.
senator.cn: 他甚至给州参议员写信，抗议海洋公园折磨海豚的行为。

senior.en: You'd expect that people who are particularly sensitive to the bitter taste of caffeine would drink less coffee, said study senior researcher Marilyn Cornelis.
senior.cn: “你或许会认为，对咖啡因苦味格外敏感的人会少喝咖啡，”研究资深作者玛丽琳·科内利斯说。

sensible.en: He observed that people living in green spaces were less stressed, and less stressed people made more sensible decisions and communicated better.
sensible.cn: 他发现，住在绿化好的地方的人们感受到的压力较小，而压力较小的人们会做出更加理智的决定并且能与人更好地沟通。

sensitive.en: You'd expect that people who are particularly sensitive to the bitter taste of caffeine would drink less coffee, said study senior researcher Marilyn Cornelis.
sensitive.cn: “你或许会认为，对咖啡因苦味格外敏感的人会少喝咖啡，”研究资深作者玛丽琳·科内利斯说。
sensitive.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

sensitivity.en: This sensitivity isn't simply a matter of taste, either, but rather is influenced by a person's genetic makeup, the researchers said in the study.
sensitivity.cn: 研究人员在论文中指出，这种敏感性不仅仅是口味问题，而是受个人基因构成的影响。

sensor.en: To address that weakness, Horn is now working with the car company Toyota to enable a form of bilateral control via modifications to existing adaptive cruise control systems, which use forward-facing sensors to judge the distance to the vehicle ahead.
sensor.cn: 为了解决这一缺陷，霍恩目前正与丰田汽车公司合作，通过改进现有的自适应巡航控制系统来实现双边控制，该系统使用前向传感器来测量与前车的距离。

sequence.en: These multi-stage lives will create extraordinary variety across groups of people simply because there are so many ways of sequencing the stages.
sequence.cn: 这种多阶段的人生会在人群中创造出非凡的多样性，原因很简单，因为人生阶段的排列顺序有很多种。

session.en: A 45-minute session in a darkened enclosure with peace and quiet costs $25.
session.cn: 在昏暗封闭的环境里安静地进行45分钟的治疗，费用是25美元。
session.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

settle.en: Regular shoppers at the supermarket are familiar with the site of several cats settling down in the shop aisles.
settle.cn: 超市的常客们已经习惯了看到几只猫在商店过道里安家的景象。
settle.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

settlement.en: In May, the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) and Outten & Golden LLP announced a historic class-action $5m settlement with JP Morgan Chase on behalf of male employees who claim they were illegally denied access to paid parental leave.
settlement.cn: 5月，美国公民自由联盟与奥滕和戈登律师事务所联合宣布，代表那些声称非法被剥夺带薪育儿假权利的男性员工，与摩根大通达成一项具有历史意义的500万美元集体和解协议。

severe.en: These changes are severe enough to interfere with social or occupational functioning.
severe.cn: 这些变化严重到足以干扰社会或职业功能。
severe.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

shade.en: Last year, a German federal court said the shade of the gold wrapping was also protected.
shade.cn: 去年，德国联邦法院表示，金色包装的色调同样受到保护。

shallow.en: Happiness without meaning characterizes a relatively shallow, self-absorbed or even selfish life…
shallow.cn: 无意义的快乐是一种相对肤浅，只专注自我，甚至是自私的生活。

shameful.en: In the world's richest nation, homelessness on this scale should be shameful and shocking.
shameful.cn: 在世界上最富裕的国家，出现如此大规模的无家可归现象应该令人感到羞耻和震惊。

shed.en: It's true that many animals shed tears, especially in response to pain.
shed.cn: 确实很多动物都会流泪，尤其是作出疼痛反应时。
shed.source: 2014年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

sheer.en: For one, the sheer number of hours we pass watching TV dwarfs the time we spend on anything else.
sheer.cn: 首先，我们纯粹用于看电视的时间超过了我们做其他事情的时间。
sheer.source: 2015年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

shell.en: Its redwood shell makes it resemble "a large party lantern " at night, according to one observer.
shell.cn: 一位观察者称，它的红木外壳使它在夜晚看起来像“一个大型派对灯笼”。

shelter.cn: 为无家可归者提供住所

shift.en: Only a very few have shifted to cycling, and even those almost certainly won't cycle in Boston's snowy winters.
shift.cn: 只有极少数人改骑自行车，而且这些人在波士顿下雪的冬天几乎肯定也不会骑车。
shift.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

shipment.en: By pumping more than 1 million barrels a day from the reserve for the next two three decades, lobbyists claim, the nation could cut back on imports equivalent to all shipments to the U.S. from Saudi Arabia.
shipment.cn: 游说者声称，通过在未来二三十年内每天从该储备中抽取超过 100 万桶石油，美国可以减少相当于沙特阿拉伯向美国出口的所有石油进口量。

shiver.en: But even if your job doesn't give you shivers of joy with each new day, working is a part of what each of us does and the contribution we make to society.
shiver.cn: 即使你的工作不一定让你在每一天都因快乐而颤抖，工作也是我们每个人生活的一部分，也是我们对社会所做的贡献。
shiver.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

shortage.en: The labor market is likely cooling, because even a shortage of workers isn't overcoming the historic imbalance between employers and employees in the US: the volume of income that workers take home as a proportion of what the US economy produces is still falling.
shortage.cn: 劳动力市场可能正在冷却，因为即使劳动力短缺，也无法克服美国雇主与雇员之间的历史性失衡：工人收入占美国经济产出的比重仍在下降。

shortly.en: Firefighters responded to the three-story building shortly after 1 P.M. for a reported structure fire, according to Norwalk Deputy Fire Chief Adam Markiewicz.
shortly.cn: 诺沃克副消防局长亚当·马尔凯维奇表示，消防员收到建筑失火讯息，于下午一点刚过不久抵达现场三层建筑。

shrimp.en: In some southeast Asian countries, shrimp farming does disastrous damage to marine ecosystems.
shrimp.cn: 在一些东南亚国家，养虾对海洋生态系统造成了灾难性的破坏。
shrimp.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

shrink.en: Organic farmers never used neonics, the controversial pesticides that have been linked to shrinking bee populations worldwide.
shrink.cn: 有机农民从未使用过新烟碱类杀虫剂，这类具有争议的杀虫剂与全球蜜蜂数量减少有关。

shrug.en: Stress is so normalized that it is easy for women to shrug off those symptoms as simply the consequences of stress.
shrug.cn: 压力是如此的常态化，以至于女性很容易忽视这些症状并把它们简单地视为压力的结果。

sideways.en: Looking sideways to see how fast your neighbor eats.
sideways.cn: 侧目观察邻居吃饭的速度。
