sight.en: Like a lot of spots in New Zealand, there are whale-watching trips and you might just catch sight of sharks.
sight.cn: 像新西兰的许多地方一样，这里有观鲸之旅，你也可能会看到鲨鱼。
sight.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

signal.en: He also tried to light a fire to send a distress signal without success.
signal.cn: 他还尝试点火发出求救信号，但未成功。

signature.source: 2020年7月英语四级 第1套 听力

significant.en: Overall, the new study found no significant relationship between participants' month of birth and symptoms of depression or anxiety.
significant.cn: 总体而言，新研究未发现参与者的出生月份与抑郁或焦虑症状之间存在显著相关性。

silicon.en: No one is spared his sharp analysis: not the easy targets of 19th century women's crippling fashions nor the modern uniforms of Silicon Valley T-shirts.
silicon.cn: 没有人能逃脱他犀利的分析：无论是 19 世纪女性令人窒息的时尚，还是硅谷 T 恤衫的现代制服，都难逃他的抨击。
silicon.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

simplicity.en: They should welcome the simplicity of the message, Lemner said.
simplicity.cn: 莱姆纳说，他们应该欢迎这种简洁明了的信息。

simplify.en: Clearly, there are plenty of ways to keep track of your job search and making the effort to simplify your job search will pay off.
simplify.cn: 显然，有很多方法可以跟踪你的求职进度，努力简化你的求职过程将会得到回报。

sincere.en: He wanted to make a sincere apology to Jimmy.
sincere.cn: 他想真诚地向吉米道歉。

singular.en: Thomas, now a speaker and author of several books, also created small, independently-run residences with their own bedrooms and bathrooms, and he has been preaching a singular message that getting old is not a bad thing.
singular.cn: 托马斯现在是一名演说家，也是几本书的作者，他还建造了独立经营的小型（养老）住宅，有独立的卧室和卫生间，他一直在宣扬一个独特的信息，即变老并不是一件坏事。

sitting.en: Great. If you don't mind, I’d like to pick your brains a bit more. Jonathan and I are thinking of renovating our sitting room, not the whole house, not yet anyway. And we'd love to get some inspiration from your experience. Are you free to come over for a coffee early next week?
sitting.cn: 太棒了。如果你不介意的话，我想向你多请教一下。乔纳森和我想翻新客厅，不是整个房子，至少不是现在。我们希望能从你的经历里得到一些灵感。你下周初有时间来喝杯咖啡吗？
sitting.source: 2020年12月大学英语四级考试真题

situate.en: It is situated on the Mediterranean Sea and surrounded by France on three sides.
situate.cn: 它坐落在地中海，三面被法国环绕。

skeleton.en: What we have not yet understood is the way the tiny machines in front of us are changing our skeletons , possibly altering not just the way we behave, but even the very shape of our bodies.
skeleton.cn: 我们还未完全明了的是，我们面前这些微型机器如何正在影响我们的骨架结构，它们可能不仅仅改变了我们的行为举止，甚至有可能改变了我们身体的形状。

sketch.en: Later, in his cook books, he would often include a sketch of himself, so that people on the street would be able to recognize-and admire-him.
sketch.cn: 后来，在他的烹饪书中，他经常会附上自己的素描，以便街上的人能够认出他并欣赏他。
sketch.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

skilled.en: You sit next to the elderly woman who unfortunately turns out to be quite skilled at picking pockets.
skilled.cn: 你坐在老妇人旁边，不幸的是，她扒窃口袋很熟练。

skirt.en: She never bought clothes and always wore the same long, ragged black skirt.
skirt.cn: 她从来不买衣服，总是穿着同一条破破的黑长裙。

slap.en: Everything changed for 7-year-old Tariq when he slapped some butter on an ear of corn.
slap.cn: 7岁的塔里克在玉米棒上抹了一些黄油，一切都发生了改变。

slender.en: To further protect the house from hurricane damage, Huff raised it 2.7 meters off the ground on timber pilings -- long, slender columns of wood anchored deep in the sand.
slender.cn: 为了进一步保护房屋免受飓风破坏，赫夫用木桩将房屋抬高了 2.7 米，木桩是细长的木柱，深深地固定在沙子里。

slice.en: You can cut it into thin slices and eat it on its own.
slice.cn: 你可以把它切成薄片，空口吃。

slide.en: Some people have said aging is more a slide into forgetfulness than a journey towards wisdom.
slide.cn: 有人认为，衰老更多的是逐渐忘却，而非通往智慧的道路。

slightly.en: A phantom jam begins when a car in dense traffic slows down even slightly , which causes the car behind that vehicle to slow even more—and the slowing action spreads backward through the lane of traffic like a wave, getting worse the farther it spreads.
slightly.cn: 幻影拥堵始于高密度交通中一辆车的轻微减速，这导致后车不得不更大程度地降速——这种减速效应如波浪般向后传播，越传越严重。

slip.en: If you have memory slips, you probably needn't worry.
slip.cn: 如果有时记不住事情，可能也不必担心。
slip.source: 2018年6月大学英语四级考试真题（一）

slippery.en: The company spent the last five years developing solar panels that are only about a quarter of an inch thick and are strong enough to stand up to heavy highway traffic without breaking or making the roads more slippery.
slippery.cn: 该公司在过去五年里开发出了厚度仅约四分之一英寸的太阳能电池板，这种电池板足够坚固，可以承受高速公路上的重型车辆通行，而不会破裂或使道路更加湿滑。
slippery.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

slogan.en: "You'll want an iPad just so you can wear this" is the slogan for one of the new lab coats designed with large pockets to accommodate tablet computers.
slogan.cn: “穿上它，你就会想要一部iPad”是其中一款新实验服的标语，这些新实验服设计有可以装平板电脑的大口袋。

slope.en: What do we learn about the lower slopes of Mount Etna?
slope.cn: 我们能了解到埃特纳火山较低坡度的哪些信息？

smash.en: Located on the shore of Sullivan's Island off the coast of South Carolina, the award-winning cube-shaped beach house was built to replace one smashed to pieces by Hurricane Hugo 10 years ago.
smash.cn: 这座屡获殊荣的立方体形海滨别墅坐落在南卡罗来纳州海岸附近的苏利文岛岸边，是为了取代10年前被飓风“雨果”摧毁的旧别墅而建。1989年9月，“雨果”飓风袭击南卡罗来纳州，造成18人死亡，并损毁或摧毁了该州36000栋房屋。
smash.source: 2004年1月英语四级 第1套 阅读

snack.en: Andre's company, Alicia offers breakfast and snacks specifically aimed at business meetings and events.
snack.cn: Andre的公司Alicia专门为商务会议和活动提供早餐和小食。

soak.en: In the mornings, you can go down to a small local cafe, soaking up the sun's rays and drinking coffee.
soak.cn: 早上，你可以去一家本地的小咖啡馆，享受阳光，喝杯咖啡。

soar.en: Soaring energy bills have made things worse.
soar.cn: 飙升的能源账单更是雪上加霜。

sociable.en: Being sociable helps improve one's quality of life.
sociable.cn: 社交有助于提高生活质量。

society.en: Schools are not just a microcosm of society, they mediate it too.
society.cn: 学校不仅仅是社会的缩影，它们还起到调节社会的作用。
society.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（二）

sociology.en: David Hunt, an associate professor in sociology at Augusta University, which has rolled out digital textbooks across its math and psychology departments, told BuzzFeed News that he understands the utility of using systems that require access codes.
sociology.cn: 戴维·亨特是奥古斯塔大学的一位社会学副教授，该校已经在其数学系和心理学系推出了数字教科书。亨特告诉BuzzFeed新闻机构，他了解需要访问密码的在线系统的实用性。

soda.en: The teens chose healthy snacks and drinks (such as fruit or water) more often over unhealthy options (like biscuits and soda ).
soda.cn: 青少年更多地选择了健康的零食和饮料（如水果或水），而非不健康的选项（如饼干和汽水）。

soften.en: While some of the budget airlines might use brighter, bolder shades, most others go with softened tones.
soften.cn: 虽然有些廉价航空公司可能会使用更明亮、更醒目的颜色，但大多数其他航空公司则选择柔和的色调。

solar.en: Great Barrier Island has no public facilities and the 950 people living there (though only about half permanently) rely on solar and wind energy, and bottled gas for cooking.
solar.cn: 大障礁岛没有公共设施，居住在那里的约950人（尽管其中只有大约一半是永久居民）依靠太阳能、风能和瓶装燃气做饭。
solar.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

sole.en: However, this would be considered an insult in Muslim countries, where one would never show the sole of the foot to a guest.
sole.cn: 然而，这在穆斯林国家会被认为是侮辱，那里的人绝不会给客人看脚底。

solemn.en: We will argue over it and may even, as a nation, make some fairly solemn -sounding commitments to avoid it.
solemn.cn: 作为一个国家，我们将为此争论，甚至可能做出一些听起来相当郑重的承诺来避免它。

solidify.en: It is an intuitive way to solidify friendship.
solidify.cn: 这是一种巩固友谊的直观方法。

solution.en: Again, robots might be the solution.
solution.cn: 同样，机器人可能是解决方案。
solution.source: 2020年9月大学英语六级考试真题

sophisticated.en: A sophisticated technology doing several tasks effectively at once.
sophisticated.cn: 一种能够同时高效完成多项任务的先进技术。
sophisticated.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

spacecraft.en: He also helped dock two spacecraft .
spacecraft.cn: 他还参与了两艘航天器的对接工作。

spacious.en: But I think most of us want spacious homes.
spacious.cn: 但我认为我们大多数人都想要宽敞的房子。

span.en: Their attention span cannot be expanded.
span.cn: 他们的注意力持续时间无法延长。

spark.en: The price of school uniforms can spark panic among families struggling with the high cost of living.
spark.cn: 校服价格可能让生活成本高的家庭倍感压力。
spark.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

spatial.en: Research shows that given 15 minutes of free play, four- and five-year-olds will spend a third of this time engaged in spatial, mathematical, and architectural activities.
spatial.cn: 研究表明，如果给四岁和五岁的孩子 15 分钟的自由玩耍时间，他们会将其中三分之一的时间用于空间、数学和建筑活动。
spatial.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

specialist.en: It could also be a forerunner for many other countries in the world that on foreign imports of energy, said Ali Hajji, a solar energy specialist and engineering professor.
specialist.cn: 太阳能专家兼工程学教授阿里·哈吉表示，这也可以成为世界上许多其他依赖外国能源进口的国家的先例。
specialist.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

specialize.en: It previously specialized in private charter flights for government officials.
specialize.cn: 该公司此前专门从事政府官员的私人包机服务。

species.en: They examined how visitors affected the behaviour of more than 250 species in zoos.
species.cn: 他们研究了来访者如何影响动物园中250多种动物的行为。

specific.en: Music is tied to specific perceptual, mental, and emotional faculties, including language, motor control, sound analysis (all musical systems have a distinct pitch and quality), and aesthetics (their tunes and rhythms are balanced between repetitiveness and chaos).
specific.cn: 音乐与特定的感知、心理和情感能力有关，包括语言、运动控制、声音分析（所有音乐系统都有独特的音高和音色），以及审美（他们的曲调和节奏在重复与混乱之间保持平衡）。

specifically.en: In an extensive study published in 2015, researchers analyzed a total of 99 choice studies and specifically looked at those cases in which reducing choices helped to boost sales.
specifically.cn: 2015年发表的一项大规模研究中，研究人员分析了总共99个关于选择的研究案例，特别关注了那些通过减少选择来提升销售的情况。

specify.en: Some passengers remain missing, the Costa Rican Foreign Ministry said, but did not specify how many.
specify.cn: 哥斯达黎加外交部表示一些乘客仍未被找到，但没有具体说有多少人。

specimen.en: It is displaying more fossil specimens .
specimen.cn: 它正在展出更多化石标本。

speculate.en: We speculate that it may have to do with what the mice are paying attention to while they are in the dark.
speculate.cn: 我们推测，这种变化可能与小鼠在黑暗环境中所关注的事物有关。
speculate.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

sphere.en: But even when these accounts touch on real concerns, they do not really reflect the great mass of everyday teenage social behavior, the online chat, the texting, the surfing, and the emergence of a new teenage sphere that is conducted digitally.
sphere.cn: 然而，即便这些报道触及了一些真实的担忧，它们并没有切实反映青少年日常社交活动的主流——在线聊天、发信息、上网冲浪，以及在数字世界中形成的新型青少年交际领域。

spherical.en: Beginning their astronomical PowerPoint demonstration using a green laser pointer, Hilde and Orla showed us the Messier 4 spherical cluster with white dwarf stars, Saturn and its rings, the Southern Cross and the Milky Way, which stretched across the sky.
spherical.cn: 希尔德和奥拉使用绿色激光笔开始了他们的天文PowerPoint演示，向我们展示了梅西耶4球状星团及其中的白矮星、土星及其光环、南十字座和横亘天际的银河。
spherical.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

spill.en: Hundreds of frozen turkeys were spilled all over the road.
spill.cn: 数百只冷冻火鸡撒落在了路上。

spite.en: In spite of progress, the number of women in top positions of big companies remains extremely small.
spite.cn: 尽管取得了一些进展，但大型公司高层女性人数仍然极少。

split.en: The researchers stated that differences in enjoyment of household and childcare tasks matched how men and women chose to split tasks.
split.cn: 研究者表示，对家务和育儿任务的享受程度的差异与男女分工的方式是一致的。

spoil.en: The anti-pollution message of the reverse graffiti artists confuses city authorities since the main argument against graffiti is that it spoils the appearance of both types of property: public and private.
spoil.cn: 反向涂鸦艺术家反污染的标语让城市当局为难，因为反对涂鸦的主要理由是它破坏了公共和私人财物的外观。
spoil.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第2套 阅读

spokesman.en: What did the spokesman of the supermarkets say regarding the employees' demand?
spokesman.cn: 超市发言人对员工的要求作了什么回应？

sponsor.en: In one survey, 89% of employees perceived companies that sponsored volunteer activities as creating a better working environment, and 75% said volunteering was critical to their well-being.
sponsor.cn: 一项调查显示，89%的员工认为组织志愿活动的公司能创造更好的工作环境，75%的员工表示志愿服务对他们的身心健康至关重要。

spontaneous.en: American audiences prefer natural, spontaneous delivery that conveys a lively sense of communication.
spontaneous.cn: 美国观众更喜欢自然、随意的表达方式，这种方式能传达出生动活泼的交流感。

spot.en: Their conclusions about what The Guardian described as this “sweet spot ” are in line with the so-called Goldilocks principle: that there can be just the right amount of something.
spot.cn: 他们关于《卫报》所描述的这个"最佳点"的结论与所谓的"金发姑娘原则"相符：即事物存在一个恰到好处的量。

spray.en: After contacting the chocolate manufacturer, the firefighters resorted to spraying hot, pressurized water to get rid of the sticky substance.
spray.cn: 联系巧克力生产商后，消防员们只好用高压热水喷洒巧克力，以清除粘性物质。

spur.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 听力

squeeze.en: Those that believed they fell claimed that the capitalists squeezed every ounce of surplus they could from the working class.
squeeze.cn: 认为他们陷入困境的人声称资本家从工人阶级榨取了每一分剩余价值。

stack.en: Let's say you are trying to learn some new and rather difficult English vocabulary using a stack of cards.
stack.cn: 假设你正在尝试用一叠卡片来学习一些新的、比较难的英语词汇。
stack.source: 2009年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

stain.en: But such behavior may stain your reputation and strain relationships important to your success.
stain.cn: 然而，这样的行为可能会损害你的名誉，并对你成功所依赖的重要人际关系产生不良影响。
stain.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

stake.en: In sum, we all have a common stake in our school, our community, and our society.
stake.cn: 总之，我们在学校、社区和社会中都有共同的利益。

stale.en: If you eat stale bread, your hair will curl.
stale.cn: 如果吃了不新鲜的面包，你的头发会卷曲。
stale.source: 2017年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

stamp.en: Success authors usually serve up vivid stories about how exceptional businesspeople stamped their personalities on a company or rescued it from a life-threatening crisis.
stamp.cn: 成功学书籍的作者们通常在书中提供生动的故事，讲述卓越的商务人士如何在公司刻上自己的人格烙印，或者如何在生死存亡的危机时刻拯救公司的命运。
stamp.source: 2014年12月大学英语六级考试真题（一）

standpoint.en: They note that the value of women's rights has often been questioned from an economic standpoint .
standpoint.cn: 他们指出，女性权利的价值经常从经济角度受到质疑。

startle.en: You will not be surprised if a stranger tried to shake hands when you were introduced, but you might be a little startled if they bowed, started to stroke you or kissed you on both cheeks.
startle.cn: 如果陌生人在自我介绍时试图与你握手，你不会感到惊讶；但如果他们鞠躬、抚摸你或亲吻你的双颊，你可能会感到有些吃惊。

statement.en: This understanding also holds true in the business world, where an organization’s stories, and the stories its leaders tell, helps solidify relationships in a way that factual statements don’t.
statement.cn: 这一理解也适用于商业世界，在商业世界中，组织的故事及其领导人讲述的故事有助于巩固关系，这种方式是事实陈述无法做到的。
statement.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

statistic.en: What does the passage say statistics prove?
statistic.cn: 文章中统计数据证明了什么？
statistic.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

status.en: Luxury goods target our feelings of self-worth, acceptance, and status in the world.
status.cn: 奢侈品迎合了我们对自我价值、认同感和社会地位的追求。
status.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

steady.en: The divorce rate in the county has been on a steady rise.
steady.cn: 该县的离婚率一直在稳步上升。
steady.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

steep.en: For example, statistical studies that he and a colleague built of corn and soybean production in the US show a steep decline after crossing the 30℃ temperature threshold."
steep.cn: 例如，沃尔弗拉姆·施伦克及其同事进行的统计研究表明，美国的玉米和大豆生产量在温度超过30摄氏度的阈值之后会显著下降。

steer.en: Can doing one’s homework really steer families to the best places? It is genuinely hard to know.
steer.cn: 做足功课真的能引导家人去往最好的地方吗？这真的很难说。
steer.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

stem.en: Nightmares stem from exposure to trauma, an overactive imagination, and the normal stresses of everyday life.
stem.cn: 噩梦源于创伤经历、过于活跃的想象力以及日常生活的压力。
stem.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

sticky.en: After contacting the chocolate manufacturer, the firefighters resorted to spraying hot, pressurized water to get rid of the sticky substance.
sticky.cn: 在与巧克力制造商取得联系后，消防队员们借助于喷射热的加压水来去除这粘性物质。

stiff.en: But it is still somewhat restricted, particularly when the language moves away from stiffer commands into more human interactions.
stiff.cn: 但其功能仍存在一定的局限性，尤其是在语言从“更僵硬”的指令模式转向更具人性化交流模式时更是如此。

stimulate.en: People over 45 stimulated by training suffer shorter periods of unemployment, get more job offers and have greater satisfaction in them.
stimulate.cn: 45岁以上的人如果接受培训，失业期会更短，获得更多的工作机会，并且在工作中获得更大的满意度。
stimulate.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

stimulus.en: A few years later, a large defense buildup finally provided a fiscal stimulus adequate to the economy's needs — and suddenly industry was eager to employ those "unadaptable and untrained" workers.
stimulus.cn: 几年后，一次大的国防建设终于给经济需求提供了足够的财政刺激——突然间，行业迫切想要雇用那些“缺乏适应力和训练的”工人。
stimulus.source: 2016年6月大学英语六级考试真题（三）

sting.en: Although fatalities are rare, the stings can cause extreme pain and stop people breathing.
sting.cn: 尽管少有致人死亡事故，但这些刺能造成极度疼痛，让人呼吸停止。
sting.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

stir.en: During the British winter, the thought of two weeks in a coastal villa with soul- stirring views of the sea and a huge pool to enjoy is enough to offset the labor until the holidays start.
stir.cn: 在英国的冬天，一想到能在海滨别墅里待两周，享受着摄人心魄的海景和巨大的游泳池，就足以抵消假期开始之前的辛劳。

stock.en: Back in 1974, only 10% of marine fish stocks had been overfished.
stock.cn: 早在1974年，只有10%的海洋鱼类资源被过度捕捞。

storage.en: For example, eating at night can lead to weight gain over time because food intake at night leads to increased fat storage .
storage.cn: 例如，夜间进食会随着时间推移导致体重增加，因为夜间摄入的食物会增加脂肪储存。

strain.en: Generally, though, a 140-pound person should not exceed 120 grams of protein per day, particularly because a high protein diet can strain kidney and liver function and increase risks of developing heart disease and cancer.
strain.cn: 通常而言，一个体重约63公斤的人每天的蛋白质摄入量不应超过120克。这是因为过高的蛋白质摄入可能会给肾脏和肝脏带来负担，同时还可能增加患心脏病和癌症的风险。

strap.en: If you want to make it even harder, use a bag with handles rather than a strap .
strap.cn: 如果你想增加难度，可以使用带提手的包而不是带肩带的包。

strategic.en: New findings suggest that the kinds of complex and strategic self-presentation behaviour we see in adults appear at a much younger age than previously known.
strategic.cn: 新的研究结果表明，我们在成人身上观察到的那些复杂而有策略性的自我展示行为，其出现年龄要比此前已知的早得多。

strategy.en: Psychologists have long been interested in how we construct our identities and the sorts of strategies that we use to present ourselves in society.
strategy.cn: 心理学家一直以来都对人们如何构建自我身份以及在社会中展示自己所采用的各种策略充满兴趣。
strategy.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

stretch.en: Kids need time every day to run, jump, stretch and play.
stretch.cn: 孩子们每天都需要时间活动身体，比如奔跑、跳跃、伸展和玩耍。
stretch.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

striking.en: One study of ninth-grade students found that 50 percent of friendships among ninth graders changed from one month to the next, signaling striking instability in friendships.
striking.cn: 一项针对九年级学生的研究发现，九年级学生中有50%的友谊在一个月的时间里就会发生变化，这表明友谊存在显著的不稳定性。
striking.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

strip.en: The store's card reader failed to scan the card's magnetic strip .
strip.cn: 商店的读卡器无法扫描该卡的磁条。

stripe.en: Bent stripes, called chevrons, painted on the roads make drivers think that they are driving faster than they really are, and thus drivers slow down.
stripe.cn: 道路上涂绘的弯曲条纹（称为人字形条纹）会让司机误以为自己开得比实际速度快，从而导致司机减速。
stripe.source: 2000年1月英语四级 第1套 阅读

strive.en: Strive hard to perfect their skills.

stroke.en: Diets high in fibre have been linked to a lower risk of developing heart disease, stroke , high blood pressure and diabetes, and it's recommended adults consume 30g per day.
stroke.cn: 高纤维饮食与降低心脏病、中风、高血压和糖尿病的风险有关，专家建议成年人每天应摄入30克纤维。

studio.en: We also loved visiting the potter Sarah Harrison, who showed us round her studio at Shoal Bay harbour, and her many pots and jugs, plates and bowls and colourful mosaics.
studio.cn: 我们也很喜欢拜访陶艺家莎拉·哈里森，她在浅湾港口的工作室带我们参观了她的许多壶、罐、盘、碗和彩色马赛克。
studio.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

stuff.en: They have loads of stuff there on display.
stuff.cn: 那里陈列着琳琅满目的展品。

stuffy.en: Yes, the classrooms would probably still smell like paint, making the air stuffy.
stuffy.cn: 是的,教室里可能还会有油漆味,空气会比较闷。

submit.en: Each participating school may submit just one proposal.
submit.cn: 每所参与的学校只能提交一份提案。

subsequent.en: In a research paper, Evil Genius, … the behavioral scientists Francesca Gino and Scott Wiltermuth wanted to examine whether people who behave unethically in one task are more creative than others on a subsequent task, even after controlling for differences in baseline creative skills.
subsequent.cn: 在一篇名为《邪恶的天赋》的研究论文中，行为科学家弗朗西丝卡·吉诺和斯科特·威尔特穆斯想要研究在一项任务中做出不道德行为的人在接下来的任务中，是否比其他人更有创造力，即使在控制了创造技能基准的差异之后也是如此。
subsequent.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

substance.en: This finding is surprising, given that bitterness often serves as a warning mechanism to convince people to spit out harmful substances, scientists said.
substance.cn: 科学家表示，这一研究结论颇为意外，因为苦味通常充当一种警示机制，促使人们把有害物质吐出来。
substance.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

substantial.en: A substantial part of this, they report, is "widespread ageism" on the part of hiring managers.
substantial.cn: 他们在报告中指出，这在很大程度上源于招聘经理普遍存在的"年龄歧视"。

substitute.en: Beans are an especially excellent protein substitute.
substitute.cn: 豆类是一种特别理想的蛋白质替代品。
substitute.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

subtract.en: In simple terms, this totals the value of all goods and services produced and subtracts loss in value of factories and equipment.
subtract.cn: 简单地说，就是产出的所有商品和服务的价值总和，减去工厂和设备的支出。
subtract.source: 2015年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

suburb.en: The locals are a relaxed and friendly bunch — a lot of them told us that it's like what Waiheke Island (now in effect a suburb of Auckland) was in the 1970s when it was a commune of artists and people wanting to escape the city.
suburb.cn: 当地人悠闲友好——很多人告诉我们，这里就像瓦伊基岛在1970年代时的样子，那时它是艺术家和想要逃离城市的人们的公社，而如今已成奥克兰的一个郊区。

subway.en: Well, for example, the subway system could have air conditioning.
subway.cn: 嗯，举个例子，地铁系统可以安装空调。
subway.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

succeed.en: Student tutors feel upset when their teachable agents fail, but happy when these virtual pupils succeed as they derive pride and satisfaction from someone else's accomplishment.
succeed.cn: 在可教代理没学会的时候，当辅导老师的学生会感到失落，但是当这些虚拟的学生学会了的时候，他们会感到开心，因为他们从别人的成就中获取了自豪感和满足感。
succeed.source: 2018年6月大学英语四级考试真题（三）

succession.en: Should you look at the same words in rapid succession or look at the word and then have some delay before you look at it again?
succession.cn: 应该快速连续地看同一个词，还是看一眼这个词后稍等片刻再看一眼？
succession.source: 2009年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

successive.en: He was the first horse to take successive firsts since Reynoldstown in 1935-1936.
successive.cn: 他是自 1935-1936 年雷诺兹敦大赛以来第一匹连续获得冠军的赛马。
successive.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

successor.en: This "successor principle" is part of the foundation of our numerical cognition, but requires extensive practice to understand.
successor.cn: 这种“继承原则”是我们数字认知的基础之一，但需要大量的练习才能理解。
successor.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

suffer.en: She suffered a great deal during the Second World War.
suffer.cn: 她在第二次世界大战期间经历了极大的苦难。
suffer.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

sufficient.en: His lack of sufficient sleep at night.

suggest.en: In fact, when Twenge previously used this data to suggest a screen time effect, some commentators were quick to raise this problem.
suggest.cn: 事实上，当特文格先前用这些数据指出屏幕使用时间的影响时，一些评论员很快就提出了这个问题。
suggest.source: 2019年12月大学英语六级考试真题（一）

sunrise.en: In agrarian, pre-industrial Europe, "you'd want to wake up early, start working with the sunrise, have a break to have the largest meal, and then you'd go back to work," says Ken Albala, a professor of history at the University of the Pacific.
sunrise.cn: 在进入工业社会之前的欧洲农业社会里，“你会想要早早醒来，在太阳升起的时候就开始工作，接着休息一下吃一顿丰盛的午餐，然后再继续工作。”美国太平洋大学的历史学教授肯·阿尔巴拉这样说道。
sunrise.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

sunset.en: From sunrise to sunset , my father, my younger brother and I cut and very large yards in well-to-do part of the city.
sunset.cn: 从日出到日落，我和父亲、弟弟在城里富裕人家的大院子里修剪草坪。

superficial.en: Our always-on world of social media may result in more connections, but they are superficial and can get in the way of building a real sense of belonging.
superficial.cn: 我们一直在线的社交媒体世界可能会产生更多联系，但这些联系是表面的，可能会妨碍我们建立真正的归属感。

superior.en: But the end result is surely superior .
superior.cn: 但最终的结果肯定是生产出最优质的（牛仔裤）。

supervise.cn: 对所有学校进行持续监督。
supervise.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

supplement.en: Global retail sales of protein supplement products reached an astonishing US$ 18.9 billion in 2020.
supplement.cn: 2020年，蛋白质补充剂产品在全球零售市场上的销售额高达惊人的189亿美元。
supplement.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

supply.en: Great Barrier Island is not connected to any Public power supply lines.
supply.cn: 大障礁岛没有接入任何公共电力供应线。

surgery.en: But a few years after his surgery , scientists found that he could still see.
surgery.cn: 但在手术几年后，科学家们发现他仍然保有视力。

surplus.en: Those that believed they fell claimed that the capitalists squeezed every ounce of surplus they could from the working class.
surplus.cn: 认为他们陷入困境的人声称资本家从工人阶级榨取了每一分剩余价值。

surrender.en: …people will surrender personal information like Social Security numbers just to get their hands on a pitiful 50-cents-off coupon.
surrender.cn: 人们会交出如社保号等个人信息，以得到一张可怜的五折优惠券。
surrender.source: 2010年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

survey.en: For the survey, researchers polled about 2,000 US adults from ages 50 to 80.
survey.cn: 在这项调查中，研究人员对大约2000名年龄在50至80岁的美国成年人进行了问卷调查。
survey.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

survival.en: Groups of highly cooperative individuals have higher chances of survival because they can work together to reach goals that are unattainable to less cooperative groups.
survival.cn: 高度合作的群体拥有更强的生存优势，因为他们能够齐心协力，完成那些合作程度较低的群体难以企及的目标。

survive.en: The navy rescued a man who survived 24 days floating in the sea on a boat by eating tomato sauce and vegetable powder.
survive.cn: 海军救出了一名在海上漂流24天的男子，他通过食用番茄酱和蔬菜粉维持生命。
survive.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

suspect.en: Helping search for the suspect of the crime.
suspect.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

suspend.en: Denver is suspending its popular electric bike incentive program.
suspend.cn: 丹佛市正在暂停其受欢迎的电动自行车激励计划。

suspicion.en: In the early days, as the supermarket multiplied, so did our suspicion of it.
suspicion.cn: 在早期，随着超市的成倍增长，我们对它的怀疑也在增加。

sustain.en: The problem is that such an impulse is hard to sustain . Across the country, many similar families were unable to maintain the initial boost in morale.
sustain.cn: 问题是这样的推动力很难维持。在全国各地，许多类似的家庭都无法维持最初高涨的士气。

sway.en: How do the clothes we wear sway our evaluation of ourselves?
sway.cn: 我们穿的衣服如何影响我们对自己的评价？
sway.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

swell.en: Each March, this tiny village swells up in numbers, because it is located in the middle of a race that takes place every year.
swell.cn: 每年三月，这个小村庄的人数都会暴增，因为它位于每年都会举行的比赛的路程中间。

swing.en: City officials cooperated with the 4-H members in planting trees, building cooking facilities, pick-me tables, swings and public rest rooms.
swing.cn: 市政府官员与 4-H 成员合作，种植树木，建造烹饪设施、取餐台、秋千和公共洗手间。
swing.source: 2013年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

switch.en: If US workers want to switch jobs, they'd better do it now.
switch.cn: 如果美国工人想换工作，他们最好现在就采取行动。

symbol.en: The new year—according to the Chinese lunar calendar—will begin on Saturday and marks the Year of the Rooster, which is thought to be a symbol of positivity.
symbol.cn: 根据中国农历，新的一年是鸡年，将从周六开始，鸡年被认为是积极的象征。

sympathetic.en: So you being busy doesn't make me sympathetic at all, because busy is the state of the world.
sympathetic.cn: 所以你的忙碌并不能引起我的同情，因为忙碌是这个世界的普遍状态。

sympathize.en: He's always been very sensitive and sympathizes with animals.
sympathize.cn: 他一直都体贴动物，对动物充满同情心。

symptom.en: Instead, it's a group of symptoms caused by other conditions.
symptom.cn: 相反，它是一组由其他疾病引起的症状。
symptom.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

tackle.en: In England, there has been a focus on tackling absenteeism from school.
tackle.cn: 在英国，解决学校缺勤问题一直是重点关注的议题。

tame.en: They are quite easy to tame.
tame.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

technician.en: Traditionally, a hundred samples would take lab technicians more than two days to examine, but for a rat it takes less than 20 minutes.
technician.cn: 传统上，100个样品需要实验室技术人员检测两天以上，但是对于一只老鼠而言，耗时不到20分钟。

tedious.en: Yes, we grown-ups can be tedious and limiting in our need for reality.
tedious.cn: 是的，我们成年人有时会很乏味，而且由于过于追求现实而显得局限。

teen.en: The Center for Disease Control has also found that teens are far less physically active than they were even a decade ago.
teen.cn: 疾病控制中心还发现，青少年的体力活动比十年前要少得多。
teen.source: 2020年7月大学英语六级考试真题

temper.en: They were also rated similarly on self-control such as the ability to regulate their temper .
temper.cn: 他们在自我控制方面的得分也差不多，比如控制脾气的能力。

temporary.en: Dementia is not temporary confusion or forgetfulness that might result from an infection that heals without treatment.
temporary.cn: 痴呆不是由可治愈的感染引起的暂时性混乱或健忘。

tend.en: Participants in the diversity condition tended to click on job listings from companies with slightly higher diversity scores than those in the baseline condition.
tend.cn: 相比对照组，多元化测试组的参与者更倾向于点击那些多元化评分稍高的公司职位列表。

tendency.en: Secondly, the test supported the assumption that people with a tendency to exhibit the Impostor Phenomenon devalue their objectively measured performance and attribute positive results to external causes such as luck and chance, but not to their own abilities.
tendency.cn: 其次，实验支持了一种假设：倾向于出现冒名顶替现象的人会贬低他们客观测量的表现，并将积极结果归因于外部因素，如运气和机会，而非自身能力。

tender.en: "I love imagining what even the most run-down house could look like with a little tender loving care," she says.
tender.cn: "我喜欢想象，即使是最破旧的房子，只要稍加修缮，也能焕然一新，"她说。

terminal.en: India launched its helicopter taxi service on Monday, promising to ferry customers, the 40 miles between Bangalore's electronic city tech hub and the international airport terminal in 15 minutes.
terminal.cn: 周一，印度推出了直升机出租车服务，承诺在15分钟内将客户从班加罗尔电子城科技中心运送到国际机场航站楼，两地相距40英里。

territory.en: "It's certainly new territory , especially as home security cameras become easier to install, "says Lizzie Post, president of the Emily Post Institute, America's foremost manners advisors.
territory.cn: “这无疑是一个全新的领域，尤其是在家庭安全摄像头的安装变得越来越容易的情况下，”美国首屈一指的礼仪顾问机构艾米莉·波斯特学院院长莉齐·波斯特说道。

terrorist.en: Failing states are of international concern because they are a source of terrorists , drugs, weapons and refugees, threatening political stability everywhere.
terrorist.cn: 这些瘫痪的国家是受到国际关注的，因为它们是恐怖分子、毒品、武器和难民的源头，威胁着全球的政治稳定。

textile.en: Given how large the textile and cotton industries are, they take up a lot of our fresh water demands across the world, according to The Huffington Post.
textile.cn: 根据《赫芬顿邮报》的报道，考虑到纺织和棉花行业的规模，它们占据了世界各地对淡水的大量需求。
textile.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

theme.en: The theme for last year's competition was “Move”, and Hourican began with three groups working in lunch breaks and after school before selecting the group with the most innovative idea.
theme.cn: 去年比赛的主题是"移动"，霍里肯最初组织了三个小组在午休和放学后工作，随后选择了拥有最具创新理念的那个小组。
theme.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

theoretical.en: Let’s compare a theoretical financial education subject to the standard compulsory English class.
theoretical.cn: 让我们把理论的金融教育课程和现有的必修英语课做个对比。
theoretical.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

therapy.en: This study shows that traditional stress management approaches aren't as effective for this population compared with programs that focus on providing opportunities to interact with therapy dogs.
therapy.cn: 这项研究显示，对于这个群体而言，相较于那些让他们有机会与治疗犬互动的项目，传统的压力管理手段效果并不显著。
therapy.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

thereby.en: The trend began in 2007, when leading wheat-exporting countries such as Russia and Argentina limited or banned their exports, in hopes of increasing local food supplies and thereby bringing down domestic food prices.
thereby.cn: 这一趋势始于 2007 年，当时俄罗斯和阿根廷等主要小麦出口国限制或禁止小麦出口，希望增加当地粮食供应，从而降低国内粮食价格。
thereby.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

thesis.en: A colleague mentioned the book, but I've been so busy writing my thesis that I haven't been able to read for pleasure in months.
thesis.cn: 一位同事向我推荐了这本书，但由于我一直在忙着写论文，已经好几个月没能抽空读书了。

thirsty.en: About a million bottles are bought every minute, not only by thirsty tourists but also by many of the 2.1 billion worldwide who live with unsafe drinking water.
thirsty.cn: 每分钟约有100万瓶瓶装水售出，购买者不仅有口渴的旅行者，还有全球各地21亿生活在没有安全饮用水地区的人。

thorough.en: The company was unable to confirm whether the recent earthquakes had contributed to the dams' wall collapse, but said it was conducting a thorough investigation.
thorough.cn: 该公司无法确认近期地震是否导致大坝坝体坍塌，但表示正在进行彻底调查。

thoughtful.en: Analytical decision-makers benefit from a deliberate and thoughtful approach, but the style also has shortcomings.
thoughtful.cn: 分析型决策者得益于这种审慎而深思熟虑的方法,但这种风格也有其不足之处。
thoughtful.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

threaten.en: Environmentalists have long believed that building roads or homes near the bears may threaten their survival by “reducing or fragmenting their natural habitats".
threaten.cn: 环保主义者长期以来一直认为，在熊的栖息地附近修建道路或住宅可能会因为"减少或分割它们的自然栖息地"而威胁它们的生存。
threaten.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

thrive.en: We make these observations as research psychologists who have studied how schools and families can help young people thrive.
thrive.cn: 作为研究学校和家庭如何帮助年轻人茁壮成长的研究心理学家，我们得出了这些观察结论。
thrive.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

thrust.en: Even that percentage is likely inflated by men thrust into their caretaker role by a downsizing.
thrust.cn: 然而这个比例也有可能是被夸大的——有一部分男性是被开除后，不得不在家照顾起了孩子。

thumb.en: It also watches for what's called 'close-by hands', where both hands are close together near the top of the wheel, so the driver can type with both thumbs and drive at the same time.
thumb.cn: 它还会观察所谓的“双手靠近方向盘”的情况，即双手靠近方向盘顶部，以便驾驶员可以用两个拇指打字并同时驾驶。

tide.en: And the man was shocked to wake up and find the tide had come in and completely surrounded him, cutting him off from the shore.
tide.cn: 男子醒来后震惊地发现潮水已经上涨，将他完全包围，与海岸隔绝开来。

timber.en: At the time, most large homes were constructed of timber and brick.
timber.cn: 那时候，大多数的大型宅邸都由木料和砖块建造而成。
timber.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

timely.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

token.en: They regard gifts as a token of friendship.
token.cn: 他们将礼物视为友谊的象征。

tolerance.en: They differed in their tolerance of irregular tones.
tolerance.cn: 他们对不规则音调的容忍度不同。
tolerance.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

tolerant.en: But I have to be tolerant of customers because they pay my salary, and that's something I can't afford to forget.
tolerant.cn: 但我必须对顾客保持宽容，因为他们支付我的工资，我不能忘记这一点。

toll.en: Such incidents take a tremendous toll on our nation's economy and our individual well-being.
toll.cn: 此类事件对我国经济和个人福祉造成了巨大损失。

tone.en: This is intentional as the informal tone of the assistant helps create an emotional attachment.
tone.cn: 这是有意为之的，因为助手的非正式语气有助于建立一种情感依恋。

torch.en: I actually had one leg inside the bedroom when I suddenly realized that someone was shining a torch up at me.
torch.cn: 我当时一只脚已经踏进了卧室，突然意识到有人正用手电筒照着我。

torture.en: He's even written to his state senator about the torture of dolphins in sea parks.
torture.cn: 他甚至给州参议员写信，抗议海洋公园折磨海豚的行为。

toss.en: In a pilot study published in The Sport Psychologist journal in 2010, University of Bern psychologist Daniel Erlacher instructed participants to dream about tossing coins into a cup.
toss.cn: 在2010年发表在《运动心理学家》期刊上的一项初步研究中，伯恩大学的心理学家丹尼尔·埃拉赫尔教参与者梦到向杯子里扔硬币。
toss.source: 2020年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

trace.en: It would be common sense for people to use small tents and leave no trace of their visit.
trace.cn: 人们应当使用小型帐篷并确保露营后没有留下痕迹。
trace.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

track.en: This type of study can't say exactly what kind of exercise is best, or how much is needed — only a study that has a placebo group and tracks people going forward can do that, said Keith Fargo, director of scientific programs and outreach at the non-profit Alzheimer's Association.
track.cn: 这种类型的研究无法准确指出哪种运动最好，或需要多少运动量——只有对比设有安慰剂对照组并进行长期追踪的研究才能做到这一点，非营利机构阿尔茨海默病协会的科学项目与外展部主任基思·法戈说。

tragedy.en: Carême's childhood was one part tragedy, equal part mystery.
tragedy.cn: 卡雷姆的童年一半是悲剧，一半是谜团。
tragedy.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

tragic.en: That's a shocking and tragic number for a region that's home to some of the richest people in the world.
tragic.cn: 对于一个居住着世界上最富有的人的地区来说，这是一个令人震惊和悲痛的数字。
tragic.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

transaction.en: They are vital to keeping a dominant position in business transactions.
transaction.cn: 它们对于在商业交易中保持主导地位至关重要。
transaction.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

transfer.en: There is no point in transferring office work to working from home.
transfer.cn: 将办公室工作转移到居家办公毫无意义。

transform.en: "We're honored to be a part of transforming the way Denver wants to move around,"said Grace Rink, Denver's chief climate officer.
transform.cn: “我们很荣幸能成为改变丹佛人出行方式的一部分，”丹佛市首席气候官格蕾丝·林克表示。
transform.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

transmission.en: As said before, with the right equipment and the right know-how, it's possible to jam any wireless transmission.
transmission.cn: 就像之前说的，有了合适的设备与正确的知识，干扰无线信号是可能的。

transmit.cn: 它是通过教科书传播的。

transplant.en: But if we keep clearing up the myths and learning more about the eyes, some day a full transplant may be possible.
transplant.cn: 但是，如果我们不断澄清误解，更多地了解眼睛，或许有一天，完全移植眼睛是有可能的。

transport.en: She is used to taking public transport .
transport.cn: 她习惯乘坐公共交通工具。

transportation.en: New research by Horn and MIT postdoctoral associate Liang Wang, published in the journal IEEE Transactions on Intelligent Transportation Systems, shows how bilateral control can fight the problem.
transportation.cn: 霍恩及其麻省理工学院博士后研究员梁·王共同完成的一项新研究发表在《IEEE 交通运输智能系统汇刊》上，该研究展示了双边控制如何解决这一问题。

trash.en: Every week since last April, Andrea Belcher has been doing something slightly unusual and amusing when she takes out her trash.
trash.cn: 自去年4月以来，安德里亚·贝尔彻每周都会在倒垃圾时做一些不太寻常和有趣的事情。
trash.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

tray.en: The cook put a cheeseburger and an applesauce cup on his tray .
tray.cn: 厨师把一个芝士汉堡和一小杯苹果酱放在托盘上。

treatment.en: Dementia is not temporary confusion or forgetfulness that might result from an infection that heals without treatment.
treatment.cn: 痴呆不是由可治愈的感染引起的暂时性混乱或健忘。
treatment.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

treaty.en: International treaties regarding space travel programs.
treaty.cn: 关于太空旅行计划的国际条约。
treaty.source: 2018年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

tremendous.en: Manufacturing and shipping of plastic water bottles consume a tremendous amount of fossil fuels.
tremendous.cn: 塑料水瓶的生产和运输消耗大量的化石燃料。
tremendous.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

trial.en: This is the first trial that demonstrates that there is something about highly processed foods independent of those nutrients that causes people to overeat.
trial.cn: 这次试验首次证明，高度加工食品本身有导致人们过度饮食的原因，而不仅仅是因为其营养成分。
trial.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

triangular.en: Back in Belgium, the scientists looked at the ants under an electronic microscope and found that their thick, triangular hair reflects light like a prism, giving them a metallic reflection and protecting them from the sun's awful heat.
triangular.cn: 回到比利时，科学家们用电子显微镜观察这些蚂蚁，发现它们浓密的三角形毛发像三棱镜一样反射光线，产生金属般的反射效果，保护它们免受太阳可怕的热量的伤害。
triangular.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

trifle.en: You will probably never think of fashion as a trifle again.
trifle.cn: 你可能再也不会把时尚当成无关紧要的事了。
trifle.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

trigger.en: Highlight the emotional response it will trigger in the consumer.
trigger.cn: 突出它能在消费者身上引发的情感反应。

triumph.en: To determine what separates science crowdfunding triumphs from failures, a team led by science communications scholar Mike Schafer of the University of Zurich examined the content of the webpages for 371 recent campaigns.
triumph.cn: 为了找出科学众筹成败的原因，苏黎世大学科学传播学者麦克·莎菲尔率领的团队调查了近期371项活动的网页内容。
triumph.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

troop.en: The Olympic suffered two crashes with other ships and went on to serve as a hospital ship and troop transport in World War I.
troop.cn: 奥林匹克号曾遭遇两次与其他轮船相撞，之后继续作为医疗船和军队运输船在第一次世界大战中服役。

troublesome.en: I'm starting to realize that painting my house is far more troublesome than I had anticipated.
troublesome.cn: 我开始意识到，粉刷房子比我想象的要麻烦得多。

try.en: Scientists have tried to tap Internet donors, too, with mixed success.
try.cn: 科学家也试图利用网络捐赠者，结果成败参半。
try.source: 2019年12月大学英语四级考试真题（三）

tuition.en: This includes tuition , fees, graduation rates, and more.
tuition.cn: 这涵盖了学费、各项费用、毕业率等多方面因素。

tunnel.en: Then, on race day, he watched as the cars rocketed out of a tunnel and went screaming toward a tight turn with the city's harbor and the Mediterranean Sea in the background framing the scene.
tunnel.cn: 然后，在比赛日，他看着赛车从隧道里飞驰而出，疾驶向一个急转弯，城市的港口和地中海的背景勾勒出了这一场景。

tutor.en: During the course of preparing for Design Ventura, teachers receive training and support while students get tutoring from designers.
tutor.cn: 在筹备 Design Ventura 的过程中，教师会接受培训和支持，而学生则会得到设计师的指导。
tutor.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

twist.en: He had a gift for creating stories that consisted of deceit, robbery, murder, corruption, and other criminal offences with incredible plot twists in the storyline.
twist.cn: 他有一种天赋，能创作出包含欺骗、抢劫、谋杀、腐败和其他犯罪行为的故事，并在剧情中安排令人惊叹的转折。
twist.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

ultimate.en: The ultimate goal of scientists is to produce clones of talented police dogs that can be trained in months instead of years.
ultimate.cn: 科学家们的最终目标是培育出具有天赋的警犬克隆体，使其训练时间由原来的数年缩短至数月。

uncover.en: Nick Cooper, the founder and co-owner of villa booking company Villa Plus, estimates his company has uncovered more than 200 fake villa websites over the past two years, and doesn't believe enough is being done.
uncover.cn: 别墅预定公司Villa Plus的创始人及共有者Nick Cooper估计，他的公司在过去两年间发现了超过200个伪造别墅网站，而且认为目前我们采取的措施不够。
uncover.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

underestimate.en: People who systematically underestimate themselves and their own performance suffer from the so-called Impostor Phenomenon.
underestimate.cn: 那些系统性低估自己和自我表现的人会遭遇所谓的冒名顶替综合征。

undergo.en: This characteristic is particularly apparent in a new study, focusing on people who underwent a hemispherectomy, a surgical procedure in which half of the brain is removed to treat illness.
undergo.cn: 这一特性在一项新研究中表现得尤为明显，该研究关注了接受半脑切除术的患者，这是一种通过切除半个大脑来治疗疾病的手术。

undergraduate.en: The state attracts more undergraduate students than it sends to colleges out of state.
undergraduate.cn: 俄亥俄州吸引的本科生数量超过了选择到州外就读的学生数量。

underline.en: It's a common story—one we frequently ridicule and readily dismiss, for example, by claiming that women tend to complain more than men, despite the growing sum of research that underlines the problem.
underline.cn: 这是一个经常听到的故事——一个我们频频对之加以嘲弄、欣然忽视的故事（比如，我们会说女性往往比男性更爱抱怨），尽管越来越多的研究强调了这一问题。

underneath.en: If you eat something too hot or too cold, or if the tooth is worn down enough where the tissue underneath is exposed, all of those things cause pain, and then the pain causes the person not to use that tooth to try to protect it a little bit more.
underneath.cn: 如果你吃了太热或太凉的东西，或者牙齿磨损严重以至于露出了下层的组织，这些都会造成疼痛。而且疼痛会使人们避免使用那颗牙齿，从而多为牙齿提供一些保护。

undertake.en: A greater responsibility for the culinary world to undertake .
undertake.cn: 烹饪界肩负着更大的责任。

undertaking.cn: 他们全力支持他的事业。
undertaking.source: 2005年12月英语四级 第1套 听力

undoubtedly.en: There are undoubtedly hundreds of great resources out there for those wishing to improve their financial literacy, but while I was researching, I still kept wishing that I didn't have to play catch-up with the money world.
undoubtedly.cn: 毫无疑问，有很多优秀的资源可以帮助人们提高金融素养，但在我研究的过程中，我仍然希望自己不必在金融领域苦苦追赶。

uneasy.en: I'm feeling a bit uneasy about meeting my boss as well.
uneasy.cn: 我对见老板这件事也有些忐忑。

unemployment.en: However, it does not take into account unemployment , pollution, health, life expectancy, or free time.
unemployment.cn: 然而，这并未将失业、污染、健康、预期寿命或空闲时间考虑在内。

unique.en: Each of the healthy eating cultures has its own unique features.
unique.cn: 每一种健康饮食文化都有其独特的特点。
unique.source: 2022年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

universal.en: Share your observations about the world around you—interesting stories you heard or things you noticed—and you may be surprised by the universal connection they inspire.
universal.cn: 要分享你对周遭世界的观察所得——听到的趣闻或者注意到的事物——可能出乎你意料的是，它们能激发普遍的联结。

universe.en: Often made fun of in gaming circles as a“spreadsheet simulator”, the economy of the fictional EVE universe is driven by real market principles.
universe.cn: 这款游戏常被游戏圈戏称为'电子表格模拟器'，但《星战前夜》虚拟宇宙中的经济体系确实是由真实的市场原理驱动的。

upright.en: This manual fixation-an indirect by-product of walking upright on two legs­ has helped yield numbers in most cultures, but not all.
upright.cn: 这种对“手”的依赖——人类用两条腿直立行走的间接副产物——在多数文化中帮助产生了数字，但并非所有的文化都是如此。

upward.en: Some San Jose residents say that as inequality has grown in recent years, upward mobility has become much more
upward.cn: 一些圣何塞居民表示，近年来随着不平等加剧，向上流动性变得更加困难。

urge.en: To urge manufacturers and consumers to reduce waste.
urge.cn: 敦促生产商和消费者减少浪费。
urge.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

urgent.cn: 为了满足客户的紧急需求。
urgent.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

usage.en: Through better water management and farming practices, water usage in cotton production can be cut down by nearly 40 percent.
usage.cn: 通过更好的水管理和耕作措施，棉花生产中的用水量可以减少近40%。

utility.en: The New York State parks system wants to turn off the falls on the American side sometime in the next two to three years to replace two 115-year-old stone bridges that allow pedestrians, park vehicles and utilities access to Goat Island.
utility.cn: 纽约州立公园系统计划在未来两到三年内关闭美国一侧的瀑布，以更换两座已有 115 年历史的石桥，这两座石桥允许行人、公园车辆和公用设施通行至山羊岛。

utmost.en: Knowing one's emotional state is of utmost importance in deciding what changes to make for a better work-life balance.
utmost.cn: 了解自己的情绪状态对于决定如何改变工作与生活以达到更好的平衡至关重要。
utmost.source: 2024年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

utter.en: Those were the words uttered by pioneering British scientist Rosalind Franklin, who firmly believed that the pursuit of science should be accessible to all.
utter.cn: 这句话出自英国科学先驱罗莎琳·富兰克林之口，她坚信每个人都应该有追求科学的权利。

vacancy.en: Hotels in San Francisco are experiencing vacancy rates between 70 and 80 percent.
vacancy.cn: 旧金山酒店的空房率在70%到80%之间。
vacancy.source: 2020年12月大学英语六级考试真题

vacation.en: Posting about luxury purchases and expensive vacations online may help you to persuade others and frighten competitors, but it could also signal to potential friends or future employers that you are unlikely to think about the needs of others.
vacation.cn: 在网上发布奢侈品购买和豪华度假的内容可能有助于说服他人或震慑竞争对手，但也可能向潜在朋友或未来雇主传递信号：你不太可能考虑他人的需求。
vacation.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

vacuum.en: Researchers can study the garbage left on the moon to see how its materials weathered the radiation and vacuum of space over time.
vacuum.cn: 研究人员可以研究月球上遗留的垃圾，看看其中的物质是如何随着时间的推移，经受住太空的辐射和真空环境的侵蚀的。
vacuum.source: 2018年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

vague.en: He believes that the dictionary definition of disease "is so vague that we can classify almost anything as a disease" and says the question is not whether we can, but whether we should, and to what end.
vague.cn: 他认为，词典上对疾病的定义“太多模糊，以至于我们几乎可以把任何情况都界定为一种疾病”，他还说，问题并不是我们能否这么做，而是我们是否应该这么做，又出于何种目的。
vague.source: 2021年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

vain.en: I've spent all afternoon trying in vain to put this bookcase together.
vain.cn: 整个下午我都在试着组装这个书柜，可惜徒劳一场。

valid.en: You don't want to get to your destination, only to find you have the wrong visa, or worse, that your passport isn't valid anymore.
valid.cn: 你不会想在到达目的地时才发现签证错了，或者更糟的是你的护照已经过期。
valid.source: 2015年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

validity.en: It proves the validity of ratings awarded by Michelin.
validity.cn: 这证明了米其林评级的有效性。

van.en: We’ll send a van to collect those four and replace them with the Milano you purchased.
van.cn: 我们会派一辆货车去将那四把椅子取回来，并换成您购买的米兰椅子。

vanish.en: As you become more capable of providing yourself with the approval you seek, your need for external validation will start to vanish, leaving you stronger, more confident, and yes, happier in your life.
vanish.cn: 当你变得足以自我认可，满足自己的期望时，对外界认可的渴望就会逐渐消失，使你变得更加坚强、自信，并且，也一定会生活得更幸福。
vanish.source: 2024年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

variable.en: It only means that the gender gap disappears when we plug in the negative reciprocity variable.
variable.cn: 这仅表明，在考虑了负向互惠因素之后，性别间的差异便不复存在。
variable.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

variation.en: Whatever the case, your passport will likely be one of four colors: red, blue, green or black, although there are slight variations.
variation.cn: 但无论如何，你的护照颜色很可能是下列四种之一：红、蓝、绿或黑色，尽管颜色可能有些许不同。
variation.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

various.en: They have taken various steps to get more funding.
various.cn: 他们已采取多种措施以获得更多资金。

vary.en: Organic farming is much less efficient when it comes to land use, although yields vary considerably depending on the crop.
vary.cn: 在土地使用效率上，有机农业要低得多，尽管产量因作物种类而异。

vehicle.en: But now, new research has found the cause and researchers may have come up with a solution for this frustrating traffic pattern: maintaining equal spacing between cars on the road, rather than driving so closely behind another vehicle that a collision is likely if that vehicle brakes suddenly.
vehicle.cn: 然而现在，新研究已经找到了原因，研究人员可能已经为这种令人烦躁的交通模式提出了解决方案：在道路上保持车辆之间的等距离，而不是紧跟前车行驶，这样如果前车突然刹车，就容易发生碰撞。
vehicle.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

veil.en: One argument that you tend to hear a lot from the pro-tipping crowd seems logical enough: the service is better when waiters depend on tips, presumably because they see a benefit to successfully veiling their contempt for you.
veil.cn: 从支持小费的人那里容易听到很多的一个观点似乎很有逻辑：当服务员的收入依靠小费的时候，他们的服务更好，大概是因为他们看到了成功隐藏对你的轻视所带来的好处。
veil.source: 2016年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

venture.en: One reason having a rival can enhance your venture's performance is that it creates a level of excitement that drives you to work harder.
venture.cn: 拥有竞争对手能够增强你的事业表现，原因之一是它激发了一种令人兴奋的竞争氛围，促使你加倍努力。
venture.source: 2023年12月大学英语四级考试真题

verify.en: It is urgent that schools teach kids how to verify online information.
verify.cn: 学校亟需教导孩子们如何核实网络信息。
verify.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

version.en: While lions are not native to China, some versions of the story include the villagers creating a monster of their own in the shape of a lion to fight off the beast.
version.cn: 虽然狮子不是中国原产，但这个故事的一些版本讲述了村民们创造了一个狮子形状的怪物来击退这只野兽。
version.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

versus.en: These differences appear as early as six years old: girls that age already show more interest in helping and caring for others than boys do, and they already exhibit a greater orientation toward family versus career.
versus.cn: 这些差异在六岁时就已显现：这个年纪的女孩比男孩更愿意帮助和照顾他人，并且已经表现出更偏向家庭而非职业的倾向。
versus.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

vertical.en: In 2004, the completed CIS tower became Europe's largest collection of vertical solar panels.
vertical.cn: 2004年，竣工的CIS大厦成为欧洲最大的垂直太阳能电池板收集体。

vessel.en: Teeth have three layers, only one of which—the innermost layer of the tooth—can hurt, as that layer of the tooth contains both blood vessels and nerves.
vessel.cn: 牙齿有三层，其中只有最里面的一层会疼，因为那一层里既包含了血管又有神经。
vessel.source: 2022年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

veteran.en: One veteran player has applied his gaming skills to his real-world business and owes his success partly to a game company.
veteran.cn: 一位资深玩家将他的游戏技能运用到现实商业中，他的成功部分要归功于一家游戏公司。
veteran.source: 2025年12月英语四级 第2套 阅读

victim.en: Hence, his movies are symbolic of the guilt and innocence of the wrongdoer and the victim.
victim.cn: 因此，他的电影往往象征性地展现了犯罪者的罪行与受害者的无辜。
victim.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

viewpoint.en: A recent study tackles the issue of over-trusting drivers and the resulting system misuse from a legal viewpoint .
viewpoint.cn: 最近一项研究从法律角度着手，探讨了驾驶员对自动驾驶系统过度信任以及由此引发的系统滥用问题。

vigor.en: Even as a child I observed people who were poor or disabled or ill, but who nonetheless faced life with optimism and vigor.
vigor.cn: 即使在孩提时代，我也观察到一些贫穷、残疾或患病的人，但他们仍然以乐观和活力面对生活。
vigor.source: 2006年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

vigorous.en: Modern techniques for producing and shipping food led to greater variety and quantity, including a tremendous increase in the amount of animal protein and dairy products available, making us more vigorous than our ancestors.
vigorous.cn: 生产和运输食品的现代技术使得食品更加多样化，数量更丰富，包括可购买的动物蛋白以及乳制品数量的大幅增加，这使得我们比自己的祖先更加有活力。
vigorous.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

violate.en: A woman was charged with allegedly violating a Rhode Island city law against feeding wild animals.
violate.cn: 一名女子被指控违反罗德岛州禁止喂养野生动物的城市法律。
violate.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

violation.en: Failure to follow the golden rule may lead to violation of laws and ethics.
violation.cn: 不遵守黄金法则可能会导致违反法律和道德规范。

violence.en: Just come in and figure out how to increase peace and decrease violence.
violence.cn: 参与进来，想办法增进和平，减少暴力。
violence.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

violent.en: Newspapers are constantly filled with frightening accounts of drug addiction and aggressive behavior supposedly caused by violent video games.
violent.cn: 报刊上不断充斥着有关暴力视频游戏所致药物上瘾和攻击性行为的骇人听闻的报道。
violent.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

virtual.en: A man was left with a $1,000 bill, after his 6-year-old son ordered a virtual buffet of food from several restaurants last weekend.
virtual.cn: 一名男子在上周末因其6岁儿子从多家餐厅点了一场虚拟自助餐，结果留下了1000美元的账单。
virtual.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

virtually.en: When Stanford University scholar Andrea Lunsford gathered data on the rates of errors in “freshman composition” papers going back to 1917, she found that they were virtually identical to today.
virtually.cn: 斯坦福大学学者安德里亚·伦斯福德搜集了自1917年以来大学新生作文中的错误率数据，结果发现这些数据与现在的错误率几乎没有区别。
virtually.source: 2023年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

virtue.en: Leslie argues that curiosity is a much-overlooked human virtue, crucial to our success, and that we are losing it.
virtue.cn: 莱斯利认为，好奇心是一种被严重忽视的人类美德，它对我们的成功至关重要，而我们正在失去它。
virtue.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第3套 阅读

visible.en: The passports of many countries can take images of their well-known geographical features and wildlife, which also function as security features as some are only visible under a special light.
visible.cn: 许多国家的护照上可以使用本国著名的地理特征和野生动物的图像，这些图像也可以作为安全特征，因为有些图像只有在特殊的光线下才可以看到。

vision.en: Without persuasion skills, employees may not be as committed to or convinced of the importance of an organization's vision and long-term mission.
vision.cn: 如果缺乏说服力，员工可能不会十分投入或信服组织的愿景和长远使命的重要性。

vital.en: It concluded that pandas fail to wander off in search of new mates if they find their habitat too comfortable, resulting in a lack of vital genetic diversity.
vital.cn: 研究结论表明，如果熊猫发现它们的栖息地过于舒适，它们就不会外出寻找新伴侣，从而导致缺乏至关重要的基因多样性。
vital.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

vitamin.en: You end up with sugary water with some vitamins .
vitamin.cn: 最终你得到的只是含有少量维生素的糖水。

vocabulary.en: Some students mark new vocabulary in a different color.
vocabulary.cn: 一些学生用不同的颜色标注新词汇。

voltage.en: Heroes serve powers or principles larger than themselves. Like high- voltage transformers, heroes take the energy of higher powers and step it down so that it can be used by ordinary people.
voltage.cn: 英雄侍奉着超越自身的力量或原则。如同高压变压器，英雄们汲取更高力量的能量，并将其转化为普通人也能使用的能量。

volume.en: The labor market is likely cooling, because even a shortage of workers isn't overcoming the historic imbalance between employers and employees in the US: the volume of income that workers take home as a proportion of what the US economy produces is still falling.
volume.cn: 劳动力市场可能正在冷却，因为即使劳动力短缺，也无法克服美国雇主与雇员之间的历史性失衡：工人收入占美国经济产出的比重仍在下降。
volume.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

voluntary.en: However, to be successful it must be voluntary.
voluntary.cn: 然而，要想取得成功，这必须是自愿的。
voluntary.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

volunteer.en: That and other Alzheimer's- related studies are always looking for volunteers to participate, he said.
volunteer.cn: 他表示，其他与阿尔茨海默病相关的研究也一直在寻求志愿者参与。
volunteer.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

vulnerable.en: The most recent count of pandas found that there were more than 1,800 left in the wild, putting them on the list of vulnerable, but not endangered, species.
vulnerable.cn: 最近一次熊猫数量统计显示，野外熊猫数量已超过1,800只，使它们被列为易危而非濒危物种。
vulnerable.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

wander.en: Imagine you are wandering about on a Thai island or admiring the ruins of Angkor.
wander.cn: 想象一下你正漫步在泰国的一个岛屿上，或是在欣赏吴哥遗迹。

ward.en: Today, the European Union is creating a $580 billion fund to ward off sovereign collapse.
ward.cn: 当今，欧盟正在设立一个5800亿美元的基金以防止主权崩溃。

ware.en: At supermarkets, food companies pay to have their wares in places where they're easily seen.
ware.cn: 在超市，食品公司要花钱让他们的商品展示在顾客容易看到的地方。
ware.source: 2013年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

warning.en: This finding is surprising, given that bitterness often serves as a warning mechanism to convince people to spit out harmful substances, scientists said.
warning.cn: 科学家表示，这一研究结论颇为意外，因为苦味通常充当一种警示机制，促使人们把有害物质吐出来。
warning.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第2套 阅读

wasteful.en: But now that you mention it, I do think getting another phone so soon is wasteful , regardless of the cost.
wasteful.cn: 不过你这么一说，我觉得这么快就换新手机确实有点浪费，不管价格如何。

watchful.en: To keep a watchful eye on those employees who perform poorly.
watchful.cn: 密切关注那些表现不佳的员工。
watchful.source: 2022年9月英语四级 第1套 阅读

waterproof.cn: 他们应该使用防水包装材料。

weaken.en: Our eyesight may dim and our recall may weaken , but, by comparison, our ability to produce and to language is well preserved into older adulthood.
weaken.cn: 我们的视力可能会衰退，记忆力可能会减弱，但相比之下，我们的语言表达能力在老年时期仍然保持得很好。

wealthy.en: Studies have shown that people who appear to be wealthy tend to be considered more intelligent, disciplined, and competent than those who do not.
wealthy.cn: 研究表明，外表富有的人通常被认为比不富有的人更聪明、更自律、更有能力。
wealthy.source: 2025年6月英语四级 第1套 听力

weave.en: But it turns out Japan still has some very old mills with the traditional weaving tools used to make jeans the original way.
weave.cn: 但事实证明，日本仍然保留着一些非常古老的纺织厂，拥有传统的织造工具，能够以最初的方式制作牛仔裤。
weave.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

welfare.en: This is based on higher earnings and avoided costs in health care, crime, welfare dependence and other things.
welfare.cn: 这基于更高的收入和医疗、犯罪、福利依赖和其他方面所规避的成本。

whale.en: The whales give birth off the southeast coast of American in the winter and travel to feeding grounds off the northeast coast in the early spring.
whale.cn: 这些鲸鱼在冬季于美国东南沿海产仔，并在早春迁徙到东北沿海的觅食地。

whatsoever.en: It should cause no alarm whatsoever .
whatsoever.cn: 这完全不会引起任何恐慌。

whereas.en: One relies on pesticides whereas the other does not.
whereas.cn: 一种依赖农药，而另一种则不然。
whereas.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

whilst.en: "The ability to absorb information, react swiftly and coordinate actions whilst remaining calm under pressure are often attributes of people that are good at gaming," according to a Royal Air Force spokesperson.
whilst.cn: 英国皇家空军发言人表示："能够快速理解信息、迅速反应并在压力下保持冷静协调行动，这些往往是游戏高手所具备的特质。"

whip.en: In a Los Angeles Times article, one employee referred to the board as a "digital whip . "
whip.cn: 《洛杉矶时报》的一篇文章中，一名员工将董事会比作“数字鞭子”。

whisper.en: When one of my wife's relations, who comes here regularly, found out that we'd been there, he whispered to us, only half-joking: Shh — don't tell anyone!
whisper.cn: 当妻子家族中一位常来这里的成员得知我们去过时，半开玩笑地对我们低声说：“嘘——别告诉任何人！”
whisper.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

wholly.en: In part, this reflects the fact that official campsites have been wholly or partially closed, or are overflowing in a summer when fewer people are going abroad.
wholly.cn: 部分原因是，官方露营地全部或部分关闭，或者在夏季出国旅行的人较少的情况下人满为患。

widen.en: In July, though, the gap widened to 2.6 percentage points.
widen.cn: 然而，在七月，这一差距扩大到了2.6个百分点。

widespread.en: Actually, it was a quarter of people, so the problem really is widespread and deserves attention.
widespread.cn: 实际上，有四分之一的人都有这个问题，所以这个问题确实很普遍，值得重视。

width.en: The cracked tank spilled a pool of rapidly-hardening chocolate, which quickly covered the width of the road.
width.cn: 一滩会快速硬化的巧克力从裂开的罐子中洒了出来，很快就覆盖了整个路面。
width.source: 2020年9月英语四级 第1套 听力

wisdom.en: Some people have said aging is more a slide into forgetfulness than a journey towards wisdom .
wisdom.cn: 有人认为，衰老更多的是逐渐忘却，而非通往智慧的道路。

wit.en: Q1: But the woman says the snake she encountered Thursday terrified her out of her wits .
wit.cn: Q1：但这位女士说，她周四遇到的那条蛇把她吓得魂飞魄散。

withdraw.en: I need to stop at the bank to withdraw some cash.

withstand.en: Gene-edit cacao seedlings for them to withstand a drier, warmer climate.
withstand.cn: 对可可幼苗进行基因编辑，使其能够适应更干燥、更温暖的气候。

witty.en: Robots are not yet witty , Siri is boring.
witty.cn: 机器人还不够机智，Siri 很无聊。

workshop.en: Mr Dittoh says the idea of converting online weather reports into speech came from the farmers themselves, after a workshop in the village of Guabuligah.
workshop.cn: Dittoh先生说，将在线天气预报转换为语音的想法来自于农民自己，他们是在Guumuligah村的一个研讨会之后提出的。
workshop.source: 2023年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

worship.en: The worship of money, beauty and pleasure.
worship.cn: 对金钱、美貌和享乐的崇拜。

worthy.en: Devote themselves to a worthy cause.
worthy.cn: 他们投身于一项有意义的事业。
worthy.source: 2021年6月英语四级 第3套 阅读

wrap.en: He wrapped one layer of the plastic around the card and tried again.
wrap.cn: 他用一层塑料包裹卡片，然后又试了一次。
wrap.source: 2016年6月英语四级 第2套 听力

wreck.en: Natural disasters can wreck a community's infrastructure, disrupting systems for months or years.
wreck.cn: 自然灾害会破坏一个社区的基础设施，扰乱系统数月甚至数年。
wreck.source: 2019年12月英语四级 第1套 阅读

wrinkle.en: I've no idea where ideas come from and I hope I never find out, it would spoil my excitement if it turned out I just have a funny little wrinkle on the surface of my brain which makes me think about invisible train platforms.
wrinkle.cn: 我不知道灵感从何而来，我希望永远不要知道，如果结果发现我只是大脑表面有个奇怪的小褶皱，让我想到看不见的火车站台，那我的兴奋感就全没了。

writer.en: Early this year, Jesse Coburn — an investigative writer with Streetsblog New York — wondered whether those predictions of economic collapse came true.
writer.cn: 今年年初，《街道博客纽约》的调查记者杰西·科伯恩想知道，那些关于经济崩溃的预测是否应验了。

writing.en: His writing is more than a little dense—dense with research, clauses, and precise adjectives and nouns.
writing.cn: 他的写作风格厚重而详尽，充溢着研究内容、复杂的从句和精确的形容词及名词。

x-ray.en: She developed X-ray facilities for military hospitals.
x-ray.cn: 她为军医院开发了X光设备。
x-ray.source: 2017年12月英语四级 第2套 听力

yearly.en: Inform prospective students of their yearly enrollment.
yearly.cn: 告知准学生其年度招生情况。

yield.en: Organic farming is much less efficient when it comes to land use, although yields vary considerably depending on the crop.
yield.cn: 在土地使用效率上，有机农业要低得多，尽管产量因作物种类而异。
yield.source: 2026年6月英语四级 第1套 阅读

youngster.en: He said the youngster instead used his father's online food ordering account to order food from one restaurant after another.
youngster.cn: 他说，这个小孩用他父亲的网上点餐账户，一家接一家地订餐。
